 And always on the lookout for what's next!
   

  

**About Your Application**
* Please submit your application in English - it’s our company language so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join
* We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested please apply through our careers portal

title: LEAD DEVELOPER LOYALTY
description:
**Lead Developer**
 Loyalty Solutions and the feature team EuroBonus Commercial Development & Partnerships at SAS Digital & IT is looking for a Lead Developer.
   

  

**What You Will Work On**
 As Lead Developer your main responsibilities will be to:
   

  

* Lead end-to-end technical development, with a primary focus on frontend technologies.
* Oversee the design, implementation, and optimization of robust, scalable, and secure applications.
* Define and maintain a long-term vision and roadmap for applications within the technology stack, in alignment with domain architecture.
* Together with the Product Owner, align application strategy with business objectives, user needs, and evolving technology trends.
* Drive the adoption of modern engineering practices including use of AI, CI/CD pipelines, and test automation.
* Ensure all applications comply with relevant regulations, security policies, and industry standards.
* Champion strong cybersecurity practices throughout the application lifecycle.
* Ensure high availability, scalability, and resilience of critical systems.
* Oversee and continuously improve application performance monitoring, observability, and alerting.
* Participate hands-on in development to support teams in solving complex technical challenges.
* Promote the use of modular, maintainable, and reusable code to increase development efficiency.
* Elevate software quality by advocating best practices, conducting code reviews, and facilitating knowledge sharing.
* Act as a coach and mentor for both offshore and onshore development teams, fostering collaboration and shared ownership.
* Cultivate a culture of continuous learning, innovation, and technical excellence across the development community.
* Ensure disciplined use of tooling to achieve effective communication, documentation, and traceability across the product lifecycle.


**The Team**
 You will be part of Loyalty Solutions within SAS Digital & IT, and specifically the feature team EuroBonus Commercial Development & Partnerships (ECDP). The team develops and maintains most EuroBonus products and services available to our 9M+ members, including online member pages, partner integrations (credit cards, car rental, hotels, and more), and SkyTeam Alliance loyalty integrations. The team also provides backend services to internal IT teams, enabling their product roadmaps — from award trip booking engines and member validation to much more.
   

  

**We Are Looking For Someone With Strong Experience In**
* Node.js and TypeScript
* React.js and modern front-end web application frameworks
* RESTful and GraphQL APIs
* Spring Boot in microservice architectures
* Database technologies such as MsSQL, Postgres, Cosmos DB, and MongoDB CI/CD pipelines and build tooling (Docker, GitHub Actions)
* Infrastructure as Code — Pulumi and/or Terraform
* Cloud platforms and container orchestration (Azure, Kubernetes)
* Performance optimization and cross-platform front-end development
* Micro-frontend architectures


**Experience With Tools Including**
* Git / GitHub
* Github wokflows
* Azure Cloud Platform
* Kubernetes
* Pulumi, Terraform
* Docker
* K9s
* Contentful
* Kibana, Grafana
* mono repo architecture
* AI workflows and optimizations


**Education & Experience**
* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum 5 years of proven professional experience within software development and operations.
* 2–5 years of professional experience in software development within airline loyalty programs or similar domains.
* Good knowledge of the airline industry and airline technology.
* Prior experience in a senior development lead or mentoring role.
* Strong coding skills and knowledge of modern development tools and practices.


**We Believe You Are**
* Eager to put your creativity and sense of innovation to work to further develop SAS.
* Someone who enjoys being part of a high-performing, multi-skilled, customer-centric team.
* A strong team player who keeps SAS's overall interest in mind and avoids sub-optimizing.
* Passionate about keeping up to date with the latest technology trends and research.
* Driven to improve — you enjoy taking on challenges and finding solutions.
* An excellent communicator, both written and verbal, comfortable with business stakeholders and IT providers alike.
* Open-minded and embracing of cultural differences.
* A natural coach with strong team-building skills, fostering cross-functional collaboration.
* Someone who contributes to an open and learning culture.
* Able to analyze problems and incidents and come up with working solutions.
* Able to translate business needs into IT requirements and specifications.


**Other**
* Travel to development teams at offshore partner expected 1–2 times per year.
* Reporting to the Head of Loyalty Solutions in business unit Commercial Solutions, Digital & IT.


 Why SAS?
   

  

**Benefits**
 At SAS, we offer extensive opportunities for professional development in an international, fast-paced working environment. We are dedicated to the continuous growth of our employees. Working with us comes with a variety of benefits, including:
   

  

* Travel Perks: Enjoy discounted travel opportunities around the world with SAS.
* Health & Wellness: Access to health and wellness benefits, including a newly renovated gym with complimentary classes such as CrossFit and yoga.
* Discounts: Receive discounts from a wide range of brands, as well as on transportation to and from airports, airport shops, hotels, and car rentals.
* Work Environment: Our office location in Frösundavik offers a vibrant workspace with a restaurant, café, and easy access to outdoor activities in Hagaparken and Brunnsviken. Engage in running, tennis, outdoor gym sessions, kayaking, and stand-up paddling with equipment available free of charge.
* Convenient Commute: Benefit from a non-stop bus service connecting our office to Solna station and commuter trains, alongside a network of cycle paths.


**Our Culture at SAS**
 At SAS, we are dedicated to caring for each other, delighting our travelers, and driving the transformation towards sustainable aviation. As a future colleague on our team, you'll join a culture where we work collaboratively towards common goals, recognize each other's contributions, and celebrate successes. Our focus is on safe, sustainable, and punctual execution, and we are committed to protecting our planet while transforming SAS for the future. This is an empowering workplace where you can thrive, grow, and take ownership of your work. Join us at SAS and be part of shaping the future of aviation!
   

  

 Come and fly with us!
   

  

**Additional Information**
* Last day to send in your application is 14/9-2026. Please send us your CV as soon as possible as interviews are conducted continuously and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Note that we are not able to handle applications sent by email, due to GDPR regulations.
* Position: Full-time (100%) starting with a 6-month probation period.
* This position is based in Frösundavik, Solna (Stockholm). You will be expected to work onsite. Remote work may also be an option, depending on the agreement made with your manager.
* A background check will be conducted at the first stage of this recruitment process, as this role is security classified. We kindly ask you to be transparent about any relevant matters during the recruitment process.
* Please note that we do not sponsor work visas for this position. Applicants must be eligible to live and work in Sweden.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Sweden
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
 Job Category
   

  

 Sales
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

 We are Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI + Data + CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer too, driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good, you've come to the right place.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Production experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.
   

  

 Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You'll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.
   

  

 The Builder Experience
   

  

* AI-Powered Development: Ship real customer solutions, supported by best-in-class AI tools — Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes — embedded into your day-to-day workflow.
* Collaborative Delivery: You'll work alongside Senior Forward Deployed Engineers and a Deployment Strategist. You'll own real components, benefit from structured mentorship from people who've shipped agentic systems at scale, and have a clear path to leading complex deliveries yourself.
* Frontier Access: Our agentic AI platform is evolving in real time. You'll work on capabilities most engineers won't touch for months — spanning Agentforce, data, platform, and headless architectures and your field insight will feed directly to the product teams building them.
* Continuous Innovation: You'll be expected to stay at the forefront, experimenting with emerging AI tools, models, and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.


 What You'll Actually Be Building
   

  

* Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.
* Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.
* Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.
* Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output
* Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.
* Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.
* Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.
* Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.
* Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.


 You're Our Forward Deployed Engineer If…
   

  

* You have 3+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you'd be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models
* You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
* You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.
* You're fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.
* You've been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you'd change.
* You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.
* You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.
* You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.
* You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what's coming next.
* You thrive in the group chat that's building something, not just talking about it.
* You're excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.


 Nice-to-Haves
   

  

* Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)
* Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns
* Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
* Experience across specialist AI delivery areas: data engineering, platform architecture, or headless deployments


 Unleash Your Potential
   

  

 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
 *be your best* 
 , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
 *do your best* 
 . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
   

  

 Accommodations
   

  

 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
   

  

 Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
   

  

 Posting Statement
   

  

 Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Senior utvecklare till Arbetsförmedlingen
description:
Vill du vara med och skapa robusta, säkra och återanvändbara lösningar för arbetsmarknaden? På Arbetsförmedlingen arbetar vi med datadelning och distribution, öppna data, API:er och öppen källkod. Våra data och tjänster används av myndigheter, företag, forskare och andra aktörer. Tillsammans får vi Sverige i arbete. Vill du bli en av oss?
   

  





****Sektionens uppdrag****




 Du blir en del av en sektion på cirka 20 personer som arbetar med bland annat API:er, öppna data, Arbetsmarknadstaxonomin, underhåll, incidenthantering och externa dialoger.
 
 Vi arbetar från olika delar av landet och mycket på distans.
   

  





****Beskrivning av tjänsten****




 Vi söker dig som vill ta ett särskilt ansvar för drift, underhåll, kvalitet och säkerhet. Du bidrar till mer enhetliga arbetssätt för DevOps och förvaltning och arbeta nära våra utvecklingsteam.
   

  





 Du kommer bland annat att:
 


* arbeta med drift, felsökning, logganalys och incidenthantering
* utveckla arbetssätt för övervakning, underhåll och förvaltning
* förbättra CI/CD, testning och automatisering
* identifiera och hantera tekniska risker
* bidra till att våra tjänster är robusta, säkra och driftbara
* samverka med andra myndigheter och externa aktörer



  Ditt fokus är att det vi har fungerar stabilt och går att förvalta över tid.
   

  





 Vår driftmiljö omfattar bland annat Kubernetes/OpenShift och Elasticsearch/Kibana. Vi använder främst Java, Python och Clojure.
   

  





 Vi ser gärna att du är noggrann, självgående och gillar ständiga förbättringar. Du får stort mandat att identifiera förbättringsbehov och driva förändringar inom ditt ansvarsområde. Vi förstärker samtidigt vårt arbete med DevOps och du får stöd av en extern resurs inom process och struktur. Arbetsförmedlingens GitLab
   

  





****Vårt erbjudande****




 Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid som kan komma att inledas med sex månaders provanställning. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Placeringsorten är Solna. 
   

  





 Vi erbjuder dig möjligheten att arbeta på en arbetsplats där vi värdesätter balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Du får tillgång till ett generöst semesteravtal, flexibla arbetstider samt möjlighet att arbeta på distans upp till 49 procent på årsbasis. Hos oss ingår även friskvård under arbetstid och ett förmånligt friskvårdsbidrag.
   

  





 Som anställd på Arbetsförmedlingen har du tillgång till kompetensutveckling och karriärmöjligheter inom myndigheten. Genom vårt arbete bidrar vi till ett inkluderande och hållbart samhälle, där du får möjlighet att göra en verklig skillnad för individer och för samhället i stort. Mer om att jobba hos oss 
   

  





****Grundläggande kvalifikationskrav****



* Minst 5 års erfarenhet av drift, underhåll och felsökning, och trivs med att gå ner i loggar för att hitta grundorsaken till problem
* Minst 5 års erfarenhet som utvecklare, med fokus på CI/CD
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska



****Övriga meriter för tjänsten****



* Erfarenhet av funktionell programmering
* Erfarenhet av öppna och länkade data samt den semantiska webben
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med öppen källkod



 Den statliga värdegrunden guidar oss i vårt dagliga arbete. Som anställd hos oss förväntas du arbeta rättvist, opartiskt och med hög integritet, samt bidra till att upprätthålla och stärka förtroendet för vår myndighet.
   

  





 Mer om statliga värdegrunden
   

  





 Utöver detta har du personlig förmåga och fallenhet att arbeta i enlighet med Arbetsförmedlingens medarbetarkriterier.
   

  





 Som medarbetare på Arbetsförmedlingen förväntas du vara:
   

  





**Ansvarstagande** 
 – ta ansvar för ditt arbete, samarbeta och bidra till en god arbetsmiljö.
   

  





**Handlingskraftig** 
 – ta initiativ, bidra till förbättringar och hantera förändringar.
   

  





**Resultatfokuserad** 
 – planera, följa upp och bidra till verksamhetsnytta och resultat.
   

  





****Ansökan****




 Låter det här som en tjänst för dig?
 **Välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026-10-07.**




 Bifoga ditt CV där du specificerar årtal, månad och arbetsuppgifter för varje anställning, samt intyg som styrker kraven om utbildning och/eller arbetslivserfarenhet i din ansökan. Det är viktigt att du besvarar urvalsfrågorna detaljerat och sanningsenligt, för att vi ska få en tydlig bild av din erfarenhet. Om efterfrågad information inte framgår riskerar du bli bortsållad i urvalet. Du behöver inte skicka in ett personligt brev.
   

  





 Under rekryteringsprocessen kan urvalstester förekomma. Vi kommer att hålla dig informerad genom hela rekryteringsprocessen. Mer om vår rekryteringsprocess
   

  





 Har du skyddade personuppgifter kontaktar du den Rekryteringspartner som finns namngiven i annonsen så får du hjälp med att skicka in din ansökan.
   

  





 Vi arbetar aktivt för att vara en myndighet fri från diskriminering. Det är viktigt för oss att all kompetens tas tillvara och vi välkomnar alla sökande. Vi ser positivt på om du har kunskaper i något av våra nationella minoritetsspråk.
   

  





 Välkommen till oss – vi jobbar för ett Sverige i arbete! Här arbetar du på regeringens uppdrag för en väl fungerande arbetsmarknad. Målet är att korta tiden i arbetslöshet genom att matcha arbetssökande med arbetsgivare. Våra insatser riktas i första hand till dem som står längst ifrån arbetsmarknaden och till de arbetsgivare som är öppna för att anställa dem med störst behov av stöd. Vi motverkar felaktiga utbetalningar och brott mot välfärdssystemen så att våra skattemedel används effektivt till det de är till för. Vi samarbetar med många andra aktörer och tillsammans hittar vi lösningar som gör skillnad - för ett Sverige i arbete.
   

  





 Mer om vår organisation och vårt uppdrag

title: Android BSP Engineer
description:
**About Ubiquiti**
 At Ubiquiti Inc., we create technology platforms for Businesses, Smart Homes, and Internet Service Providers, driven by our goal to connect everyone, everywhere. To date, Ubiquiti has shipped over 100 million devices worldwide, from ISP networking products to next generation of IT solutions. Our growth is made possible by the dedicated team of hundreds behind the scenes. From software developers and product managers to designers and strategists, Team UI is driven to achieve our common goal: Rethinking IT. At Ubiquiti, you’ll heighten your potential and broaden your horizons - all while shaping the future of connectivity.
   

  

**Join forces with us on our mission to build a better IT industry. We are currently looking for a highly skilled Android BSP Engineer to our team in Stockholm or Malmö, Sweden.**
***Please note that applicants must live in Sweden and hold a valid work permit at the time of application to be considered for this role.***
**Responsibilities**
* Bring up Android on new custom hardware, from initial kernel boot through a fully functioning Android system
* Develop and customize the Android platform and board support package
* Configure and maintain the Linux kernel, device tree, boot configuration, and Android device configuration
* Integrate the Android software stack with custom hardware
* Integrate, port, develop, and maintain drivers and interfaces for RFID readers, sensors, and other peripherals
* Develop and integrate Android HALs, native services, system services, and application-facing APIs

* Build, configure, flash, and maintain Android system images
* Support system validation, production readiness, and compatibility testing
* Collaborate closely with hardware, embedded, application, manufacturing, and product engineers
* Help define the platform architecture, development workflows, and engineering practices for a new product at an early stage


**Requirements**
* Professional experience with Android platform development, AOSP, Android BSPs, or Android-based embedded systems
* Strong knowledge of embedded Linux, including kernel configuration, device trees, and device drivers
* Experience bringing up software on new hardware or diagnosing board-level hardware/software integration problems
* Strong C and C++ development skills in embedded or system-level environments Experience with hardware interfaces such as SPI, I²C, UART, USB, and GPIO
* A systematic debugging approach and the ability to isolate problems across hardware and software layers
* Experience building, configuring, modifying, and flashing Linux or Android system images
* Ability to read hardware schematics and component datasheets
* Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively with engineers from different disciplines


***Please note that a background check will be conducted in the final stage of the recruitment process***

title: Agentic AI Developer (Forward Deployed)
description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.
   

  

**Your role**
 As an Agentic AI Developer you will co-create and deliver intelligent AI solutions together with a collaborative and diverse team which are embedded with our clients, designing, developing, and deploying end-to-end agentic AI systems that are intelligent, autonomous solutions.
   

  

 This role combines AI engineering, software development, and system integration expertise to build scalable, production-ready solutions leveraging LLMs, vector databases, orchestration frameworks, model context protocols (MCP), tool use, evaluation frameworks, and modern web technologies.
   

  

 You will work close to the client, shaping use cases with the people who will use them, and iterating on working software rather than waiting for a specification. You will collaborate in cross-functional teams with data scientists, developers, and product specialists, where knowledge-sharing and support are part of everyday work.
   

  

*In this role you will play a key role in:*
* GenAI & Agent Engineering: architect and implement agentic workflows and multi-agent orchestration using GenAI models (e.g., Claude, GPT, Gemini, Kimi): agent roles, memory systems, tool integrations, MCP-based integrations, and inter-agent communication protocols.
* Work with orchestration platforms such as LangGraph, Agent SDK, or Google ADK and cloud AI platforms (AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI, Azure AI Foundry, Agent Builder), optimizing agent workflows for reasoning, planning, tool use, reliability, and cost efficiency.
* Prompt & Context Engineering: design and iterate high-quality prompts for agentic tasks, with prompt templates, context management strategies, and RAG pipelines using vector databases (e.g., Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate). Improve accuracy, latency, safety, and cost through prompt optimization, retrieval quality assessment, grounding validation, and automated evaluation frameworks.
* Backend Development: build and maintain backend services and RESTful APIs supporting agent orchestration and user interfaces. Develop microservices using Python (FastAPI, Flask) or Node.js with the scalability and security to integrate with cloud-native services such as BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Firestore, messaging queues, and enterprise data platforms.
* Cloud & DevOps: deploy and monitor GenAI applications on AWS, Azure, or GCP using CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). Implement logging, tracing, observability, evaluation pipelines, and performance monitoring for agent-based systems.
* Client Delivery: run discovery and feasibility assessments that turn client ambitions into scoped use cases. Build prototypes fast, put them in front of real users, and navigate the realities of enterprise delivery like data access, legacy integration, security reviews. Document what you build and enable client teams to run it.


**Your profile**
* Experience with Python, SQL, JavaScript, TypeScript, or similar programming languages.
* Experience with GenAI frameworks such as LangGraph, Anthropic Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, or similar.
* Strong understanding of LLM orchestration, tool calling, RAG, MCP, prompt engineering, evaluation methodologies, and agentic workflows.
* Experience with backend development (FastAPI, Flask, Node.js), cloud deployment, and cloud AI platforms (AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI, Azure AI Foundry).
* Experience with AI observability, evaluation frameworks, prompt/version management, and production AI operations.
* Comfortable engaging senior stakeholders and working in ambiguous environments where requirements are not yet fully defined.
* Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or a related quantitative field.
* Fluent in English.


*If you also have experience with AI observability, evaluation, governance, safety, compliance and speaks Swedish fluent it's a strong plus.*
**What We Believe You Will Enjoy About Working Here**
* The opportunity to shape your own development, whether you want to deepen your expertise in Data & AI or explore new roles and areas of responsibility.
* A culture where learning is part of everyday work – through certifications, communities, knowledge hubs, and colleagues who are always willing to share their knowledge.
* Flexibility in how and where you work, with opportunities for hybrid working when assignments allow.


**Application**
*As part of our recruitment process, identity verification will be conducted through inspection of your ID card, and background checks may be carried out as required. We welcome applicants with different backgrounds and experiences. If you're excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway.*
*We believe diverse perspectives make better products and stronger teams. We actively strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute. We welcome applicants of all genders, backgrounds, and experiences.*
**About Capgemini**
 Capgemini is the business transformation partner for enterprises in the age of AI. We help organizations imagine and build an intelligent, sustainable future, combining AI, technology and human ingenuity to transform how they operate, innovate and grow. With unique end-to-end capabilities spanning strategy, technology, engineering and intelligent operations, we bring together deep industry expertise and market-leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data to turn ambition into measurable business outcomes at scale. Supported by a robust ecosystem of partners and nearly 60 years of expertise, Capgemini is a responsible and diverse global organization of over 410,000 team members in more than 50 countries. The Group reported 2025 revenues of €22.5 billion.
   

  

**Make it real** 
 | www.capgemini.com

title: AI Engineer
description:
**Are you passionate about how AI can shape the insurance market?**
 Join either
 **Data Discovery & Experience** 
 or
 **API Platform** 
 , two teams within API & Data Products Solutions.
   

  

 Our mission is to make APIs, MCPs and Data easy to discover, understand, and use. To support that journey, we are looking for an AI Engineer who is excited about building the next generation of AI-powered experiences.
   

  

**About The Role**
 You will help shape AI-powered experiences by enabling AI agents, APIs, MCPs, and Data Products to create value for developers, employees, partners, and customers.
   

  

 Working hands-on with modern AI technologies, agent frameworks, APIs, and platform capabilities, you will build scalable solutions that enable teams across If to discover, access, and use digital capabilities more effectively.
   

  

 As part of a cross-functional team of Product Managers, Architects, Engineers, and business stakeholders, you will turn emerging AI opportunities into practical solutions with measurable business impact.
   

  

* Help evolve our Data Discovery & Experience or API Platform capabilities.
* Design and develop AI-powered platform capabilities using AI agents, APIs, MCPs, and Data Products.
* Improve how APIs, MCPs, and Data Products are discovered, understood, and used across If.
* Help ensure secure access using open standards.
* Apply platform engineering and product thinking to solve real business problems.
* Contribute to AI literacy and AI-enabled ways of working.


 We offer
   

  

**Benefits**
 In the same way that we place high demands on you as an employee, we also expect you to place high demands on us as an employer. Here are some of the benefits of working at If:
   

  

* An including work environment where everyone is welcome
* Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
* Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment
* Possibility of hybrid workplace
* Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities
* Great insurance benefits
* Lunch benefit


**About The Team**
 Depending on your background, interests, and experience, you may join either the
 **Data Discovery & Experience** 
 team or the
 **API Platform** 
 team.
   

  

 The
 **Data Discovery & Experience** 
 team works closely with business and technical stakeholders to improve how APIs and Data are discovered, understood, and used as Products across If.
   

  

 The
 **API Platform** 
 team focuses on building and evolving common platform capabilities that enable secure, scalable, and efficient API consumption and integration across If and with external partners.
   

  

 Both teams use agile ways of working and collaborate closely with stakeholders across business and technology domains.
   

  

 This position is also a part of a larger agile Tribe responsible for providing common API and IAM capabilities that enable If's business to grow in a secure, scalable, and compliant manner. We support both internal teams and external partners through technology, products, processes, training, and governance.
   

  

 Who are you?
   

  

 You are curious, innovative, and motivated by making hard things look easy.
   

  

 You enjoy experimenting with new technologies and turning ideas into working solutions. You combine strong technical skills with a product mindset and are excited about creating experiences that are useful, intuitive, and valuable to users.
   

  

 You are comfortable navigating uncertainty, learning quickly, and working in a field that is evolving.
   

  

 You see AI not as a standalone technology, but as a capability that becomes powerful when combined with data, business processes, and great user experiences.
   

  

 You are passionate about agile ways of working, continuous improvement, and exploring new technologies.
   

  

 You have the ability to make complex technical concepts understandable and actionable for both technical and business stakeholders.
   

  

**You Also Have**
* Relevant university degree, preferably within Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data & Analytics, or a related technical field. Equivalent practical experience is also valued.
* Experience in the insurance industry or another regulated industry, such as banking, finance, healthcare, telecommunications, or the public sector.
* At least 3 years of experience in software engineering and modern application development.
* At least 1-2 years of practical, hands-on experience applying AI engineering practices in production or real-world applications.
* Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
* Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as C#, TypeScript, or Python.


 Experience from one or more of the following areas is considered a strong advantage:
   

  

* AI Agents, Agentic Workflows, and Agent Frameworks such as LangGraph, Pydantic AI, Microsoft Agent Framework, or similar technologies.
* MCP (Model Context Protocol), including providing AI systems with context, tools, and access to enterprise capabilities.
* Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), prompt and context engineering, evaluation, and model orchestration.
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search, embeddings, and semantic search technologies.
* APIs, API Platforms, integration technologies, and secure access using open standards, as well as Data Products, Data Discovery, Analytics Platforms, and Developer Experience capabilities.
* Cloud-native application development using Microsoft Azure or similar cloud platforms.


 Additional facts and the recruitment process
   

  

**Application deadline:** 
 Screening and interviewing will start immediately. However, application deadline is October 11, 2026.
   

  

**To apply for the position:** 
 Please attach your CV and fill in the questionnaires
   

  

**Work location:** 
 Bergshamra, Stockholm
   

  

**Travelling:** 
 Some travel within the Nordics and Baltics is required
   

  

**Start:** 
 Upon agreement
   

  

 For more information, please contact Daniel Sahlin, Head of API and Data Product Solutions, +46 (0) 771 43 00 00
   

  

 Final candidates will undergo a background check before employment.
   

  

 We look forward to your application!

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**Techster Solutions** 
 befinner i dagsläget sig i en spännande tillväxtfas och söker nu fler kollegor, inledningsvis dig med minst
 **3+** 
 års erfarenhet och som kan stärka teamet.
   

  

 Du kan förvänta dig en omväxlande miljö, dagarna kan se väldigt olika ut - men en sak är säkert, här får du använda dina kompetenser och sätter själv gränsen för hur mycket du vill utvecklas. Som ett kunskapsbolag är det viktigt för oss att våra specialister delar med sig av sin kompetens och får kollegorna att växa.
   

  

**Rollbeskrivning** 
 :
   

  

 Vi söker nu en senior Data Engineer.
   

  

 Uppdragsbeskrivning:
   

  

 Kund söker en driven och framåtsträvande senior data engineer till Digitaliseringsenheten. Enheten ingår i avdelningen för verksamhetsstöd och ansvarar för verksamhetsnära digitala lösningar som stöder myndighetens kärnverksamhet.
   

  

 Digitaliseringsenheten arbetar agilt i fyra utvecklingsteam och präglas av innovation, nytänkande och höga ambitioner.
   

  

 Som senior data engineer blir du en nyckelperson i utvecklingen och förvaltningen av vårt datalager och våra BI-lösningar. Du kommer att driva tekniska beslut, optimera dataprocesser och säkerställa robusta, långsiktiga lösningar som skapar värde för verksamheten samt analysera och lösa komplexa problem på djupet.
   

  

 Placering: kunds kontor i Stockholm men med möjlighet till visst distansarbete.
   

  

**Arbetsuppgifter**
* Designa, utveckla och underhålla datalager, ETL-flöden och SSAS-kuber för rapportering och analys.
* Bygga datamodeller i SSAS som möjliggör effektiva och användarvänliga Power BI-lösningar.
* Felsöka, analysera och lösa komplexa problem i datalager och dataprocesser, från rotorsak till färdig lösning.
* Driva tekniska beslut kring arkitektur, datamodellering, datakvalitet och optimering av kuber.
* Samarbeta nära verksamheten för att förstå behov och omvandla dem till datadrivna beslutsstöd.
* Coachning och mentorskap av kollegor i teamet, inklusive standardisering av kod och processer.
* Bidra till en insiktsdriven myndighet genom att identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter och föreslå nya lösningar.


 Krav
   

  

 Skallkrav:
   

  

* Relevant högskoleutbildning inom systemvetenskap, datavetenskap eller annan teknisk utbildning som bedöms relevant.
* Minst 3–5 års erfarenhet som data engineer med fokus på datalager, ETL, BI-lösningar eller motsvarande.
* Mycket goda kunskaper i SSAS (SQL Server Analysis Services) och erfarenhet av att bygga kuber, datamodeller och measures för analys och rapportering.
* Mycket goda kunskaper i SQL och erfarenhet av att skriva och optimera komplexa queries.
* Erfarenhet av Microsoft SQL Server on-prem, inklusive Management Studio och databasadministration på utvecklingsnivå.
* God förståelse för datamodellering och databasdesign (t.ex. 3NF och Kimball).
* Vana vid Git och versionshantering, samt dokumentation av kod och dataprocesser.
* Mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska.
* Utvärdering av de personliga egenskaperna kommer att ske vid en eventuell intervju


 Börkrav:
   

  

* Erfarenhet av att arbeta i agila team och nära kärnverksamheten.
* Erfarenhet av att driva förbättringar inom datakvalitet, datastyrning och best practices.


**Ansökan**
 Tror du att du är
 **Techster Solutions** 
 nästa stjärna? Tveka då inte att skicka in din ansökan redan nu. Urval sker löpande och tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse.
   

  

 Arbetsplats och kultur
   

  

 Vi är ett entreprenördrivet IT företag, med både produktkunskap och försäljning (Techster AB) och konsultativa tjänster (Techster Solutions AB). Det innebär att vi är mycket öppna för nya tekniska lösningar, kunskapsutbyte och ständigt lärande. Att ha roligt och samtidigt behålla den familjära andan utan hierarkier är lika viktigt.
   

  

 Vi vill skapa det konsultbolag som du alltid velat jobba för, men kanske inte hittat ännu. Redan idag har vi en blandning av seniora och yngre medarbetare, såväl som män och kvinnor. Det vill vi fortsätta att bygga på. Så välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Data Engineer
description:
*Vill du vara med och bygga robusta dataflöden som möjliggör analys, maskininlärning och AI i praktiken? Nu söker vi på Länsförsäkringar AB en Data Engineer som vill utveckla skalbara och pålitliga lösningar i nära samarbete med data scientists, AI Engineers och arkitekter. Här får du en viktig roll i ett innovativt och prestigelöst team där ny teknik, samarbete och verklig verksamhetsnytta står i centrum.*
*OBS: Då denna rekrytering sker under semestertider kan återkoppling komma att dröja lite längre än vanligt.*
**Om jobbet**
 Som Data Engineer inom gruppen Data Science får du en central roll i att bygga och vidareutveckla den informationsförsörjning som krävs för analys, maskininlärning och AI. Rollen innebär att du arbetar med lösningar som behöver vara robusta, skalbara och långsiktigt hållbara, med fokus på att göra rätt data tillgänglig med rätt kvalitet, i rätt format och vid rätt tidpunkt. Du blir en del av ett innovativt team på 16 personer där data scientists, AI Engineers, lösningsarkitekter och Data Engineers arbetar nära varandra, delar kunskap och tillsammans driver AI-utvecklingen framåt inom Länsförsäkringar AB. Här får du möjlighet att bygga lösningar som används i praktiken och bidra till framtidens AI i en miljö präglad av samarbete, utveckling och hög teknisk ambition.
   

  

**Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer vara bland annat:**
* designa, bygga och underhålla skalbara, robusta och pålitliga datapipelines
* strukturera och modellera data så att den kan användas för analys, feature engineering och maskininlärning
* säkerställa stabil informationsförsörjning till ML-modeller och AI-tillämpningar i nära samarbete med data scientists och AI Engineers
* bygga integrationer och datatjänster som gör information tillgänglig på ett säkert, effektivt och återanvändbart sätt
* bidra till övervakning, loggning och kvalitetssäkring för att följa upp hälsa, prestanda och tillförlitlighet i datapipelines


 Följande kommer göra dig framgångsrik i denna tjänst:
   

  

* högskole- eller universitetsutbildning inom relevant tekniskt område, exempelvis datateknik, AI, teknisk fysik eller matematik
* några års arbetslivserfarenhet av data engineering, backendutveckling eller liknande roller där du har byggt dataflöden i produktion
* stark utvecklarbakgrund, gärna med Python, samt erfarenhet av att designa, bygga och underhålla datapipelines
* god förståelse för datamodellering, datatransformation och datakvalitet
* erfarenhet av databaser, datalagring, molnplattformar som Azure och containerbaserade lösningar
* grundläggande kunskaper i svenska
* möjlighet att jobba på plats på Gärdet i Stockholm, där vi har vårt kontor
* förmåga att samarbeta nära data scientists, utvecklare och andra intressenter för att omsätta databehov till fungerande lösningar


 Meriterande är även om du har:
   

  

* erfarenhet av dataflöden till ML-modeller eller AI-tillämpningar, exempelvis feature stores
* erfarenhet av vektor- eller grafbaserad datahantering, exempelvis semantisk sökning eller kunskapsgrafer
* erfarenhet av ostrukturerad eller semistrukturerad data
* erfarenhet av strömmande dataarkitekturer
* erfarenhet av API-utveckling och ramverk som FastAPI eller LangChain
* relevanta certifieringar inom exempelvis Azure, data engineering, DevOps, molnplattformar eller databaser


 Som person är du kommunikativ, självgående, strukturerad och ansvarstagande. Du har lätt för att samarbeta nära olika kompetenser och intressenter och trivs i en miljö där kunskapsdelning är en naturlig del av arbetet. Du har ett problemlösande förhållningssätt, är nyfiken på att utvecklas inom data engineering och AI-/ML-nära dataflöden och känner ett starkt ägarskap för kvalitet, långsiktighet och användbarhet i det du bygger.
   

  

**Kontaktpersoner**
 Rekryterande chef: Fredrik Urby, fredrik.urby@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

 Facklig representant Forena: Susanne Hirsch, susanne.hirsch2@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

 Facklig representant Akademikerföreningen: Maria Eriksson, maria.eriksson@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

*Låter det spännande? Då vill vi veta mer om dig! Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag. Vi arbetar löpande med denna rekrytering och kan komma att tillsätta tjänsten innan sista ansökningsdag.*
 Länsförsäkringar AB är en inkluderande arbetsplats där mod, möjligheter och engagemang står i centrum. Vi erbjuder ett hållbart arbetsliv med flexibla villkor och satsar på att alla medarbetare ska kunna växa och trivas, oavsett bakgrund.
   

  

 Affärsenhet Sak är länsförsäkringsgruppens drivkraft inom sakförsäkring. Vi utvecklar nya affärer, skapar smarta försäkringslösningar och ser till att kunderna alltid har trygghet i vardagen. Vi står bakom gemensamma koncept, digital försäljning och kundkommunikation – och vi kompletterar bolagens erbjudanden med specialprodukter som gör skillnad.
   

  

 Hos oss får du vara med och forma framtidens försäkring – där innovation möter samhällsnytta.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Syntrace builds conversational knowledge for institutional investors. We capture, organize and synthesize private conversations into source-backed knowledge a firm can build on.
 



  





 We are now hiring a Machine Learning Engineer, based in Stockholm.
 



  





 You will build and improve the models and pipelines behind them. You will design the evaluations that tell us when it works, and run the experiments that make it better.
 



  





 Our users trust us with the most sensitive conversations they have. That makes security part of the product, not a feature on top of it. It shapes which models we use and where data is processed.
 



  





**What you bring:** 




  





 - Several years building machine learning systems in production.
 



 - Strong Python and experience with modern deep learning frameworks.
 



 - A disciplined approach to evaluation. You measure before you claim.
 



 - Experience with LLMs, speech or retrieval is a strong plus.
 



  





**What you get:** 




  





 - A founding role with real ownership.
 



 - A senior team that has scaled companies before.
 



 - Hard problems where accuracy is the product.
 



  





 To apply, send a short note to careers@syntrace.com about yourself.
 



  





 If you know someone who should read this, send it to them.

title: ITSM-utvecklare
description:
**Startdatum:** 
 2026-10-12
   

  

**Slutdatum:** 
 2027-10-03, option på förlängning
   

  

**Omfattning:** 
 100%
   

  

**Plats:** 
 Stockholm / hybrid, 3-4 dagar på plats
   

  

**Uppdragsbeskrivning**
 Vi söker en erfaren ITSM-utvecklare till ett nyetablerat team med ansvar för vidareutveckling, konfiguration, integration och teknisk förvaltning av en ITSM-plattform. Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med teknisk lead, produktägare, förvaltningsorganisation och andra tekniska funktioner.

* Implementera formulär, arbetsflöden, regler, notifieringar, rapporter och integrationer.
* Vidareutveckla stöd för bland annat Incident, Problem, Change, Release och Configuration Management.
* Analysera krav, identifiera tekniska lösningar samt genomföra felsökning och korrigeringar.
* Arbeta med test, kvalitetssäkring, versions- och releasehantering samt teknisk dokumentation.
* Samverka med produktägare, arkitekter, säkerhetsfunktioner och externa samarbetspartners samt bidra vid överlämning till förvaltning.


**Skall-krav**
* Minst 3 års dokumenterad erfarenhet av utveckling och konfiguration av ITSM-verktyg.

* Erfarenhet från minst 2 uppdrag med integrationer och datautbyte mellan ITSM-plattformar och andra system, exempelvis genom REST/API och JSON.

* Erfarenhet från minst 2 uppdrag av scripting eller motsvarande teknisk anpassning i samband med ITSM-verktyg
* Erfarenhet från minst 2 uppdrag av arbete med minst tre av följande: test, felsökning, teknisk dokumentation, versionshantering och releasehantering.


**Meriterande**
* Minst 3 års erfarenhet av utveckling och konfiguration i ITSM-plattformen Service Desk Plus.
* Erfarenhet från minst 1 uppdrag av utveckling eller vidareutveckling av CMDB/Configuration Management i ett ITSM-verktyg.
* Erfarenhet från minst 1 uppdrag där ett nytt ITSM-verktyg eller en ny ITSM-plattform införts eller etablerats, inklusive överlämning till förvaltningsorganisation.

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
Stories have the power to make the ordinary extraordinary. They help us think bigger, see beyond ourselves, and deepen our connection with others.
   

  

 As one of the world’s leading audiobook and e-book streaming platforms, Storytel brings unlimited listening to millions of users across 25 markets. We’re at the forefront of digital storytelling, driven by a vision to make the world a more empathetic and creative place.
   

  

 Ready for your next chapter? We are looking for an Analytics Engineer to join the team in Stockholm.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We are proud of our ability to combine technical expertise with sound business sense. This translates to solutions that are not only effective in addressing current challenges but also sustainable long term. Our team is composed of Analytics Engineers and Data Engineers, fostering a collaborative environment that enables us to manage data end to end – from optimizing data pipelines to developing user-friendly models for analysis.
   

  

 Our technology stack includes BigQuery (SQL), Looker, dbt™, and Google Cloud Platform, with opportunities to evaluate and introduce new technologies as we scale.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As an Analytics Engineer, you'll work with developing data capabilities that power decisions across our global organization. You'll have significant technical and organizational impact, driving both immediate solutions and long-term strategic initiatives.
   

  

**Examples Of Responsibilities**
* Develop data transformation steps and build a strong data modeling foundation for enabling self-service analytics across the company.
* Build and maintain trusting, working relationships with business partners across domains and discover high-impact opportunities to enable self-service analytics in our semantic layer.
* Strategically plan and deliver meaningful projects to increase data literacy at Storytel.
* Lead the resolution of critical data issues, establishing monitoring systems and best practices to prevent future problems and improve data reliability.
* Collaborate with data practitioners to understand their needs and requirements, breaking down complicated technical concepts to fit the audience.
* Drive adoption of technical best practices across the data team, mentoring others and bringing in industry innovations that improve how we work.


**We believe that you have**
* Experience with creating and maintaining semantic layers.
* Experience in working with data (BI/Analytics/Data Engineering) specializing within Analytics Engineering.
* Deep expertise in SQL and data modeling and extensive experience with modern data stack technologies (e.g., dbt™, Looker, BigQuery, or equivalent tools).
* The ability to consistently deliver performant, accurate, and scalable solutions.
* Experience mentoring junior engineers and driving team-wide technical improvements.
* Proven ability to lead complex data projects, solve problems independently, and proactively improve products.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to various audiences.
* The ability to thrive in a feedback culture and constantly strive to improve your own skills and knowledge.


**Bonus If You Experience**
* Working with Python.
* With data governance and access management.
* With different data modeling schemas.
* Working with international teams and global data operations.


 Join a world of stories
   

  

 At Storytel, we’re a team of creative story lovers who thrive on collaboration and new ideas. Our workplace is friendly, dynamic, and full of opportunities to experiment and make an impact. We believe in trust, flat hierarchies, and empowering you to grow with us.
   

  

 Does this sound like your next story? Simply fill out the application form and share your CV or LinkedIn profile – no cover letter needed. Answer a few questions, and you’re all set.
   

  

 Does this sound like you? If you feel like Storytel is a place where you could thrive, please submit your application in English and we will contact you as soon as possible.

title: Staff Engineer | Group Operations
description:
**Every parcel we deliver starts with an engineering decision**
 At Instabee, we don't just move parcels — we solve some of the most complex physical-world problems in European logistics, at scale. From the algorithms that optimize a driver's route to the systems that predict terminal throughput hours in advance, our engineering decisions have a direct impact on millions of deliveries every day.
   

  

 We're now looking for a Staff Engineer to join our technical leadership group — someone who doesn't just write great code, but shapes how entire teams think, build, and deliver.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This isn't a traditional engineering role. As a Staff Engineer in Group Operations, you sit at the intersection of technical strategy and real-world logistics. You work alongside Product and Engineering Management to ensure multiple teams are building the right things, in the right way, at the right scale.
   

  

 Think of yourself as the technical glue — the person who bridges business ambition and engineering execution, who spots the hard problems before they become expensive ones, and who raises the bar for the entire engineering organization around you.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Drive Technical Strategy & Architecture Set the technical direction across multiple teams in Operations. You'll guide engineers toward right-sized solutions — balancing high-scale stability with the speed needed to move the needle on operational KPIs.
* Tackle Genuinely Hard Problems Forecasting incoming parcel volumes, optimizing terminal throughput, routing thousands of drivers in real time — these are the kinds of challenges that define our business and your days.
* Champion Developer Experience Identify and eliminate technical friction. You'll lead initiatives to improve testing environments and deployment speed, keeping our engineering organization sharp and efficient.
* Bridge Business & Tech Translate complex business requirements into evolvable technical designs. You'll help teams understand how their code directly impacts the P&L of our logistics network — and why that matters.
* Mentor & Build Culture Act as a role model for the engineering community. You'll mentor senior engineers, promote a culture of learning from failure, and foster cross-team collaboration to ensure we don't reinvent the wheel.
* Enable Data-Driven Decisions Work closely with Data and Product teams to ensure our systems produce high-quality insights that power company-wide decisions.


**What We're Looking For**
 You don't need to be an expert in everything your teams do — but you should care deeply about helping them succeed. Since the teams you'll be leading work across both software engineering and data science, we're looking for someone who is comfortable in both worlds. We think you'll thrive in this role if you are:
   

  

* A Leader with Dual Competencies — You have a background in maths, forecasting, or ML, yet have spent years building robust, production-grade software systems. You're as comfortable discussing model accuracy as you are system reliability.
* A Technical Leader — You have broad experience building distributed systems and can navigate deep technical dives and high-level architectural trade-offs with equal confidence.
* Strategic & Pragmatic — You know that "perfect is the enemy of good." You favor an iterative mindset, delivering value early and often rather than waiting for the ideal solution.
* Operationally Curious — You're fascinated by the intersection of software and physical operations. Experience in logistics, routing, or hardware integration is a significant plus.
* A Communicator & Collaborator — You can translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and thrive in a cross-functional environment where engineering, product, and business work closely together toward shared goals.
* A Quality Advocate — You hold a high bar for stability and security — but you know how to achieve it without killing the pace of innovation.


**Why join Instabee?**
 You won’t just be another employee here; you’ll be a builder. We offer the chance to sharpen your skills alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry. If you’re someone who sees an inefficient process and thinks, "I can make that better," you’re going to love it here.
   

  

**The Perks**
 🌇
 **The Best View in Town** 
 Our Stockholm HQ offers a stunning 360-degree panorama.
   

  

 🐶
 **Dog-Friendly Culture** 
 No need to leave your best friend at home; our furry friends have their own floor!
   

  

 🏓
 **Unwind & Recharge** 
 Whether it's a competitive game of Foosball or a Karaoke solo, we take our fun seriously.
   

  

 👶
 **Family First** 
 We support our new parents with six months of parental pay.
   

  

 🎂
 **Birthday Gift** 
 Enjoy a fully paid day off to celebrate another trip around the sun.
   

  

 ⏰
 **Work-Life Harmony** 
 Hybrid working and flexible hours come as standard.
   

  

**The Journey So Far**
 Instabee was born when two pioneers, Budbee and Instabox, joined forces. Today, we are on a mission to become the leading European e-commerce enabler. We are a high-speed business, expanding across borders and constantly evolving. As our journey grows in scale and complexity, we need people like you to help us navigate the road ahead.
   

  

*As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and trustworthy workplace, all candidates applying to Instabee in Sweden will undergo a background check conducted by Svensk Bakgrundsanalys. This review examines public criminal records and is a mandatory step in our recruitment process. While the results are public information, we handle all data with the utmost confidentiality.*
 Instabee Group, with consumer-facing brands Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy, brings together years of experience in delivery. Today, Instabee Group is present in five markets, serving thousands of online merchants and millions of consumers with seamless home deliveries and convenient parcel locker deliveries, using the best fuel available. With smart technology, a strong focus on sustainability, and a secure supply chain, Instabee has become a trusted partner for online merchants and a preferred choice for consumers.

title: Tech Graduate - Stockholm
description:
**Vill du starta karriären med att bygga något som faktiskt används, lära dig hur moderna teknikplattformar fungerar från insidan, och få möjlighet att påverka mer än du kanske tror som nyutbildad?**
 Intility är en digital grund och teknikplattform som används av mer än 700 verksamheter. Vi är över 700 medarbetare, med en snittålder på runt 30 år, som tillsammans arbetar för att bygga Europas ledande teknikplattform.
   

  

 Även om vi idag är en trygg digital grund för hundratals verksamheter, är vi fortfarande tidigt i resan mot det vi kan bli. Som Tech Graduate får du möjligheten att vara med på den resan från början av karriären.
   

  

**En skalbar modell**
 Intility är byggt som en plattformsverksamhet, med samma grundläggande principer för skalbarhet som företag som Spotify och Amazon. När vi förbättrar något i plattformen påverkar det alla kunder.
   

  

 Det gäller också tekniken du jobbar med. Automatisering, kod, arkitektur och nya plattformsfunktioner utvecklas inte bara för en enskild kund, utan som del av en gemensam teknikplattform.
   

  

 För dig som vill förstå teknik på djupet och samtidigt se hur den fungerar i stor skala, ger det en sällsynt möjlighet att vara med och bygga vidare på en modern teknikplattform.
   

  

**Lär dig plattformen från insidan**
 Som Tech Graduate kommer du nära tekniken som Intility bygger, utvecklar och driftar varje dag. Du jobbar hands-on med verkliga tekniska problemställningar och lär dig hur identitet, nätverk, säkerhet, cloud, data, AI och digitala arbetsytor fungerar tillsammans som en plattform.
   

  

 Du bidrar direkt till utvecklingen av plattformen och bygger både bredd över hela plattformen och djup inom ditt eget område. Eftersom plattformen utvecklas kontinuerligt möter du ständigt nya teknologier, problemställningar och möjligheter längs vägen.
   

  

 👉 Läs mer om hur vi bygger vår plattform: Engineering@intility
   

  

**Vi söker dig som**
* avslutar en masterexamen inom IT, teknik, ingenjörsvetenskap eller andra relevanta ämnesområden 2027
* lär dig nya teknologier snabbt och gillar att förstå hur saker faktiskt fungerar
* blir motiverad när du möter problem du inte omedelbart vet hur du ska lösa
* gillar att bygga, automatisera och förbättra, och bryr dig om kvaliteten på det som sätts i produktion
* tar ägarskap, delar kunskap och gör människorna runt dig bättre
* kommunicerar bra på ett skandinaviskt språk och engelska


**Hos oss får du**
* arbeta hands-on med teknik som används av hundratals verksamheter varje dag
* verkliga tekniska problemställningar tidigt, med kompetenta kollegor som stöd
* utveckla både bred förståelse för plattformen och djup inom ditt eget område
* en ung och ambitiös teknikmiljö med god kunskapsdelning
* möjlighet att växa in i nya tekniska roller och större ansvar


 På Intility är vi måna om att alla anställda ska trivas på jobbet och tillsammans med sina kollegor. Vi erbjuder därför olika sociala och kompetensutvecklande arrangemang under hela året. Du får även tillgång till Intilitys lägenheter på Norefjell Ski och Spa Resort, som kan besökas tillsammans med såväl kollegor, som familj och vänner. Dessutom finns möjlighet att nyttja våra företagsstugor i Kragerø.
   

  

 Som anställd i Sverige får du även tillgång till frukost, lunchförmån och friskvårdsbidrag.
   

  

 Även om du blir en av de första som startar på kontoret i Stockholm kommer du alltid jobba nära många av dina 700 kollegor i Oslo. Utöver att vi kontinuerligt underlättar för och önskar att du besöker vårt kontor i Oslo, kommer den första delen av din upplärning att ske i Oslo över en period på ca. 6 månader. Intility står då för resekostnader och boende. Uppstartsdatumet är flexibelt och vi tar gärna emot kandidater som antingen har möjlighet att starta redan nu eller senare.
   

  

**Verkar det här som en plats för dig?** 
 Skicka in ansökan, CV och betygsutdrag från gymnasiet och högre utbildning.
   

  

**Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig.**
 Intility er en digital grunnmur og teknologiplattform som benyttes av mer enn 700 virksomheter. Vi er over 700 medarbeidere, med en snittalder på rundt 30 år, som sammen jobber for å bygge Europas ledende teknologiplattform. 🌍
   

  

 I Intility blir du del av et ungt og dynamisk arbeidsmiljø, og du er omgitt av gode kollegaer som ønsker å dele sin kunnskap med deg. For oss spiller det ingen rolle hvor du kommer fra, hvor du gikk på skole eller hvilken bransje du er i – vi er alltid på utkikk etter flinke folk. Er du hardtarbeidende, initiativrik og en god lagspiller? Bli med oss på laget for å bygge og utvikle teknologiske løsninger som betyr noe 👊

title: Automationsingenjör
description:
Vill du arbeta med automation i en varierad roll där programmering kombineras med praktiskt arbete och teknisk problemlösning? Här får du möjlighet att arbeta med flera delar av kedjan, från programmering och konfigurering till test, felsökning och driftsättning.
 



  





**Om tjänsten:** 




 Som automationsingenjör får du en bred teknisk roll där PLC- och DUC-programmering står i centrum. Du arbetar med att utveckla, konfigurera och anpassa automationslösningar och får följa arbetet hela vägen från programmering och konfigurering till en fungerande lösning ute i verksamheten.
 



  





 Rollen passar dig som uppskattar variation och vill arbeta nära både tekniken och de miljöer där lösningarna används. Du får möjlighet att lösa tekniska utmaningar, vidareutveckla befintliga system och se det konkreta resultatet av ditt arbete.
 



  





 I rollen kan du även komma att arbeta med:
 


* Testning, felsökning och driftsättning
* SCADA och andra system för styrning och övervakning
* Teknisk dokumentation och uppföljning
* Samarbete med kunder, projektledare och andra tekniska kompetenser



 Arbetsuppgifterna varierar mellan olika projekt och kan anpassas efter din erfarenhet och kompetens. Du behöver därför inte ha arbetat med samtliga delar tidigare.
 



  





**Vi söker dig som:** 




 Har erfarenhet av PLC- eller DUC-programmering, exempelvis i Schneider, Beckhoff, SAIA, Larmia eller motsvarande system. Du behöver inte ha arbetat med något särskilt fabrikat. Det viktiga är att du har programmerat styrsystem och vill fortsätta utvecklas inom automation.
 



 Du kan ha en teknisk utbildning inom exempelvis automation, styr- och reglerteknik, el, energi eller fastighetsteknik. Du kan även ha skaffat dig motsvarande kunskaper genom arbetslivet.
 



  





 Det är meriterande, men inget krav, om du har erfarenhet av något av följande:
 


* Testning, felsökning eller driftsättning
* SCADA eller andra system för styrning och övervakning
* El, VVS eller tekniska installationer
* IT, kommunikation eller nätverk



  





 Som person är du nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och ansvarstagande. Du tycker om att samarbeta och utbyta kunskap med andra, samtidigt som du är bekväm med att självständigt driva dina arbetsuppgifter framåt. Framför allt motiveras du av att lösa tekniska problem och skapa automationslösningar som fungerar i praktiken.
 



  





**Övrig information:** 



* Omfattning: Heltid
* Start: Enligt överenskommelse
* Placering: Stockholm
* Rekryteringsansvarig: Maja Dahlin, maja.dahlin@friday.se
* Lön: Fast månadslön



  





 Ansök genom att klicka på länken nedan. Urval sker löpande och annonsen kan komma att stängas innan tjänsten är tillsatt, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.
 



  





**Om Friday:** 




 På Friday brinner vi för att ge dig som Tech-talang en riktigt bra start på karriären. Genom att lyssna på vad just du vill och drivs av matchar vi dig med företag och möjligheter som får dig att se fram emot att gå till jobbet.
 



  





 Vi värderar ambition och potential högt och arbetar aktivt för en fördomsfri rekrytering där alla ges samma möjlighet att lyckas.
 



  





 Vi finns i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Linköping och Örebro. Varje år genomför vi över 5 000 karriärmöten och matchar kandidater med allt från globala företag till innovativa startups.
 



  





 Sökord: Automationsingenjör, Automationstekniker, PLC-programmerare, DUC-programmerare, Styr- och reglertekniker, Fastighetsautomation, PLC, DUC, SCADA, Driftsättning, Schneider Electric, Beckhoff, SAIA, Larmia, Styrsystem, Serviceingenjör automation, Driftingenjör, El- och automationsingenjör, Building Automation Engineer, Control Systems Engineer, BMS Engineer, HVAC automation, Siemens PLC, Regin, Citect, EcoStruxure.

description:

 Coding Scrum Master - Java Development Team
   

  

 Vill du arbeta i ett globalt företag och bidra till en mer hållbar livsmedelsproduktion? DeLaval är en ledande utvecklare, tillverkare och leverantör av lösningar för mjölkproducenter världen över. title: Application Security Engineer
description:
**Join our highly skilled team — breaking new ground and shaping the future of retail. We dare to dream big, we have the courage to keep raising the bar, and we're committed to being a force for good in retail—helping both established and fast-growing brands meet the ever-changing expectations of their customers.** 




  





**Sitoo is a fast-growing technology company exploring how far we can take innovation to deliver the world's best Unified Commerce Platform and Point of Sale. Our technology is used in more than 20 countries—a number that keeps growing thanks to our incredible team. And we have no intention of slowing down. Are you the Application Security Engineer we're looking for?** 




  





**Your mission at Sitoo** 




  





 As a Application Security Engineer at Sitoo, you will work closely with our CISO, Senior Security Engineer, and engineering teams to support the secure development side of our platform. You will play a vital, hands-on role in securing our application code, repositories, and dependencies. You will take direct ownership of our application-level vulnerability backlog across our GitHub repositories, ensuring code fixes are triaged, released, and compliant with our SOC 2 SLA targets. By pairing a passion for security with an eagerness to learn, you will help triage findings, maintain CI/CD security gates, and empower our developers to safely leverage AI-assisted coding tools.
 



  





**What you will do** 




  




* Actively track, prioritize, and remediate application and dependency vulnerabilities (Dependabot, Aikido) across ~184 active GitHub repositories to hit strict SOC 2 SLA targets.
* Assist development teams with code-level security updates across npm, pnpm, Go, Ruby, Python, Dockerfiles, and GitHub Actions.
* Help investigate and resolve breaking dependency upgrades, CI failures, and build issues caused by security updates.
* Track merged security fixes through the release lifecycle to ensure they are successfully deployed and validated in production.
* Contribute to improving repository-level security workflows, automated scanning, and CI/CD security gates.
* Learn, help define, and monitor security guardrails for the safe use of AI-assisted development tools in product engineering.
* Collaborate closely with our Senior Cloud & Infrastructure Security Engineer to escalate complex code or architectural risks while continuously growing your technical security expertise.



  





**What you'll bring to the table**

* Basic understanding of version control (GitHub), repository management, and CI/CD pipelines.
* A proactive, problem-solving mindset with a genuine enthusiasm for clearing security technical debt and learning modern AppSec practices.
* Interest in AI-assisted development and a basic awareness of AI-related code security risks (e.g., hallucinated packages, unsafe generated patterns).
* Confident, clear communication skills to collaborate effectively across development teams and foster a culture of shared security ownership.
* Professional English, both verbal and written.

We believe in an inclusive culture where everyone feels a sense of belonging. We support each other, we win together, we celebrate success together, and we overcome challenges together.

**The Good Stuff** 




  





 We care just as much about our team as we do about pushing the boundaries of retail. To make sure you have the support, balance, and energy to thrive, both in and out of the office, here is glimpse of what you get when you join us:
 


* 30 days vacation

* And more!

title: Data Architect - Finance
description:
**Company Description** 




 Sure Thing AB is a Swedish company providing effective, results-oriented services in Financial Services and senior IT consulting since 2020. The organization has strong expertise in banking, finance, and e-commerce, working closely with clients to deliver robust, data-driven solutions. Sure Thing AB is currently expanding into e-commerce product development, offering opportunities to shape new digital products and services. The company is also actively seeking mutually beneficial partnerships, creating an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and long-term growth for both clients and team members.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 The Data Architect – Finance is a full-time hybrid role based in Stockholm, with flexibility for part-time work from home.
 



 This role is responsible for designing and maintaining the data architecture for financial and e-commerce domains, ensuring data structures support reporting, analytics, and regulatory requirements.
 



 Day-to-day tasks include defining data models, establishing data governance standards, collaborating with engineering teams on ETL and data warehousing solutions, and optimizing data flows across systems.
 



 The Data Architect – Finance will work closely with stakeholders in finance, risk, and product teams to translate business needs into scalable data designs and support strategic decision-making.
 



 The role also involves documenting data frameworks, guiding best practices, and contributing to continuous improvement of the data platform.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong skills in Data Architecture and Data Modeling, particularly in financial services and related domains.
* Candidates should possess skills in Data Governance, including establishing policies, standards, and controls for data quality, security, and compliance.
* Candidates should possess skills in Extract Transform Load (ETL) processes and Data Warehousing, including designing pipelines and optimizing data storage for analytics.
* Experience with relational and cloud-based databases, data integration tools, and BI/analytics platforms is highly beneficial.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to translate complex business requirements into technical data solutions.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills, with experience working across finance, IT, and product teams in a hybrid work environment.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience in banking, finance, or e-commerce data environments, including regulatory and risk data, is a significant advantage.
