title: UX/UI designer, WeTransfer
description:
WeTransfer helps millions of users share ideas and collaborate seamlessly. Now part of Bending Spoons, it plays a key role in a portfolio of outstanding digital businesses united by a shared focus on innovation and operational excellence. By applying through the WeTransfer brand, you’ll be stepping into the wider Bending Spoons team. You may work directly on WeTransfer or contribute to one of our other leading products. Either way, you’ll be part of a high-performing, collaborative environment where you can make a real impact.
   

  

 At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.
   

  

 To achieve this objective, we execute the following strategy: We acquire a digital business with untapped potential and make it as successful as we can by leveraging our platform—which comprises our expertise, technologies, data, brand, talents, and company culture. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we operate so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other. Then, we invest the proceeds into making our platform more powerful, and into acquiring new businesses. Thus, our strategy sees us combine an investor’s attention to capital allocation with the hands-on approach of an operator.
   

  

 For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.
   

  

**A few examples of your responsibilities** 
* **Shape high-leverage product experiences.** 
 Design exceptional UI and UX—from early concepts to polished delivery—using the best available tools to explore more directions, move faster, and raise the quality bar. Ensure every experience is intuitive, effective, and delightful.
* **Start with an LLM.** 
 Use AI tools to clarify intent, draft short specs, and surface risks, edge cases, and initial approaches before opening any design tool. Use this work to align quickly with your team and compress the time from ambiguity to direction.
* **Prototype and build with AI.** 
 Use Cursor and Claude Code to turn rough concepts into interactive prototypes and generate production-ready frontend code. You know when to reach for code and when to reach for Figma—and you move fluidly between both to get the best result.
* **Co-create with PMs and engineers from day one.** 
 Define UX requirements early, stay in the build through QA and release, and make engineering-aware design decisions.
* **Validate and measure.** 
 Talk directly with customers, run quick tests, and use what you learn to adjust direction. Track funnels, retention, and adoption to assess design effectiveness and sharpen what ships next.
* **Find the highest-leverage bets from the backlog.** 
 Identify where product improvements can unlock business value, align stakeholders around them, and move fast to deliver.


**What we look for** 
* **Reasoning ability.** 
 Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.
* **Drive.** 
 You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.
* **Team spirit.** 
 You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.
* **Proficiency in English.** 
 You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.


**What we offer** 
* **Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams.** 
 You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
* **An exceptional opportunity for growth.** 
 We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.
* **Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount.** 
 Typically, we offer individuals with limited experience an annual salary of £85,797 in London and €66,065 elsewhere in Europe. For a candidate that we assess as possessing considerable relevant experience, the salary on offer tends to be between £112,189 and £250,512 in London, and €107,837 and €188,848 elsewhere in Europe. Compensation varies by location and expected impact, and grows rapidly as you gain experience and translate it into greater contributions. For individuals who demonstrate exceptional capability, we may offer compensation that extends beyond the usual ranges to reflect their higher expected impact. If you're offered a permanent contract, you'll also be able to receive some of your pay in company equity at a discounted price, thus participating in the value creation we achieve together. If relocating to Italy, you may enjoy a 50% tax cut.
* **All. These. Benefits.** 
 Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.


**Commitment & contract**
 Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time.
   

  

**Location**
 Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland), or fully remote from eligible countries.
   

  

**The selection process**
 In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.
   

  

 Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.
   

  

 All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.
   

  

 We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.
   

  

 We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.
   

  

**Before you apply**
 If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.
   

  

 Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.
   

  

 To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.
   

  

 If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

title: UX/UI designer
description:
**Jobbeskrivning**
 Vill du vara med och skapa digitala tjänster som gör verklig skillnad för människor, verksamheter och samhället? På Sopra Steria får du möjligheten att kombinera strategi, användarinsikter och design för att utveckla lösningar som inte bara fungerar – utan också skapar värde för användare och verksamheter.
   

  

 Vi söker nu en bred UX/UI Designer som vill bli en del av vårt designteam. Här får du arbeta i spännande kundprojekt tillsammans med engagerade kollegor och kunder från hela Sverige, i en miljö som präglas av samarbete, innovation och kunskapsdelning.
   

  

 Som
 **UX/UI Designer** 
 på Sopra Steria kommer du att arbeta med design i olika typer av digitala utvecklingsprojekt. Du kommer att vara en viktig del av tvärfunktionella team där du samarbetar nära utvecklare, produktägare, verksamhetsexperter och andra intressenter för att skapa lösningar som möter både användarnas behov och verksamhetens mål.
   

  

 Rollen är bred och varierad, där du arbetar genom hela designprocessen – från research och analys till konceptutveckling, interaktionsdesign och visuellt gränssnitt. Du genomför användarstudier, identifierar behov och omvandlar insikter till värdeskapande lösningar som visualiseras genom användarflöden, wireframes och interaktiva prototyper.
   

  

 Du kommer även att bidra med kunskapsdelning både i kunduppdrag och internt inom organisationen.
   

  

**Teamet**
 Du kommer att tillhöra vårt designteam Sopra Steria EGGS som består av heltäckande kompetens inom design med både research, strategi, UX/UI och tillgänglighet.
   

  

 Sopra Steria är en internationell partner inom IT, management och design, med en tjänsteportfölj som täcker allt kunden behöver för att lyckas i en digital värld. Som en del av Sopra Steria Sveriges designkompetens kommer du även att få ta del av kunskapsutbyte från den internationella designförmågan som består av ca 400 designers som jobbar med digital design, innovation, business design, service design, UX/UI och tillgänglighet.
   

  

**Om dig**
 Vi söker dig som är nyfiken, kommunikativ och brinner för att skapa användarcentrerade digitala upplevelser. Du trivs i konsultrollen, uppskattar variation i dina uppdrag och känner dig bekväm med att samarbeta med människor med olika perspektiv och kompetenser.
   

  

 Du är trygg i att presentera och argumentera för dina designlösningar och har förmågan att balansera användarbehov, verksamhetsmål och tekniska förutsättningar. Samtidigt är du prestigelös, lyhörd och gillar att arbeta tillsammans med andra för att nå bästa möjliga resultat.
   

  

**Kompetens och erfarenhet**
* Cirka 4–7 års erfarenhet med bred kompetens inom UX/UI och servicedesign
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta genom hela designprocessen, från research och strategi till UX/UI-design
* Väl förtrogen med att använda AI i ditt arbete som designer och driven i att kontinuerligt utvecklas inom området
* Tidigare erfarenhet som konsult
* God vana av att facilitera workshops med kunder och intressenter
* Kunskap inom tillgänglighet
* Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga och vana att presentera och argumentera för designbeslut
* Flytande kunskaper i svenska och engelska
* Erfarenhet av design för mobila applikationer är meriterande


**Varför välja Sopra Steria?**
**En plats där din kompetens verkligen gör skillnad** 
 – Vi bygger smarta och hållbara lösningar som förbättrar samhälle och verksamheter med användarupplevelsen i centrum.
   

  

**Stark företagskultur med Power of Sharing** 
 – Vi tror på kraften i kunskapsdelning, transparens och samarbete. Hos oss når vi längre tillsammans.
   

  

**Toppbetyg som arbetsplats** 
 – Great Place to Work har rankat oss som en av Sveriges bästa arbetsplatser flera år i rad, och vi har även utsetts till Karriärföretag vid upprepade tillfällen.
   

  

**Del av en europeisk ledare inom digital transformation** 
 – Med över 50 000 experter världen över erbjuder vi både spännande projekt och goda möjligheter till utveckling.
   

  

**Del av en stark Europeisk designmiljö** 
 – Som designer på Sopra Steria EGGS blir du en del av ett stort nätverk av designers, innovatörer och specialister som tillsammans driver utvecklingen framåt.
   

  

**Ansökan**
 Om du känner att detta kan vara rätt för dig, klicka på "Ansök nu" och skicka in ditt CV. Vi ser fram emot att lära känna dig och höra mer om din erfarenhet och passion för design.
   

  

 Rekryteringsprocessen består av personlighet- och logiktest via Alva Labs, tre intervjuer, arbetsprov, referenser och bakgrundskontroll.
   

  

 På Sopra Steria ställer vi höga krav på både kompetens och säkerhetsmedvetenhet hos våra medarbetare. Innan en eventuell anställning kommer du därför att genomgå en bakgrundskontroll, och vid intervju behöver du kunna uppvisa giltig legitimation.
   

  

 Vid frågor är du välkommen att kontakta vår talent acquisition partner Viktoria Roosvald, viktoria.roosvald@soprasteria.com

title: Senior Designer
description:
**We are looking for a Senior Designer specializing in digital products and experiences. The ideal candidate combines strong conceptual thinking and creative direction with excellent digital craft.** 




  





 You know how to translate brand ideas into distinctive and intuitive digital experiences, demonstrate strong attention to detail and communicate ideas clearly and systematically.
 



  





 You are proactive, autonomous and comfortable setting a clear creative direction, while collaborating effectively with designers, strategists, developers and project leads.
 



  





 This role is Stockholm-based.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* Turn complex challenges into clear concepts and compelling digital products and experiences.
* Establish and communicate a strong design direction throughout a project.
* Work from early exploration and rapid prototyping through to detailed UI design and delivery.
* Design and evolve digital brand expressions and scalable design systems.
* Create prototypes ranging from quick concept tests to polished interaction demos.
* Bring clarity to visual hierarchy, interaction and the overall user experience.
* Take ownership of the design process by identifying what a project needs and creating the right conditions for great work.
* Present ideas, design rationale and decisions with clarity and confidence.
* Guide and activate other designers, helping teams move forward while raising the quality and ambition of the work.
* Collaborate closely with strategists, designers and developers from early thinking to implementation.
* Use emerging tools and technologies to explore possibilities, accelerate ideas and rethink how digital experiences can be made.
* Contribute to a generous, constructive feedback culture in which both the work and the people around it can develop.



  





  





**What you’ll bring** 




 You’re a senior digital designer with a distinctive point of view and a portfolio that shows both strong thinking and exceptional craft. You care about the details, but never lose sight of the bigger idea or the people you’re designing for.
 



  





 You’re curious, open and generous in how you work. You enjoy sharing early ideas, inviting different perspectives and giving thoughtful feedback. You’re equally comfortable challenging a direction and changing your mind when someone else has a better idea.
 



  





 You thrive in collaborative, multidisciplinary teams and bring clarity and momentum when the way forward is not yet obvious. Most importantly, you love making things.
 



  





**What you can look forward to** 




 A variety of projects for some of the most exciting brands and organisations across the Nordics. You’ll be part of multidisciplinary teams with deep expertise in design, technology and strategy—alongside some of the kindest and most talented people in our field.
 



  





 We want you to keep learning, to experiment and grow, and provide an annual education budget to support your development, alongside other benefits such as wellness allowance, pension etc.
 



  





 Doing brave things, boosting each other and making things happened lies at the core of our culture, and we want you to contribute actively and help shape how we collaborate as a team—all within a creative and welcoming studio environment.
 



  





*Interested?* 




*Email us at careers@doberman.co with the subject line "Senior Designer" and include a portfolio that demonstrates strong thinking, distinctive work and excellent digital craft.* 




  





*Note that a background check will be conducted as part of the recruitment process.*

title: Design Director
description:
**Are you passionate about creating exceptional user experiences while inspiring a talented creative team to thrive?**
 We are looking for a
 **Design Director** 
 who balances strategic design vision with empowering team management and a pragmatic, execution-focused mindset. We have a bold ambition to be the undisputed #1 service in the eyes of our consumers. To get there, we need a leader who has successfully built and elevated design practices before—someone who knows what "great" looks like, both in the final user experience and in the best-in-class ways of working that get us there.
   

  

 You will play a fundamental role in translating our consumer-centric strategy and ambition into world-class design execution that drives real user, business, and brand impact.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 As the Design Director at Instabee, your mission is to embed user-centricity into our cross-functional initiatives and workflows, implement insights-driven design practices, and lead and develop our team of product and brand designers. You will collaborate closely with colleagues and stakeholders in strategy, product, analytics, tech, and operations. Together with your peers in Consumer, you will establish consumer ambassadorship and center of excellence - ensuring the consumer experience is top-of-mind in everything we do.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Fall Into Three Key Pillars**
* Drive Design Strategy & Transformation
* Develop and continuously hone the design practices at Instabee to achieve our high consumer experience ambitions, desired brand position, user-centricity, efficiency, and business outcomes.
* Champion the end-to-end user perspective across all development phases, from discovery and design execution to post-launch optimization.
* Demonstrate the value of great design for our user experience and business goals, building trust, credibility and the strong internal relationships needed to give design a strong voice in company decisions.
* Ensure our design organization stays on the forefront of the craft: exploring and putting emerging methodologies and technologies into practice.
* Lead and Empower the Design Team
* Recruit, coach, develop, and lead a high-performing, multidisciplinary team of product and brand designers working with teams and stakeholders across the organization.
* Oversee brand and product design for Growth, Operations, Markets, and other key teams. Translate strategic business objectives and priorities into clear design strategy, adapting resources and capabilities to effectively support the organization and focus where it matters most.
* Champion high standards for design execution. Ensure design output is cohesive, high-quality, and clearly connected to user and business goals.
* Deliver Senior Design Excellence
* Keep one foot in the craft, driving own high-impact product and UX/UI design work - leading by example and showcasing best practices.
* Raise the bar for design and design processes across digital, physical and human interactions, ensuring we deliver "brilliant basics" enhanced by targeted signature “wow moments” that differentiate us.
* Act as a strong facilitator bringing cross-functional experts together to solve complex consumer challenges and drive user-centric innovation.


**Your Profile**
* 8+ years of experience in senior consumer-focused design or product UX/UI roles within a fast-paced service, product, or tech environment.
* A proven track record of design execution that drives clear user, business, and brand impact.
* Solid experience building, leading and elevating multidisciplinary design teams. Skilled at unlocking the potential of different individuals and design disciplines.
* A working-leader mindset, with a passion for keeping your own senior design craft sharp and a desire to lead by example.
* Strong change management capabilities, with a history of successfully integrating design best practices into cross-functional work and influencing without formal ownership.
* A systems-thinking approach, allowing you to see the full customer journey across touchpoints while seamlessly moving between high-level strategic alignment and hands-on operational details.
* Great communication, facilitation and leadership skills, enabling you to build trust, inspire teams, and confidently navigate complex cross-organizational environments as a strong voice for the consumer and the business value of design.


**What You’ll Get**
 We can promise you that you will be challenged, develop your skills and have the opportunity to work with truly amazing and competent colleagues. If you like changes and want to set new processes and ways of working - this is the place for you!
   

  

**Benefits**
 Of course, we have all the necessary and standard benefits in place, but in addition to this, we can also offer:
   

  

* Sky-High Office: Modern and newly renovated with a 360-degree view around Stockholm.
* Puppy Friendly: Bring your dog to work - we've got a whole floor for our furry friends!
* Fun & Games: Ping pong, Shuffleboard, Foosball, and even a Karaoke Room for your leisure time.
* Parental Pay for Six Months: Step away from work and provide the best care and love to your little one.
* A Day Off on Your Birthday: We love to celebrate, so enjoy your birthday to the fullest with a day off each year!
* Hybrid setup and flexible working hours


**Get to know us**
 In 2022, Instabee was founded after combining Budbee and Instabox - two leading last-mile delivery companies with three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy. Instabee serves millions of consumers across Europe with convenient deliveries and is on track to become the leading European e-commerce enabler. Always with the consumer at heart.
   

  

 We’re fast, both in terms of parcel delivery and when it comes to growing our business. So far our journey has taken us from Sweden to the rest of Scandinavia and parts of continental Europe, but we have no plans on stopping anytime soon. As we continue to expand, the complexity of Instabee grows in parallel. With that in mind, we’re now looking for you to help us on the journey ahead.
   

  

*This recruitment process consists of background checks via Svensk Bakgrundsanalys as a review of previous public criminal records. The result is public information that is handled confidentially. This is mandatory for all recruitment processes at Instabee in Sweden.*
 Instabee Group, with consumer-facing brands Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy, brings together years of experience in delivery. Today, Instabee Group is present in five markets, serving thousands of online merchants and millions of consumers with seamless home deliveries and convenient parcel locker deliveries, using the best fuel available. With smart technology, a strong focus on sustainability, and a secure supply chain, Instabee has become a trusted partner for online merchants and a preferred choice for consumers.

title: Senior UI Artist | New Games
description:
**Craft:**
**Job Description:**
 We are looking for a
 **Senior UI Artist** 
 to help shape and produce the visual interface for our a new IP centred mobile game
   

  

 This role sits between Art Direction, Game Design, UX, and Tech. Your goal is to create clear, polished, playful, and production-ready UI assets that support the game experience and match the project’s cute, quirky, and high-quality visual tone.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has strong graphic design foundations, excellent iconography and illustration skills, and a good understanding of how UI is implemented in Unity. Knowledge of 3D workflows is important, and Blender experience is a plus.
   

  

 Your role within the Kingdom
   

  

* Design and produce high-quality UI assets for mobile gameplay, menus, HUDs, events, and live features.
* Create clear, readable, and polished icons, buttons, panels, badges, frames, and interface elements.
* Develop illustrative UI elements that support the game’s visual identity.
* Work from wireframes, UX flows, and art direction to create final UI visuals.
* Maintain consistency across UI screens, systems, and feature updates.
* Prepare assets for Unity implementation with correct formats, naming, slicing, and optimization.
* Support the creation of UI style guides, templates, and documentation.
* Collaborate with UX, Design, Tech, and Art Direction to ensure UI is beautiful, functional, and production-ready.
* Review in-game implementation and help polish final results.
* Contribute ideas to improve readability, usability, and visual quality.


 Collaboration and Integration
   

  

* Work closely with Art Direction to maintain the project’s visual style.
* Collaborate with Game Designers and UX Designers to support clear player flows.
* Work with Unity developers to ensure UI assets integrate correctly.
* Coordinate with 2D, 3D, VFX, and animation teams when UI requires cross-discipline support.
* Communicate clearly with internal teams and respond well to feedback.
* Support production priorities while keeping a strong eye on quality and consistency.


 Skills to create thrills
   

  

* Strong portfolio showing high-quality UI art for games or mobile products.
* Excellent iconography skills with strong readability at small sizes.
* Strong illustration skills, especially for stylized, playful, or polished game visuals.
* Solid understanding of layout, composition, typography, color, hierarchy, and visual clarity.
* Experience with Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, or equivalent tools.
* Experience creating UI assets for Unity.
* Good knowledge of 3D principles and how 3D assets can support UI presentation.
* Ability to prepare clean, optimized, implementation-ready assets.
* Good understanding of mobile UI constraints and readability.
* Experience working with art direction and established visual styles.
* Strong communication skills and ability to take feedback constructively.
* Good sense of polish, consistency, and quality control.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working on casual, mobile, or family-friendly games.
* Experience with Blender.
* Experience creating UI mockups, style guides, and asset libraries.
* Knowledge of UI animation or motion design.
* Comfort working with both 2D and 3D pipelines.
* Experience supporting live game features, events, or seasonal content.


 What We Offer
   

  

* The opportunity to help shape the UI visual quality of a major global IP on mobile.
* A collaborative art team focused on craft, clarity, and polish.
* The chance to contribute to a playful and highly visible game experience.
* A healthy work culture that values trust, ownership, and teamwork.


 Success in this role means UI assets are clear, beautiful, consistent with the art direction, and smoothly integrated into the game.
   

  

**About King**
 With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

title: Content Designer (Contract)
description:
**TL;DR** 
 — We're looking for a contract Content Designer who can write both inside the product and across the website. You'll own the words in onboarding, empty states, and error messaging, and partner with PMM and our external design partner on the copy and structure of lovable.dev. This is a full-time engagement.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we're just getting started.
   

  

 We're building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME's 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe's fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
* 5+ years in content design or UX writing, with a portfolio that shows work on both sides: copy shipped inside a product, and marketing pages you wrote or restructured
* Real in-product examples. Onboarding flows, empty states, error messaging, upgrade moments - the words people hit when something is confusing or has gone wrong. Tell us what changed as a result
* Real web examples. Pages where the copy carries the argument, not just the headline.
* The ability to look at an already-designed page and say precisely where the message gets lost on a skim, then rewrite it
* A clear point of view on voice. You can describe a brand's voice and point to copy where you delivered a message in it
* Comfort working at the pace of a design team that ships daily, in Figma, alongside product designers and PMs rather than downstream of them
* Comfort partnering with an external design agency as well as internal marketing and design stakeholders
* Genuine full-time capacity for the length of the contract. We move fast and this needs to be your primary focus
* Ideally - content strategy chops. Strategy and SEO aren't the core scope here, but the instincts show up in the work


**If you're strong on only one side of this, apply anyway.** 
 We know we're describing a rare combination. If you're exceptional at in-product writing and have never touched a marketing site, or you're a brilliant web writer who has never written an error message, we still want to see your work. Tell us which side you're great at and we'll take it from there.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 In one sentence: Make Lovable sound like one company, in the product and on the website.
   

  

* Own the copy in the moments that decide whether someone sticks: first run in the editor, empty states, failed and partial builds, upgrade and credit prompts
* Name things - features, surfaces, settings - so the product's own vocabulary holds together
* Write copy for new and refreshed marketing pages with PMM, making sure current GTM messaging is actually reflected on the site
* Work with our external design partner on content hierarchy, categorization, and the top-level navigation. You'll shape it with them rather than own it alone
* Diagnose and fix pages that are already designed but not landing, focusing on hierarchy, scannability, and messages that have to work fast
* Sit embedded with marketing and design, with full context on how messaging decisions get made across the business


**How We Hire**
* Fill in a short form then jump on an intro call with a recruiter.
* Send us two pieces of work: ideally one from inside a product and one from the web, or two from whichever side you're strongest on.
* Walk us through your process and craft in a small number of interviews with the marketing and design team.
* In some cases, we may opt to do paid, trial work.


**About Your Application**
* Please submit your application in English - it's our company language so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join
* We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested please apply through our careers portal


**Ready to join us?**
 Help us unlock human creativity and build the future of software creation.

title: Product Experience Specialist (Part Time)
description:
**TL;DR**
 Want to work at one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies while studying?
   

  

 We’re looking for curious, ambitious
 **Students** 
 to join Lovable part-time and work directly with our users and product. You’ll become an expert in Lovable, solve real problems for people building software, spot patterns in what isn’t working, and turn what you learn into improvements to the product and how we operate.
   

  

 This is a 3-month contract with a potential 12-month extension and expanded responsibilities, on a part-time basis, based in Lund, Stockholm, or remotely in Sweden.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For**
* A driver, not a passenger: You spot problems before they're pointed out, come up with improvements on your own initiative, and follow through.
* Analytical problem solver: You break down complex situations systematically and move fast to get users unblocked even if it is something we haven’t seen before. You see opportunities where others see obstacles.
* Curious: You test ideas, try new approaches, and aren't afraid to get it wrong the first time. You're naturally drawn to AI tools and see the potential to get things done more efficiently.
* Crystal-clear communicator: Whether it's a user reply, a bug report, or an internal process doc, you communicate warmly and precisely.
* Bonus: Experience in B2C SaaS support using tools like Intercom.
* Bonus: Hands-on experience with Lovable, Claude and similar AI tools.


**What You’ll Do**
* Own user problems end to end: Become a Lovable expert to solve a wide range of issues with speed and clarity, and escalate effectively to engineering when needed.
* Improve our support stack: Keep our internal knowledge base up to date, design smarter workflows, and find ways to make the whole team operate better.
* Be the voice of the customer: Continuously feed product feedback into the team so that what you see on the front lines actually improves the product.
* Grow your scope: As you build trust and ownership, the role expands. Internally at Lovable and externally in how we engage with users and the community, there is real room to develop.


**The tech stack:**
 We run one of the most AI-native support operations anywhere, and we build much of it ourselves, on Lovable.
   

  

* AI-first ticketing: Intercom as system of record, with our AI agent (built on Parahelp) resolving the first line: it answers, troubleshoots, takes actions, e.g. executes refunds and credit grants with human approval. You handle what genuinely needs a human and you train and improve the AI as part of the job.
* Internal tools built on Lovable: our admin console (user, workspace, billing, domain, and credit operations), live metrics dashboards, and QA tooling are all Lovable apps, built and iterated by the team that uses them. You’ll ship improvements to your own tools and build new ones.
* An AI copilot that lives everywhere: Our investigation agent with access to our codebase, logs and relevant data troubleshoots issues and helps our team draft high quality replies. It lives in Slack, in Intercom & in your browser.
* Real engineering surfaces, you go deep when tickets demand it: Grafana, Temporal, Stripe, Supabase, Cloudflare, and DNS tooling.


**About Your Application**
 We welcome students from any field and candidates from all backgrounds. A technical or computer science background is a plus, but by no means required. Please apply through our application system in English as it is our company language.

title: Consumer Analyst
description:
Are you passionate about building true consumer preference—turning data and insights into real user and business impact?
   

  

 At Instabee, we are on a mission to become the undisputed #1 service in the eyes of our consumers. We are now looking for a Consumer Analyst to join our Consumer Department. In this role, you will play a fundamental part in building the analytical foundation and insights required to ensure our organization is aligned, informed, and accountable for delivering a superior consumer experience across all markets.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who combines strong analytical capabilities with business acumen and the ability to communicate findings clearly to diverse stakeholders.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As Consumer Analyst, you will translate complex data and consumer signals into clear, actionable insights that can drive strategic and tactical impact. Partnering with teams across Data & Analytics, Product, Design, Operations, Strategy and Market to understand challenges, synthesize insights from diverse sources, and co-create solutions grounded in consumer and business relevance.
   

  

 Your goal is to build a solid foundation for consumer, brand, and experience analytics, making insights accessible and actionable company-wide. Whether you are mapping the behavior of different consumer segments, uncovering what drives long-term retention, or tracking the impact of a new product feature, you will play a key role in guiding our journey toward becoming the undisputed #1 service in all our markets.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Manage the Consumer Scorecard: Define and evolve our core KPIs (NPS, User ratings, Brand preference, CSAT, MAU, Consumer base metrics, Operational metrics etc.) to ensure a trusted, single source of truth for our performance across the full consumer journey and lifecycle.
* Analyze Loyalty & Retention: Conduct cohort and retention analysis to identify the key drivers of consumer satisfaction and long-term loyalty. You’ll explore how different user segments behave and evolve, and translate user and service delivery insights into cross-functional guidance for the most effective ways to win, delight, and retain our consumers.
* Analyze Consumer Behavior: Dive deep into user behavior across web, app, communications and customer service channels. You will analyze funnels and identify drop-off points to provide concrete product and experience recommendations. This includes proactively identifying tracking gaps and defining what needs to be measured and how, to ensure decisions are grounded in reliable data.
* Translate Data into Action: Synthesize quantitative and qualitative data into concise, actionable insights. You will provide a holistic lens to ensure we deliver a seamless and superior experience across the entire consumer journey.
* Co-create Analytical Foundations: Partner with data and tech teams to ensure our data collection is high-quality, scalable, and reliable. You’ll help shape the tracking and data structures (e.g., GA4, BigQuery) required to turn digital behavior into trustworthy insights.
* Drive Performance Insights: Enable data-driven decision-making through forecasting, trend analysis, and the development of automated dashboards in Tableau, Steep or similar tools.
* Collaborative Problem Solving: Act as the consumer analytics partner for teams across Instabee, helping them move past the "what" to understand the "why" behind consumer behavior.
* Drive Experimentation: Design, run, and evaluate A/B tests—taking ownership from the initial hypothesis to the final conclusion and recommended next steps.


**Your profile**
 You are an analytical problem-solver with a natural drive to uncover patterns and understand exactly what drives consumer behavior and business performance. You are curious, proactive, and motivated by creating real-world results rather than theoretical perfection. You don't just provide data; you see it as your mission to provide the actionable insights that enable our teams to deliver a great consumer experience and our business to grow.
   

  

**Experience & Mindset**
* Analytical Experience: 4-5+ years of experience in consumer analytics, digital analytics or a related field - ideally within a fast-paced service or e-commerce environment.
* Commercial Curiosity: You have a strong business acumen and a natural drive to understand the "why" behind the numbers. You focus on what is relevant and actionable for the business, and proactively surface insights and opportunities.
* Problem Solver: Strong analytical and numerical skills with a business-oriented mindset. You excel at bringing structure to ambiguous problems and can navigate complex datasets to find the most impactful answers.
* Communication: You can translate complex analysis into sharp, actionable narratives for diverse stakeholders. You communicate insights clearly and confidently to stakeholders at all levels, from junior teams to senior leadership.
* Collaboration: Team player who enjoys working across Product, Tech, and Business teams to develop insights and build solutions together.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, IT, Statistics, Business, or other relevant field.


**Analytical toolkit**
* Consumer Analytics: Proven ability to synthesize various internal and external consumer data into holistic consumer analytics and insights.
* Digital Analytics: Experience with tools such as Amplitude, GA4, or similar behavioral tracking platforms.
* Data Foundations: Proficiency in SQL and Python or similar, and experience working with large datasets.
* Visualization: Ability to build and maintain clear dashboards and funnels that give our teams an ongoing view of consumer health (e.g., using Tableau, Power BI, or Steep).
* AI coding tools: Experience in using AI tools in your analytical work is an advantage.
* Experimentation: Hands-on experience designing, running, and evaluating A/B tests is an advantage.
* Tracking: Knowledge of digital tracking implementation and Google Tag Manager is an advantage.


**What You'll Get**
 We can promise you that you will be challenged, develop your skills and have the opportunity to work with truly amazing and competent colleagues. If you like changes and want to set new processes and ways of working - this is the place for you!
   

  

**Benefits**
 Of course, we have all the necessary and standard benefits in place, but in addition to this, we can also offer:
   

  

* Sky-High Office: Modern and newly renovated with a 360-degree view around Stockholm.
* Puppy Friendly: Bring your dog to work - we've got a whole floor for our furry friends!
* Fun & Games: Ping pong, Shuffleboard, Foosball, and even a Karaoke Room for your leisure time.
* Parental Pay for Six Months: Step away from work and provide the best care and love to your little one.
* A Day Off on Your Birthday: We love to celebrate, so enjoy your birthday to the fullest with a day off each year!
* Hybrid setup and flexible working hours


**Get to know us**
 In 2022, Instabee was founded after combining Budbee and Instabox - two leading last-mile delivery companies with three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy. Instabee serves millions of consumers across Europe with convenient deliveries and is on track to become the leading European e-commerce enabler. Always with the consumer at heart.
   

  

 We’re fast, both in terms of parcel delivery and when it comes to growing our business. So far our journey has taken us from Sweden to the rest of Scandinavia and parts of continental Europe, but we have no plans on stopping anytime soon. As we continue to expand, the complexity of Instabee grows in parallel. With that in mind, we’re now looking for you to help us on the journey ahead.
   

  

*This recruitment process consists of background checks via Svensk Bakgrundsanalys as a review of previous public criminal records. The result is public information that is handled confidentially. This is mandatory for all recruitment processes at Instabee in Sweden.*
 Instabee Group, with consumer-facing brands Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy, brings together years of experience in delivery. Today, Instabee Group is present in five markets, serving thousands of online merchants and millions of consumers with seamless home deliveries and convenient parcel locker deliveries, using the best fuel available. With smart technology, a strong focus on sustainability, and a secure supply chain, Instabee has become a trusted partner for online merchants and a preferred choice for consumers.

title: CXM Strategist/Strategy Consultant
description:
**Job Description:**
**Strategy Consultant – Merkle Sweden, a Dentsu Company**
**Om rollen**
 Vi söker nu en Strategy Consultant som vill vara med och hjälpa våra kunder att skapa tillväxt genom kundcentrerade strategier och arbetssätt
   

  

 I den här rollen blir du en del av Merkle Sveriges Strategy & Consulting-team, där du arbetar nära kunder och kollegor inom flera specialistområden för att lösa komplexa affärs- och kundutmaningar. Du kommer att hjälpa några av Nordens ledande företag att omsätta kundinsikter, data och ny teknik till strategiska initiativ som skapar mätbart affärsvärde.
   

  

 Du kommer att arbeta med frågeställningar som:
   

  

* Hur kan kunddata och CRM användas för att skapa tillväxt?
* Hur bör organisationer använda AI för att förbättra kundupplevelsen och stärka sin konkurrenskraft?
* Hur skapar vi mer relevanta och personaliserade kundupplevelser genom hela kundresan?
* Hur bör teknik, arbetssätt och organisation utvecklas för att möta framtidens kundbehov?


 Rollen passar dig som har några års erfarenhet av strategi-, digitaliserings- eller transformationsarbete och som trivs i gränslandet mellan affär, kundupplevelse, data och teknik. Du motiveras av att hjälpa kunder att förstå komplexa utmaningar, identifiera möjligheter och omsätta insikter till rekommendationer som driver tillväxt och förändring.
   

  

 Hos Merkle får du möjlighet att arbeta med några av Nordens mest spännande företag samtidigt som du blir en del av dentsus globala nätverk. Merkle är en ledande aktör inom datadriven kundupplevelsehantering (Customer Experience Management, CXM) och hjälper världens främsta varumärken att skapa unika och personliga kundupplevelser över olika kanaler.
   

  

 Vi erbjuder expertis inom digital analys, strategi och rådgivning inom kundupplevelser, UX-design, CRM, datahantering, e-handel, innehållshanteringssystem (CMS), adtech och martech.
   

  

 Vi är en del av Merkle Worldwide och dentsu – ett globalt nätverk av byråer med verksamhet på 145 marknader världen över.
   

  

**Arbetsuppgifter**
 Som Strategy Consultant kommer du bland annat att:
   

  

* Arbeta med strategiska konsultuppdrag inom områden som CRM, Customer Experience, Account Based Marketing, AI, digital transformation och affärsutveckling.
* Utveckla strategier, rekommendationer och roadmaps som hjälper kunder att skapa tillväxt och förbättrade kundupplevelser.
* Omvandla komplex information till tydliga beslutsunderlag och presentationer.
* Rådgiva kunder kring hur data, teknik och nya arbetssätt kan användas för att skapa kund- och affärsvärde.
* Planera och facilitera workshops med kunder och tvärfunktionella team.
* Samarbeta nära specialister inom CRM, Data & Analytics, Experience Design, Martech och media för att utveckla integrerade lösningar.
* Bidra till kunskapsdelning och utvecklingen av Merkle som en ledande aktör inom kundupplevelse och transformation.
* Hålla dig uppdaterad om nya trender, innovationer och teknologier samt deras påverkan på affärsmodeller och kundupplevelser.


**Vi ser gärna att du har:**
* Några års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet inom strategi, digital kundupplevelse, consulting eller liknande områden.
* Akademisk examen inom företagsekonomi, management, marknadsföring eller annat relevant område. Högre examen är meriterande.
* Erfarenhet av ett eller flera av följande områden:
* CRM & Customer Strategy
* Customer Experience (CX)
* Customer Data & Personalisation
* AI & Digital Transformation
* Account Based Marketing (ABM)
* Martech & Adtech
* Operating Model & Ways of Working
* Erfarenhet från konsultverksamhet eller en liknande strategisk roll på kundsidan.
* Förmåga att koppla kundbehov till affärsmål och omsätta strategi till konkreta och genomförbara lösningar.
* Stark analytisk förmåga och erfarenhet av att strukturera komplexa problemställningar.
* Erfarenhet av att ta fram rekommendationer baserade på data, analys och insikter.
* God kommunikativ förmåga och vana att bidra i workshops, presentationer och kunddialoger.
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.


**Vi tror att du:**
* Är nyfiken på hur organisationer kan skapa tillväxt genom ett kundcentrerat arbetssätt.
* Trivs med att arbeta i gränslandet mellan affär, strategi och kundupplevelse.
* Är analytisk, strukturerad och lösningsorienterad.
* Har ett starkt intresse för hur AI förändrar företag, kundrelationer och affärsmodeller.
* Är analytisk, strukturerad och lösningsorienterad.
* Är en stark lagspelare som uppskattar samarbete och kunskapsdelning.
* Har lätt för att bygga förtroende och skapa goda relationer med kunder och kollegor.
* Är självgående och tar ansvar för att driva ditt arbete framåt.
* Vill fortsätta utvecklas som konsult och successivt ta ett större ansvar i kunduppdrag.


**Om Dentsu Sweden**
 Dentsu Sweden är en del i ett globalt kommunikationsnätverk med ca. 70 000 medarbetare i fler än 145 länder. Vi erbjuder våra medarbetare möjligheten att jobba med flera marknadsledande varumärken och spännande kunder. Våra samtliga svenska bolag är miljödiplomerade enligt Svensk Miljöbas och vi jobbar aktivt med vårt sociala och miljömässiga ansvarstagande som arbetsgivare och medmänniskor. Diversity, Equity & Inclusion är djupt förankrat i våra gemensamma värderingar – the 8 Ways to Never Before – och vårt Leadership Framework är applicerbart på alla våra medarbetare. Vi är stolta över det som gör oss unika som företag och individer och vi uppmuntrar sökande från alla olika typer av bakgrunder att söka sig till oss.
   

  

 Vi erbjuder bland annat:
   

  

* Kollektivavtal
* 5000 kr i friskvårdsbidrag
* 30 dagars semesterrätt
* Flexibilitet och den bästa möjliga mixen av två goda ting, att jobba på våra kontor och att jobba hemma
* Många karriär- och utvecklingsmöjligheter


**Ansökan och kontakt**
 Låter det här som något för dig? Om du kan se dig själv i rollen som Strategy Consultant och som en del av dentsu-nätverket, vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande med tänkt tillträde så snart som möjligt. Vi har både kontor i Stockholm och Göteborg och vi tar emot sökande till båda kontoren.
   

  

 Vid frågor, kontakta:
   

  

 Maria K. Cederbrand
   

  

 Senior Talent Acquisition Partner
   

  

 maria.cederbrand@dentsu.com
   

  

**Location:**
 Stockholm
   

  

**Brand:**
 Merkle
   

  

**Time Type:**
 Full time
   

  

**Contract Type:**
 Permanent

title: Kravanalytiker IT
description:
**Företagsbeskrivning**
 AFRY erbjuder tjänster inom teknik, design, digitalisering och rådgivning. Vi är dedikerade experter inom industri, energi och infrastruktur och skapar värde för kommande generationer. AFRY har nordiska rötter med global räckvidd. Våra gemensamma principer – Result driven, Client centric, Empowering och Accountable – vägleder oss i hur vi arbetar, utvecklas och lyckas tillsammans. Var med och accelerera övergången till ett hållbart samhälle.
   

  

**Jobbeskrivning**
 Vi söker nu en Kravanalytiker som vill vara med och skapa verklig förändring hos våra kunder inom bland annat offentlig sektor, energi och försvarsindustrin.
   

  

 I rollen ansvarar du för att fånga, analysera och dokumentera både funktionella och icke-funktionella krav genom exempelvis workshops, användarintervjuer, observationer och dokumentstudier. Du säkerställer att kraven är tydligt formulerade, utvecklingsbara och testbara samt bryter ned dem i hanterbara och värdeskapande leveranser med definierade acceptanskriterier.
   

  

 Arbetet sker i nära samarbete med användare, produktägare, verksamhetsexperter, arkitekter och utvecklingsteam för att säkerställa att kraven är tydliga, prioriterade, förankrade och väl förstådda av samtliga intressenter. Du ansvarar även för att upprätthålla spårbarhet genom hela utvecklingskedjan och säkerställa att krav kommuniceras och förankras mellan olika kravställare och intressentgrupper.
   

  

 Vidare bidrar du till kontinuerlig utveckling av teamets arbetssätt, dokumentation och kravprocesser. Du stödjer test- och kvalitetssäkringsarbetet genom kravvalidering och granskning av testfall samt fungerar som ett metodstöd inom kravhantering för verksamhetsspecialister och andra kravställare. Rollen innefattar även att utforma och vidareutveckla arbetsprocesser för mottagande organisation för att säkerställa effektiva och hållbara arbetssätt.
   

  

 Du kommer att ingå i ett agilt och tvärfunktionellt team som idag består av kravanalytiker, scrum master, systemutvecklare och testare.
   

  

**Kvalifikationer**
 Vi tror att du är en analytisk och kommunikativ person som tycker om att samarbeta, skapa struktur och bygga goda relationer. Du drivs av att förstå verksamheters behov och omsätta dem till lösningar som fungerar i praktiken.
   

  

**Skallkrav**
* Högskole-/universitetsutbildning om minst 180 hp inom systemvetenskap/IT
* Flytande svenska i tal och skrift
* Minst fem års erfarenhet av arbete som kravanalytiker i IT-relaterade projekt inom offentlig sektor och/eller inom energisektorn


**Meriterande kvalifikationer**
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta nära verksamhet och olika intressenter
* Erfarenhet av kravverktyg som Azure DevOps, Jira eller GitLab samt UX/designverktyg som Figma, Axure, och Adobe XD


 Det är positivt om du även har erfarenhet av konsultrollen eller förändringsledning – men vi värdesätter framför allt din vilja att utvecklas och bidra tillsammans med teamet. Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper och söker dig som är nyfiken, prestigelös och gillar att samarbeta med andra.
   

  

**Viktig information om ansökan**
 För att vara aktuell för fortsatt urval behöver du i din ansökan tydligt redogöra för hur du uppfyller skallkraven. Vi baserar den initiala urvalsbedömningen på informationen i ansökan.
   

  

**Ytterligare information**
 Vår enhet Digital Services verkar över hela utvecklingskedjan med experter inom projektledning, kravanalys, QA och test, systemutveckling, arkitektur, dataanalys och AI, cybersäkerhet med mera.
   

  

 Vad erbjuder AFRY dig som anställd?
   

  

 Vi har regelbundna träffar där temat varierar mellan kompetens och socialt utbyte, eller både och. En bra balans helt enkelt! Hos oss får du också:
   

  

* En AFRY Buddy som bollplank under din första tid som anställd
* Balans i arbetslivet med möjlighet till hybridarbete.
* Tillgång till Club AFRY där en bredd av spännande och underhållande aktiviteter för våra medarbetare anordnas - det finns något för alla! Läs gärna mer här.
* Konkurrenskraftiga förmåner gällande pension, friskvård och föräldraledighet reglerade i vårt kollektivavtal
* Företagsrabatter med externa partners genom vår förmånsportal Advantage You.
* Friskvårdsbidrag 4500 SEK/år.
* Restauranger och kaféer på plats
* Ett enormt nätverk av tekniska experter med +19 000 kollegor runtom i världen.


**Välkommen med din ansökan, sista ansökningsdag är 2026-09-30**
**Kontaktperson för frågor:**
 Fredrik Lindblad, Business Section Manager
   

  

 fredrik.f.lindblad@afry.com
   

  

 Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt säljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.
   

  

*På AFRY driver vi förändring i allt vi gör. Vi anser att förändring sker när modiga idéer möts, när vi samarbetar, skapar innovation och omfamnar kreativa lösningar, det är så vi skapar framtiden. Vi söker konstant kvalificerade kandidater som vill ansluta sig till våra inkluderande team runt om i världen. Bli en del av oss och påskynda den gröna omställningen*

title: T Textile & Rug Designer – Maternity Cover
description:
We are looking for an experienced Textile & Rug Designer to join our Stockholm-based design team for a maternity cover of at least six months. The preferred start date is in early December.
 



  





 As Nordic Knots continues to evolve from a rug brand into a comprehensive textile house, you
 



 will play an important role in developing our collections across rugs and textiles. Working closely with the Creative Director and our designers, you will translate creative concepts into distinctive, high-quality and production-ready designs.
 



  





 This is a hands-on role for someone with a strong design sensibility, solid technical knowledge and the confidence to take ownership of projects from initial concept through development and final production.
 



  





**The role** 




 You will develop original designs across rugs and textiles, ensuring that each product reflects Nordic Knots’ creative direction, quality standards and modern design language. You will balance creative ambition with technical feasibility, commercial considerations and production requirements.
 



  





**Your responsibilities will include:** 




 ● Developing original rug and textile designs, patterns, colorways and material concepts.
 



 ● Translating creative direction and collection concepts into detailed, production-ready designs.
 



 ● Taking ownership of assigned design projects from research and concept development through sampling and final handover.
 



 ● Preparing technical specifications, artwork, design files, color references, mood boards and presentation materials.
 



 ● Researching developments across interiors, art, fashion, materials and culture to bring relevant perspectives into the design process.
 



 ● Exploring yarns, fibers, constructions, colors and textures to create products that are both distinctive and feasible to produce.
 



 ● Reviewing samples and prototypes, providing clear feedback and ensuring that the final product meets our design and quality expectations.
 



 ● Working closely with the Production team and suppliers to explore techniques, solve technical challenges and maintain the design intent throughout the development process.
 



 ● Collaborating with the Buyer & Planner and Production team to ensure designs align with commercial goals, timelines and manufacturing capabilities.
 



 ● Contributing to a collaborative, open and ambitious team culture.
 



  





**Your profile** 




 You are an experienced designer with a strong understanding of textiles, rugs, color, pattern and material development. You combine creative instinct with technical precision and are comfortable moving between early-stage ideas and the detailed work required to bring a product into production.
 



  





 You are confident working independently and driving your own projects forward, while also enjoying close collaboration with creative, technical and commercial colleagues. You bring sound judgment, a solutions-oriented mindset and the ability to maintain momentum in a fast-moving environment.
 



  





**We believe you have:** 




 ● A strong sensibility for interior design and home products, or relevant professional experience within the category.
 



 ● Relevant professional experience in textile, rug, surface or product design.
 



 ● A strong portfolio demonstrating a refined sense of color, pattern, material and composition.
 



 ● Experience taking designs from concept through sampling and production.
 



 ● Good knowledge of textile or rug constructions, materials and manufacturing processes.
 



 ● The ability to interpret creative direction and develop it into clear, considered and production-ready solutions.
 



 ● Strong skills in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop. Experience with Lightroom or other relevant design tools is an advantage.
 



 ● Experience preparing accurate technical files and communicating with suppliers or production partners.
 



 ● Excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage several projects and deadlines simultaneously.
 



 ● Strong communication skills and professional fluency in English.
 



 ● A collaborative, pragmatic and curious approach.
 



  





 Experience from a premium interior, furniture, textile or fashion brand is considered an advantage.
 



  





 This is a full-time maternity cover for a minimum of six months. Please submit your CV and portfolio in English. We review applications on an ongoing basis and may fill the position before the application deadline.
 



  





**Nordic Knots** 




 Nordic Knots was founded in 2016 by Liza Laserow, Fabian Berglund and Felix Berglund. We are a fast-growing direct-to-consumer Scandinavian interior design brand with the USA as the major market.
 



 Nordic Knots was born from a culture of thoughtful design that lasts beyond seasons and trends. Fusing function and aesthetics with a Scandinavian sensibility, we craft timeless textiles for the modern home. We believe that great textiles are foundational and can transform a house into a harmonious home – framing the most beautifully curated lives.
 



 The head office as well as the flagship store is located at Birger Jarlsgatan in central Stockholm. We have a constantly growing team in Sweden, Europe and the USA.
 



  





**What we offer** 




 We are a driven team with high ambitions and an entrepreneurial, open-minded culture where new ideas and initiatives are encouraged. At Nordic Knots, everyone plays a meaningful role in contributing to our continued growth.
 



  





 We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants who bring different perspectives, experiences and ideas to our team.
 



  





**Location** 




 This position is based at our head office on Birger Jarlsgatan in central Stockholm. The role is office-based and requires presence at the Stockholm office.

title: Senior Mobile Engineer
description:
**TL;DR:**
 Lovable's mobile app (React Native, iOS/Android, owned by Team Everywhere) mirrors the web app's functionality while adding native login, push notifications, in-app top-ups, and haptics - it's one of the fastest-growing ways builders reach Lovable. The role is a product-minded fullstack engineer to own end-to-end mobile slices: native flows, auth, push, the web-native bridge, and app store ops (TestFlight, Play Console, compliance) across the full stack.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For**
* At least 6 years of relevant experience at high-pace, high-scale companies
* Strong fullstack background: deep comfort with TypeScript/React on the frontend and Node.js or similar on the backend
* Hands-on experience with React Native in production, including native module integration.
* Experience shipping and maintaining apps through the App Store and Google Play, including review/compliance cycles (Sign in with Apple, IAP, Android policy review)
* Product instinct: you think in user outcomes, not just API endpoints
* Comfort working with third-party services and building clean abstractions over vendor APIs. Familiarity with managed cloud services (AWS, GCP) and the tradeoffs of buy-vs-build
* Experience with push notification infrastructure or native device integrations is a strong plus
* You've shipped features in fast-moving, high-ownership environments where you wore multiple hats


**What You’ll Do**
* Build and own native mobile features end-to-end: onboarding, auth, push notifications, in-app purchases/credit top-ups, and share targets
* Improve the web-native bridge that connects the in-app WebView experience to native device capabilities (keyboard handling, haptics, camera, file sharing)
* Own App Store and Play Store submissions, review compliance, and release tooling (TestFlight, Play Console, Fastlane)
* Diagnose and fix native-specific bugs and performance issues (cold start, preview loading, crash handling) across iOS and Android


**Our Tech Stack**
 We're building with tools that both humans and AI love. Lovable software engineers are capable of working across the whole stack. Examples of tech in our stack include:
   

  

* Mobile: React Native, TypeScript, Swift, Kotlin
* Frontend: React and Typescript
* Backend: Golang and Rust
* Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, Firebase
* Data: Clickhouse, Firestore, Spanner, BigQuery
* DevOps & Tooling: CI/CD pipelines, OTEL, Kubernetes, Terraform, Fastlane


 And always on the lookout for what's next!
   

  

**About Your Application**
 Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
   

  

 We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: OT Solution Architect
description:
E.ON i Sverige är en del av den internationella energikoncernen E.ON SE med huvudkontor i Essen, Tyskland. Inom koncernen arbetar runt 70 000 personer i 17 länder. Runt om i Sverige arbetar runt 2100 engagerade medarbetare. Vårt nordiska huvudkontor finns i Malmö. I Sverige levererar vi el, värme och smarta energilösningar till drygt en miljon hushåll och företag. E.ON:s roll är att ta ansvar för och driva utvecklingen framåt, för att fler ska kunna ställa om. Med våra investeringar och våra kunders vilja att bidra arbetar vi för att fortsätta elektrifiera samhället och möta framtidens energibehov.  

**Om oss**


Energiomställningen ställer nya och utökade krav på cybersäkerhet, inte minst inom området Operational Technology (OT). Inom avdelningen Operativ IT bygger vi nu upp en ny grupp vars uppdrag är att arbeta med cybersäkerhetsfrågor kopplade till vår OT-miljö. Nu söker vi dig som vill bli en av gruppens fyra medarbetare, i en roll med fokus på våra OT-system.


I rollen bidrar du direkt till att skydda och utveckla de system som utgör en grundläggande del av elnätsverksamheten. Genom att kombinera säkerhet, arkitektur och verksamhetsförståelse är du en drivkraft i att skapa förutsättningar för säkra, tillförlitliga och framtidssäkrade OT-lösningar.

**Din roll**


Som OT Solution Architect har du en central och drivande roll i gränslandet mellan cybersäkerhet, lösningsarkitektur och OT-teknik. Du arbetar med våra centrala OT-system för styrning, övervakning och förvaltning av elnätet och säkerställer att dessa system utvecklas och drivs på ett säkert, robust och långsiktigt hållbart sätt.


I rollen ansvarar du för att förstå verksamhetens behov och omsätta dessa till säkra och ändamålsenliga lösningsarkitekturer som uppfyller verksamhetskrav, säkerhetskrav och regulatoriska krav. Du fungerar som en rådgivande specialist och en viktig nyckelspelare mellan verksamhet, arkitektur, drift, projekt och cybersäkerhetsfunktioner.


Arbetet omfattar bland annat att driva utredningar, analyser, säkerhetsgranskningar och arkitekturgenomgångar för nya och befintliga lösningar inom OT-miljön. Du säkerställer att tekniska lösningar följer gällande lagstiftning, interna styrande dokument, säkerhetskrav och etablerade arkitekturprinciper. En viktig del av rollen är att delta i och följa upp säkerhetsaktiviteter såsom penetrationstester, risk- och sårbarhetsanalyser samt hotmodelleringar. Du analyserar resultat, identifierar risker och driver nödvändiga förbättringsåtgärder tillsammans med relevanta intressenter.


Du arbetar nära cybersäkerhetsfunktionen, Information Security Officers (ISO), arkitekter, systemansvariga och projektledare, samt samverkar med motsvarande funktioner inom vår internationella koncern.


Exempel på ansvarsområden

* Ta fram och vidareutveckla lösningsarkitekturer för centrala OT-system och tillhörande datacenterlösningar.
* Säkerställa att lösningar uppfyller verksamhetskrav, säkerhetskrav och regulatoriska krav.
* Genomföra säkerhetsgranskningar, riskanalyser och arkitekturutvärderingar.
* Delta i och följa upp penetrationstester, sårbarhetsanalyser och hotmodelleringar.
* Driva och koordinera åtgärder baserade på identifierade risker och säkerhetsbrister.
* Bidra till utvecklingen av säkerhetsarkitektur, nätverkssegmentering, identitets- och åtkomsthantering samt andra säkerhetskontroller inom OT.
* Ge specialiststöd till projekt och förvaltningsorganisationer i frågor som rör OT-säkerhet, arkitektur och efterlevnad.
* Säkerställa att OT-lösningar följer interna policys, standarder och externa regelverk.

**Dina erfarenheter**


Vi söker dig som har en bakgrund inom eller erfarenheter av arbete inom IT-säkerhetsarkitektur eller lösningsarkitektur. Du har god förmåga att omsätta säkerhetskrav, risker och regulatoriska krav till tekniska lösningsarkitekturer. Du har erfarenheter från att designa helhetslösningar som balanserar verksamhetskrav, tillgänglighet, säkerhet, livscykel och förvaltningsbarhet. Du uttrycker dig väl i tal och skrift på både svenska och engelska.


Det är meriterande om du även har:

* God förståelse för nätverksszoner, VLAN, brandväggsregler, certifikat och DMZ-lösningar
* Erfarenheter av hotmodelleringar och riskanalyser
* Kunskaper inom NIS2, ISO27001, Säkerhetsskyddslagen
* Kunskap om serverplattformar, virtualisering, lagring, backup, identitetstjänster, hög tillgänglighet, disaster recovery och härdning
* Erfarenhet av arbete inom energibranschen

  

Som person är du initiativtagande och har ett lösningsorienterat arbetssätt. Med ägandeskap för dina frågor driver du konkreta förbättringar hela vägen fram. Du vågar utmana verksamheten och för konstruktiva dialoger som driver säkerhetsarbetet framåt. Du ser vikten av samarbete med andra och trivs med att föra dialog med olika typer av intressenter, både lokalt, globalt och utanför E.ON.


**Hur är det hos oss**


Hos oss blir du del av en nybildad grupp som idag består av fyra personer. Gruppen är del av avdelningen Operativ IT (OPIT), inom enheten Digitalisering- och Transformation. Inom OPIT arbetar vi med att säkra verksamhetskritiska IT-tjänster kopplade till elnätsdriften. Utveckling, digitalisering och säkerhet är centrala delar av vårt uppdrag, och vi befinner oss i en spännande fas där både teknik och arbetssätt fortsätter att utvecklas.


På E.ON arbetar vi aktivt med inkludering - det är avgörande för att driva energiomställningen framåt. Vi vill att just du ska känna dig välkommen! Vi strävar efter att skapa en trygg arbetsmiljö med meningsfulla arbetsuppgifter och goda möjligheter till utveckling. Vi fortsätter hela tiden att utmana oss själva för att skapa en välkomnande arbetsplats, där vi hoppas att du kommer att trivas.


Vi arbetar för ett mer hållbart energisamhälle, men det är minst lika viktigt att våra medarbetare har förutsättningar att värna om sin egen hållbarhet. Vi erbjuder därför bra förmåner för att du ska må bra och ha god balans mellan arbete och fritid. Några av dessa är t.ex. arbetstidsförkortning som är högre än branschens standard, hälsoförsäkring, fri sjukvård och mer därtill!


Då vi arbetar med samhällsviktig verksamhet är anställningen säkerhetsklassad, vilket innebär att en säkerhetsprövning kommer att genomföras innan anställning. Svenskt medborgarskap är ett krav för tjänsten.


Varmt välkommen att söka och var med oss på vägen mot ett mer hållbart samhälle! Sista ansökningsdag är 7 oktober.

**För frågor om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef:**


Lies Van Laere, lies.vanlaere@eon.se

Unionen, Unionen.EED@eon.se  

Akademikerna, Akademikerna@eon.se
