title: Financial Planning Solutions Architect
description:
Be part of something bigger. Decode the future.
  
  

At Electrolux Group, as a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living.
  
Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute, and grow together.
  
  

Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home.
  
  

About the role
  
  

Electrolux Group is looking for a Financial Planning Solutions Architect to support and govern our global SAP-based Financial Planning platform, used across EMEA, North America, Latin America, and Asia Pacific. The solution landscape includes SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), SAP Datasphere, SAP BW, and SAP BPC Embedded, supporting key processes such as Profit & Loss Planning, Resource Cost Planning, Global Allocations, and Strategic Planning.
  
In this role, you will be responsible for solution governance, architecture, enhancements, and global deployments while partnering closely with Finance, Controlling, and IT stakeholders worldwide.
  
  

What You'll Do
  
  

Own and govern the Financial Planning Solution architecture and roadmap.
  
Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable SAP planning solutions.
  
Lead solution enhancements, projects, and global rollouts.
  
Develop functional specifications, solution designs, and effort estimates.
  
Coordinate with development, integration, security, and support teams.
  
Review and approve solution changes and ensure proper documentation.
  
Drive process improvements, standardization, and user adoption.
  
Facilitate workshops, training sessions, and stakeholder discussions.
  
  

What You'll Bring
  
  

5+ years of experience with SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP BW, and SAP BPC Embedded.
  
Strong SAP BW modeling knowledge, including InfoObjects, ADSOs, process chains, security, and transports.
  
Experience delivering end-to-end SAP Financial Planning implementations.
  
Good understanding of finance and controlling processes, including planning, forecasting, P&L, and reporting.
  
Strong project management and stakeholder management skills.
  
Advanced Excel skills; VBA experience is an advantage.
  
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, IT, Engineering, or a related field.
  
Excellent communication skills in English.
  
  

Who You Are
  
  

Analytical, proactive, and solution-oriented.
  
Comfortable working in a global, fast-paced environment.
  
Able to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  
A collaborative team player with leadership capabilities and a passion for continuous improvement.
  
  

**Where you'll be:**  

You will be based at our modern Global Headquarters in Stockholm, where more than 1,200 colleagues come together to collaborate and innovate. We operate in a hybrid work model, offering up to 20% remote flexibility, while maintaining a strong in-office presence to foster creativity, connection, and teamwork.
  
  

**Benefits highlights:**  

Stability of employment in a company that shapes living for the better for over 100 years
  
Attractive additional benefits, such as free access to sports facilities, employee discounts, team and company events, onsite cafeteria
  
Extensive learning opportunities and flexible career paths
  
  

As part of Electrolux, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you.

title: AI & Data Scientist
description:
* Permanent
* Experienced Professionals
* Data & AI
* ID 563085-en\_US
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.


**Your role**


As a Data Scientist, you will collaborate with clients to understand complex business challenges and turn data into measurable business value. You will design, develop, and validate AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics solutions.
  

  

At Capgemini, we believe great Data Scientists combine analytical rigour with business understanding and technological curiosity. You may work with forecasting customer demand, optimising industrial operations, building recommendation engines, or assessing whether an AI use case is feasible.
  

  

You will help clients make evidence-based decisions by applying statistical modelling, machine learning, data visualisation, Generative AI, and advanced analytics.


*In this role you will play a key role in:*  

  



* **Data Wrangling & Analytics:** work with data wrangling, advanced analytics, statistical modelling, machine learning, and data visualisation to uncover insights and support better decisions. Use tools such as Matplotlib, Seaborn, Power BI, and Qlik.
* **Use Case Assessment & Experimentation:** run AI use case assessments and feasibility analyses. Frame business problems as analytical questions and design experiments to test assumptions and evaluate potential value.
* **Predictive Analytics & Optimisation:** build forecasting, recommendation, optimisation, predictive maintenance, and decision-support solutions.
* **Model Validation**: validate models for performance, robustness, drift, and explainability. Apply experimental design, A/B testing, and uncertainty quantification when evaluating models and analytical results.
* **Generative AI & Agentic AI**: apply Generative AI, Large Language Models, AI agents, and frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and LlamaIndex where they create tangible business value and complement traditional Data Science approaches.
* **Data Platforms & Cloud**: work with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, Spark, and cloud-native analytics environments across Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud.
* **Client Collaboration**: partner closely with stakeholders to translate business problems into analytical solutions. Explain models and analytical results clearly to business stakeholders and ensure that solutions align with the EU AI Act and GDPR.
* **Deployment & Knowledge Transfer:** package models for deployment using APIs and REST services, document the solutions, and transfer knowledge to the client team.
**Your profile**


* Experience as a Data Scientist, Analytics Consultant, or similar, with an interest in Generative AI, Agentic AI, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, intelligent automation, and AI copilots.
* Experience with LLMs (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Kimi, or similar) and frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and LlamaIndex.
* Experience with Python (including Pandas, Polars, NumPy, Scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Spark, PySpark) or R.
* Strong SQL, database experience, and knowledge of statistical methods including experimental design, A/B testing, and uncertainty quantification.
* Experience with analytics and visualization tools such as Matplotlib, Seaborn, Power BI, and Qlik.
* Knowledge of cloud analytics platforms, APIs, REST services, and Git version control.
* Ability to explain analytical models and results to business stakeholders and identify opportunities to create business value through analytics.
* Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or a related quantitative field, and fluent English.
  

  

*If you also have experience with Databricks, MLOps, knowledge graphs (Neo4j), Kubernetes, Docker, and speaks Swedish fluent that's even better!*

**What we believe you will enjoy about working here**


* The opportunity to shape your own development, whether you want to deepen your expertise in Data & AI or explore new roles and areas of responsibility.
* A culture where learning is part of everyday work – through certifications, communities, knowledge hubs, and colleagues who are always willing to share their knowledge.
* Flexibility in how and where you work, with opportunities for hybrid working when assignments allow.
  

  

**Application**

*As part of our recruitment process, identity verification will be conducted through inspection of your ID card, and background checks may be carried out as required. We welcome applicants with different backgrounds and experiences. If you're excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway.*

  

  

*We believe diverse perspectives make better products and stronger teams. We actively strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute. We welcome applicants of all genders, backgrounds, and experiences.*

**About Capgemini**  

Capgemini is the business transformation partner for enterprises in the age of AI. We help organizations imagine and build an intelligent, sustainable future, combining AI, technology and human ingenuity to transform how they operate, innovate and grow. With unique end-to-end capabilities spanning strategy, technology, engineering and intelligent operations, we bring together deep industry expertise and market-leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data to turn ambition into measurable business outcomes at scale. Supported by a robust ecosystem of partners and nearly 60 years of expertise, Capgemini is a responsible and diverse global organization of over 410,000 team members in more than 50 countries. The Group reported 2025 revenues of €22.5 billion.
  

  

**Make it real** | www.capgemini.com

title: Praktikplats - Kommunikation & studentrelationer på Vattenfall Power Solutions
description:
**Företagsbeskrivning**  

Vattenfall är ett ledande europeiskt energiföretag med 12 miljoner kunder och cirka 21 000 anställda. Vi är övertygade om att det finns en väg att bygga en framtid där alla kan välja fossilfria sätt att transportera, producera och leva.

 **Jobbeskrivning** *Är du student och vill använda dina kunskaper för att bidra till verkliga lösningar inom energiomställningen? Hos oss får du möjlighet att genomföra din praktik nära verksamheten, tillsammans med erfarna specialister och med utmaningar där dina idéer och perspektiv kan göra skillnad.*


Vattenfall Power Solutions är en affärsenhet inom Vattenfall som stöttar koncernens verksamheter med utbildning, tekniska specialisttjänster, kärnbränsle samt projekt- och utvecklingsstöd. Inom avdelningen People, Culture & Communication (PC&C) arbetar vi med kommunikation, HR och organisationsutveckling för att stärka både medarbetarupplevelsen och verksamhetens långsiktiga utveckling.


Som praktikant hos oss får du en bred inblick i hur kommunikation, marknadsföring och employer branding bedrivs i en verksamhet som spelar en viktig roll i samhällets energiomställning. Du blir en del av vårt team och får möjlighet att arbeta både strategiskt och operativt med kommunikation.


Under praktiken kommer du bland annat att:

* Skapa och publicera innehåll för sociala medier, intranät och andra interna och externa kommunikationskanaler
* Bidra i planering och genomförande av kommunikationsinsatser och kampanjer
* Stötta oss med grafisk profilering och produktion av kommunikationsmaterial
* Stötta aktiviteter inom employer branding, såsom studentevent, mässor och samarbeten med universitet och högskolor
* Bidra i HR-kommunikation och andra initiativ som stärker engagemang och kultur i organisationen
* Omfattning: Heltid

  

**Kvalifikationer**  

Vi söker en student som har pågående studier och som vill omsätta sina kunskaper i praktiken genom en praktikplats hos Vattenfall. Du är även någon som identifierar dig med våra principer: Aktiv, Öppen, Positiv och Säkerhet. Vi ser även att du uppfyller följande krav;

* Pågående högskole- eller universitetsutbildning inom kommunikation, medie- och kommunikationsvetenskap, marknadsföring, journalistik eller annan närliggande inriktning.
* Engelska och svenska kunskaper
* Du är kreativ, flexibel och initiativtagande, med god samarbetsförmåga och ett strukturerat arbetssätt. Du trivs i en miljö med många kontaktytor och har förmåga att självständigt planera och driva dina arbetsuppgifter framåt.
* Intresse för intern och extern kommunikation, digitala kanaler, employer branding och organisationskommunikation.


Meriterande:

* Kunskap och erfarenhet inom marknadsföring eller internkommunikation genom studier, projekt eller ideella engagemang.
* Erfarenhet av verktyg som Canva, Adobe Creative Cloud (exempelvis InDesign, Photoshop eller Premiere Pro) eller liknande.
* Erfarenhet av att ta fram text, foto eller film för olika målgrupper och kommunikationskanaler.
* Engagemang i studentföreningar, projektgrupper eller andra uppdrag där kommunikation, marknadsföring eller eventplanering ingått.

  

**Ytterligare information**  

* Uppdraget startar: 2027-01-18 eller vid överenskommelse
* Placeringsort: Solna men resor till Nyköping kan förekomma
* Ansökan – en fil med ditt CV.
* Sista ansökningsdag är **2026-10-11.**
* Kontaktperson och handledare på Vattenfall: Elise Johansson, elise.johansson@vattenfall.com

**Mångfald och inkludering – i allt vi gör**


På Vattenfall värdesätter vi att vara aktiva, positiva, öppna och säkerhetsmedvetna. Vi söker medarbetare som delar vår vision och kan bidra till att stärka vår företagskultur. Vi är övertygade om att mångfald bidrar till att bygga ett mer lönsamt och tilltalande företag och strävar efter att vara goda förebilder när det gäller mångfald. Vattenfall arbetar aktivt för att alla medarbetare ska ha samma möjligheter och rättigheter oavsett ålder, etnisk eller kulturell bakgrund, könstillhörighet, religion/tro, sexuell läggning eller funktionsvariation. Läs mer om hur vi arbetar med mångfald och inkludering här.

*Vattenfall är en del av Sveriges kritiska infrastruktur, därmed är många av våra tjänster säkerhetsklassade. Är denna tjänst säkerhetsklassad kommer säkerhetsprövning genomföras innan anställning, i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagen.*

title: Head of AI, Machining
description:
As AI adoption accelerates across Machining and throughout Sandvik, a unique opportunity is emerging to shape how AI creates value across a global industrial business. Working at the intersection of business, technology and transformation, you play a key role in turning AI potential into measurable business results and defining Machining’s future AI journey.

You strengthen Machining’s ability to identify, develop and realize value from AI. Working across divisions, common functions, Machining IT, Group IT and specialist communities, you build alignment, influence priorities, and help accelerate AI adoption and value creation across the organization.  



**Job responsibilities**

* Lead selected Machining-wide AI initiatives with clear business value.
* Support and coach divisions and functions that need additional AI expertise or capacity.
* Connect business needs with suitable technology, platforms, architecture and specialist competence.
* Guide AI opportunities from initial idea and business case through implementation, adoption and value realization.
* Drive change by building alignment, influencing stakeholders, and establishing ways of working that accelerate AI impact.

Enable responsible AI by helping stakeholders navigate architecture, cybersecurity, privacy, legal, ethical and data requirements.  

* 

**Location**

This position is based at the World Trade Center in Stockholm.  



**Your profile**

You’re a collaborative and business-oriented leader who enjoys shaping direction, influencing decisions and turning opportunities into tangible results. You bring senior experience from AI, IT, digital, data, analytics, or automation in a complex international organization. Combining a broad understanding of AI with practical delivery experience, you connect technology opportunities to business outcomes.  



Your background includes


* Practical experience developing AI use cases, business cases, implementation, adoption and value realization.
* A solid understanding of generative AI, machine learning, agentic solutions, analytics, automation, data foundations and cloud-based AI services.

* A university degree, master’s degree, or equivalent training and experience in a relevant field.

Fluency in written and spoken English.  

* 

Experience from an industrial, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain or B2B environment is an advantage, as are knowledge of governance, portfolio management or ways of working for emerging technologies.  



Success in this position comes from your ability to build trust, influence stakeholders, and turn opportunities into results. You're comfortable navigating between strategic discussions and practical execution while balancing local needs with enterprise-wide value.

title: Functional Leader
description:

VEMS/PPC functional requirements and control philosophy

Practical knowledge of grid-connected BESS, EMS/PPC, PCS, metering, protection, power quality and grid-support functions
  
  

Experience with end-to-end testing across cloud platforms, industrial networks, firewalls, EMS/PPC, BESS and grid interfaces
  
  

Ability to manage setpoint priorities, operating limits, response times, availability, cybersecurity and communication-loss behaviour
  
  

Strong project management and stakeholder coordination capability

title: Juniora Analysts till Operations Transformation, Engineering, AI & Data (Stockholm) – Aug 2027
description:
**Företagsbeskrivning**
-----------------------

Deloitte är en globalt ledande leverantör av Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal och Consultative Services. Med mer än 470 000 medarbetare i över 150 länder hjälper vi våra klienter och vår omvärld att lösa komplexa problem och nå ambitiösa mål genom områdes- och branschexpertis, global räckvidd och allianser med de största tech-leverantörerna. Det som definierar Deloitte är vår strävan efter att göra en meningsfull skillnad. För oss innebär det långsiktig utveckling och resultat för våra klienter och deras företag, idéer och handlingar som också bidrar till en positiv samhällsutveckling. Det handlar även om att stärka våra medarbetare och främja deras utveckling.


**Om rollen**
-------------

Operations, Engineering, AI & Data stödjer våra kunder att driva strategiska förändringsprojekt där vi implementerar affärsstrategier och utvecklar deras operationella förmågor för att hjälpa dem nå sina affärsmål. Vi arbetar med verksamhetsförändring där vi använder våra industrispecifika lösningar och tekniska kunskaper för att transformera, modernisera och optimera våra klienters processer och tekniska plattformar.
  

  

Inom Operations, Engineering, AI & Data finns tre olika team:  

  



**AI & Data:**

Inom AI & Data-teamet hjälper du Deloittes kunder att förbättra beslutsfattande genom datadrivna insikter och skapa insiktsdrivna organisationer. Du kommer att arbeta med implementering av AI, GenAI, cloud data platforms, data warehouse och BI/analytics, med fokus på data science, maskininlärning, statistisk analys och modellering för att leverera avancerade insikter och affärsvärde. Vår modell är on-the-job-training där du växer in i mer ansvarsfulla roller och vidareutbildar dig i tekniska plattformar som Google Cloud Platform, AWS, Azure, Snowflake och Databricks. I det rådgivande spåret arbetar du med data management, data governance och datastrategi. Vi ser gärna att du har en traditionell managementkonsultutbildning kombinerad med data och teknik samt ett intresse för rådgivning. AI & Data-teamet verkar i en nordisk organisation med mycket kunskapskapital och kompetens, så du kommer att medverka i projekt, communities och utbildningar tillsammans med nordiska kollegor.


**Operations Transformation & Industry Solutions:**

Inom OTIS-teamet hjälper du Deloittes kunder att innovativt förändra sina organisationer. Du driver förändringsprojekt, förnyar operativa modeller, implementerar nya system och processer samt förbättrar effektiviteten. Hos oss fokuserar du primärt på bank och finans samt försäkring, där vi arbetar tillsammans med flertalet av Nordens största banker och försäkringsbolag. Du kommer att arbeta i projektteam med stark laganda och nära kunden. Som Analyst driver du analysarbete, stöttar i framtagandet av presentationsmaterial och hjälper kunden att lyckas med sin förändringsresa. Du får möjlighet att arbeta nära och lära dig av erfarna kollegor om olika industrier och affärsutveckling, samt adressera tekniska och affärsmässiga utmaningar.


**Engineering:**

Inom Engineering-teamet fokuserar du på att hjälpa Deloittes kunder att transformera sin affär genom planering och implementation av kritiska verksamhetssystem och molnplattformar. Du kombinerar teknik- och affärsexpertis inom systemutveckling och molnplattformar med bred projektledningsförmåga och djup branscherfarenhet inom flera sektorer. Därmed stödjer du kunder genom hela deras system- och affärstransformationsresa, oavsett fas. Vårt erbjudande inkluderar utveckling av strategier, skräddarsydda plattformar, modernisering av applikationer, alla aspekter av molnteknik samt rådgivning kring systemimplementation. Som Analyst i vårt team stödjer du kunder med roller inom kravställning, systemutveckling, testning och projektledning. Du skaffar dig erfarenhet genom kundprojekt samt deltar vid branschevent, specialiserad utbildning och certifieringsprogram.


**Kravspecifikation**
---------------------

**Vi söker dig som:**

* Är nyexaminerad ingenjör, systemvetare eller ekonom med en masterexamen inom management, data/data science/analytics eller finans.
* Har relevant arbetslivserfarenhet – erfarenhet inom konsultbranschen är meriterande
* Har goda språkkunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift

**Meriterande:**

* Goda akademiska meriter, internationell erfarenhet och relevant engagemang vid sidan av studierna
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans i ett team, med målmedvetenhet, engagemang och driv
* Intresse för hur digitalisering och ny teknik kan utveckla verksamheter och branscher

Du är en prestigelös lagspelare som trivs med att arbeta projektbaserat, i nära samarbete med både ditt team och klienter, i en dynamisk miljö.


*Om du är osäker på om du uppfyller ovan kvalifikationer uppmuntrar vi dig att skicka in en ansökan ändå.*

**Ytterligare information**
---------------------------

**Vi erbjuder**  

Som en del av Deloitte får du tillgång till världens största konsultnätverk tillsammans med kunniga och engagerade kollegor som är experter inom sina områden. Du får arbeta med spännande, komplexa uppdrag, både på global och nordisk nivå, i team som alltid värderar ditt perspektiv. Vi lägger stor vikt vid att erbjuda dig möjligheter att driva din personliga utveckling. Vi erbjuder dig praktisk erfarenhet, en personlig coach som långsiktigt stöttar dig i din karriär och kontinuerlig feedback och support från mer erfarna kollegor.


Du får möjlighet att arbeta i ett företag som hjälper andra aktörer i deras resa mot en mer hållbar organisation, samtidigt som vi arbetar målmedvetet med våra egna ambitioner inom både klimat, miljö och socialt ansvar. Vi ser ett värde i att våra medarbetare har olika erfarenheter vilket främjar nytänkande och bidrar till fler perspektiv.


**Ansökan**  

Du ansöker online. Din ansökan ska bestå av:


* CV
* Betygskopior från högskola/universitet - De betyg som du laddar upp bör inte vara utdragna senare än 2 månader tillbaka i tiden.

I det första steget laddar du upp ditt CV. I nästa steg laddar du upp dina universitetsbetyg (över hittills avklarade kurser) samt svarar på frågor som är kopplade till rollen, inklusive en motivering till varför du sökt denna roll. Observera att både CV samt fullständiga betyg behöver laddas upp för att din ansökan ska ses som fullständig. Vi tillämpar löpande urval, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Vid inskickad ansökan ska du få ett bekräftelsemejl från oss. Får du inte detta mejl råder vi dig att skicka in din ansökan på nytt. Om du söker flera tjänster hos oss ber vi dig att i dina ansökningar tydliggöra vilken roll du är mest intresserad av.


Som ett kvalitativt led i Deloittes rekryteringsprocess genomgår våra slutkandidater en bakgrundskontroll, detta för att öka kännedomen om våra framtida medarbetare, trygga arbetsmiljön för våra medarbetare och möta regelkrav. Processen för bakgrundskontroller genomförs i samarbete med ToFindOut. https://tofindout.se/sv/faq/ . För de tjänster som Deloitte efterfrågar universitetsbetyg genomförs en verifiering som en del i rekryteringsprocessen. För frågor hänvisar vi till ansvarig rekryterare i processen.


**Frågor**  

Om du har frågor om tjänsten eller om rekryteringsprocessen är du välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryterare William Lim, wilim@deloitte.se


Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!


**What impact will you make?**

På Deloitte gör ditt arbete en meningsfull skillnad, varje dag, medan du växer i en inkluderande företagskultur av samarbete och hög prestation. Utöver att skapa lösningar strävar vi efter att göra en positiv och avgörande skillnad för andra i vår omgivning, våra klienter och samhället. På Deloitte hittar du tidigare dolda möjligheter att lyckas och inser din fulla potential.


Genom att klicka på länken ovan eller en tredjepartslänk i det här inlägget lämnar du webbplatsen och går till en tredjepartswebbplats där den tredje partens villkor och integritetspolicy gäller.


**Arbetsplats**
---------------

title: Senior Manager, Platform Architects - Northern EMEA
description:

It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.

 **Job Description** **What you get to do in this role:**


We are all about our customers and we show up with a point of view as we constantly listen to our customers and innovate our products and services. We are focused on flawless executions in advisory, co-delivery and implementations to deliver to our customers faster time to value in realizing the benefits of the ServiceNow suite of products.


The **Senior Manager, Platform Architects** is focused on all aspects of leading a team of Platform Architects in timely, high quality advisory services for ServiceNow customers.


This role has the responsibility to provide business and technical leadership, and to establish and reinforce the utilization of Best Practices across all the teams. He or she will develop a high performing team of Platform Architects. Customer Outcomes is in transformation. As a result, and most importantly, the Manager for Platform Architects will manage the workforce transformation to ensure that our talent is enabled to meet tomorrow’s business needs.


You and your team will actively work with customers and alongside partners to provide ServiceNow Platform leading practice guidance. To achieve excellent business outcomes underpinned by a technically healthy platform this team must be at the forefront of these leading practices, collaborating across ServiceNow, to both receive the latest standards, but also to feedback and support their continuous improvement.


You will support partnering with ServiceNow account teams and across Customer Outcomes to allocate the right consultant at the right time in the right place. Driving best in class execution, utilization management, measurable KPIs and SLAs determining success, building a world class team that can not only deliver, but in many cases partner with sales teams to help articulate the value proposition of Platform Architecture services.


Additionally, you must have the ability to continuously learn and improve from our customers, your team and from our Product Development and Sales Teams. This feedback loop is critical to constant innovation, improvement and growth of the overall Platform Architecture capability in the GEO, both directly as well as through Customer Outcomes Excellence and Product Development.


Measurements will include but are not limited to:

* Delivery success criteria such as time to value, accuracy, health scan and NPS

title: AI Engineer - ADAS AI Agents
description:
Graduate AI Engineer – ADAS AI Agents
  
Are you passionate about Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and the future of automotive technology? Do you want to help shape the next generation of connected, autonomous, and electric vehicles?
  
DXC Luxoft is a global leader in software engineering and digital transformation, partnering with many of the world's leading automotive manufacturers and suppliers. We are now looking for a talented and motivated Graduate AI Engineer to join our growing Automotive team in Sweden.
  
In this role, you will work at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS), developing innovative AI agents and intelligent tools that support the creation of safer, smarter vehicles. You will collaborate with experienced automotive and AI engineers, apply cutting-edge technologies such as Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Large Language Models, and contribute to real-world solutions for the mobility challenges of tomorrow.
  
This is an exciting opportunity for recent graduates and early-career professionals who are eager to combine their technical skills with creativity, innovation, and a passion for automotive technology. If you are looking for a role where you can learn, grow, and make a meaningful impact in a fast-moving global environment, we would love to hear from you.
  
Join DXC Luxoft and help drive the future of intelligent mobility.
  
  

**Project Description:**  

DXC Luxoft is a leading global software services company, delivering professional services across multiple business verticals such as finance, automotive, and digital transformation. The Automotive practice inside DXC Luxoft delivers software projects to a majority of the world's car manufacturers and suppliers for both personal and commercial vehicles. We are known for our Automotive software expertise and for helping our customers with high quality services and deliveries. Currently we are growing for our Swedish customers and are looking for Automotive cloud engineer with knowledge in cloud infrastructure development to join our team. You will be part of our growing organization in Sweden and will be part of developing next generation systems for the Automotive industry in the era of connected, autonomous, electric vehicles.
  
  

**Responsibilities:**  

Design, develop, and maintain C++ software for automotive systems with a strong focus on system safety
  
Candidates who can support in development of component adhering to functional safety standards
  
Contribute to system analysis, and implementation in compliance with automotive standards
  
Collaborate with hardware, software, and system teams across the development lifecycle
  
Develop and evaluate AI agents for automotive and ADAS use cases.
  
Build AI-powered tools to improve engineering productivity.
  
Apply Machine Learning and Generative AI techniques to ADAS challenges.
  
Work with ADAS engineers to prototype and deploy AI solutions.
  
Analyze automotive datasets and support AI model development.
  
Participate in research and innovation activities related to AI in automotive systems.
  
  

**Mandatory Skills Description:****Hard skills:**  

* Degree in Physics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with MSc or BSc preferred in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, Robotics, or Computer Vision.
* Experience in C++ software development within automotive settings.
* Foundational knowledge of AI and Machine Learning principles.
* Python programming.
* Understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI concepts.
* Competence in data analysis to support problem-solving efforts.


**Soft skills:**  

* Demonstrated leadership capabilities and effective communication skills.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
* Proven track record in automotive software development projects


**Nice-to-Have Skills Description:**  

* ADAS knowledge: Familiarity with Advanced Driver Assistance Systems concepts and applications.
* Computer Vision: Understanding of image processing and visual data interpretation techniques.
* Deep Learning (PyTorch/TensorFlow): Experience with deep learning frameworks used for modeling and training AI systems.
* Master's Thesis related to ADAS, AI, Autonomous Driving, or Computer Vision: Relevant academic research demonstrating specialized expertise in these areas.
* Experience with AI Agent frameworks: Exposure to frameworks that facilitate the development of intelligent autonomous agents.
* Experience in agile or scaled agile environments: Optional familiarity with iterative and collaborative development methodologies.

title: AI Engineer
description:
**Are you passionate about how AI can shape the insurance market?**
===================================================================

  

Join either **Data Discovery & Experience** or **API Platform** , two teams within API & Data Products Solutions.


Our mission is to make APIs, MCPs and Data easy to discover, understand, and use. To support that journey, we are looking for an AI Engineer who is excited about building the next generation of AI-powered experiences.

  

  

**About the role**
------------------


You will help shape AI-powered experiences by enabling AI agents, APIs, MCPs, and Data Products to create value for developers, employees, partners, and customers.

  

  

Working hands-on with modern AI technologies, agent frameworks, APIs, and platform capabilities, you will build scalable solutions that enable teams across If to discover, access, and use digital capabilities more effectively.

  

  

As part of a cross-functional team of Product Managers, Architects, Engineers, and business stakeholders, you will turn emerging AI opportunities into practical solutions with measurable business impact.

  

  

* Help evolve our Data Discovery & Experience or API Platform capabilities.
* Design and develop AI-powered platform capabilities using AI agents, APIs, MCPs, and Data Products.
* Improve how APIs, MCPs, and Data Products are discovered, understood, and used across If.
* Help ensure secure access using open standards.
* Apply platform engineering and product thinking to solve real business problems.
* Contribute to AI literacy and AI-enabled ways of working.

**We offer**
------------


In the same way that we place high demands on you as an employee, we also expect you to place high demands on us as an employer. Here are some of the benefits of working at If:

  

  

* An including work environment where everyone is welcome
* Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
* Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment
* Possibility of hybrid workplace
* Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities
* Great insurance benefits
* Lunch benefit
  

  

**About the team**
------------------


Depending on your background, interests, and experience, you may join either the **Data Discovery & Experience** team or the **API Platform** team.


The **Data Discovery & Experience** team works closely with business and technical stakeholders to improve how APIs and Data are discovered, understood, and used as Products across If.

  

  

The **API Platform** team focuses on building and evolving common platform capabilities that enable secure, scalable, and efficient API consumption and integration across If and with external partners.


Both teams use agile ways of working and collaborate closely with stakeholders across business and technology domains.

  

  

This position is also a part of a larger agile Tribe responsible for providing common API and IAM capabilities that enable If's business to grow in a secure, scalable, and compliant manner. We support both internal teams and external partners through technology, products, processes, training, and governance.

  

  

**Who are you?**
----------------


You are curious, innovative, and motivated by making hard things look easy.

  

  

You enjoy experimenting with new technologies and turning ideas into working solutions. You combine strong technical skills with a product mindset and are excited about creating experiences that are useful, intuitive, and valuable to users.

  

  

You are comfortable navigating uncertainty, learning quickly, and working in a field that is evolving.

  

  

You see AI not as a standalone technology, but as a capability that becomes powerful when combined with data, business processes, and great user experiences.

  

  

You are passionate about agile ways of working, continuous improvement, and exploring new technologies.

  

  

You have the ability to make complex technical concepts understandable and actionable for both technical and business stakeholders.  

  



You also have:


* Relevant university degree, preferably within Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data & Analytics, or a related technical field. Equivalent practical experience is also valued.
* Experience in the insurance industry or another regulated industry, such as banking, finance, healthcare, telecommunications, or the public sector.
* At least 3 years of experience in software engineering and modern application development.
* At least 1-2 years of practical, hands-on experience applying AI engineering practices in production or real-world applications.
* Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
* Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as C#, TypeScript, or Python.
  

  

Experience from one or more of the following areas is considered a strong advantage:


* AI Agents, Agentic Workflows, and Agent Frameworks such as LangGraph, Pydantic AI, Microsoft Agent Framework, or similar technologies.
* MCP (Model Context Protocol), including providing AI systems with context, tools, and access to enterprise capabilities.
* Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), prompt and context engineering, evaluation, and model orchestration.
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search, embeddings, and semantic search technologies.
* APIs, API Platforms, integration technologies, and secure access using open standards, as well as Data Products, Data Discovery, Analytics Platforms, and Developer Experience capabilities.
* Cloud-native application development using Microsoft Azure or similar cloud platforms.
  

  

**Additional facts and the recruitment process**
------------------------------------------------


**Application deadline:** Screening and interviewing will start immediately. However, application deadline is October 11, 2026.


**To apply for the position:** Please attach your CV and fill in the questionnaires


**Work location:** Bergshamra, Stockholm


**Travelling:** Some travel within the Nordics and Baltics is required


**Start:** Upon agreement

  

  

For more information, please contact Daniel Sahlin, Head of API and Data Product Solutions, +46 (0) 771 43 00 00

  

  

Final candidates will undergo a background check before employment.

  

  

We look forward to your application!

title: HR Specialist
description:
Be part of Clavister’s journey to secure the digital world! We are looking for an HR Specialist who wants to take an active role across the employee lifecycle and help us deliver effective, people-focused and scalable HR practices.


We apply Agile HR principles, working closely with the organisation, learning through feedback and data, and continuously adapting our people practices as our needs evolve. This is a broad and hands-on HR role for someone who enjoys combining people interaction with structure, independent responsibility and continuous improvement.

### **About Clavister**


Clavister is a leading European cybersecurity company founded in 1997, headquartered in Örnsköldsvik, offering a wide range of cybersecurity solutions, including network firewalls, identity management, cloud security, machine learning and AI.


Today, we focus on four main customer segments: the Public Sector, Critical Infrastructure, Defence and Telecommunications. Together with our partners and distributors, Clavister’s hardware and software are widely deployed and used by customers in more than 100 countries.

### **The Role**


As HR Specialist, you will work closely with our Head of HR. You will independently manage and coordinate defined HR processes and support employees and leaders throughout the employee lifecycle.


You will have a broad role spanning recruitment, onboarding and offboarding, HR administration and data, work environment activities and day-to-day HR support. You will be responsible for ensuring that the processes within your area are well structured, professionally delivered and continuously improved.


This is a role for someone who enjoys taking ownership, creating structure and making sure things get done, while providing a professional and positive experience for candidates, employees and People Leads.

#### **Key areas of responsibility**

* Manage recruitment processes, including candidate communication, interview coordination and recruitment administration
* Coordinate and continuously improve onboarding and offboarding processes
* Coordinate activities, documentation and follow-up related to Systematic Work Environment (SAM) Management and the Safety Committee
* Maintain accurate employee information, HR systems, documentation and records

#### **You will also contribute to**

* Provide HR support to employees and People Leads, handling routine matters and working together with the Head of HR on more complex questions
* Prepare and validate employee and compensation data for reporting, analysis and recurring HR processes
* Support recurring HR activities related to engagement, communication, performance and employee development
* Support personnel security activities throughout the employee lifecycle
* Work closely with employees and People Leads to understand needs, gather feedback and improve HR practices


Across all these areas, you will work with an Agile HR mindset, staying close to the organisation, learning from feedback and continuously improving our processes, tools and ways of working.

### **The person we are looking for**


Trust is our foundation, and how you work with people matters to us. We are looking for someone who combines a genuine interest in people with the structure and drive to take ownership and get things done.


You have experience working with HR and independently managing defined HR activities or processes. You understand the employee lifecycle, are comfortable managing several priorities at once, and communicate confidently in both Swedish and English.


We believe you will thrive at Clavister if you:

* Care about people and take pride in creating a positive and professional experience for others
* Collaborate openly, build strong relationships and enjoy working closely with employees and leaders
* Show bravery by taking initiative, asking questions and challenging ways of working when you see an opportunity to improve
* Innovate by being curious and looking for smarter ways of working, including how technology can improve everyday HR
* Keep growing by seeking feedback, learning and adapting as the needs of our people and organisation evolve
* Take ownership of your work while having the judgement to recognise when something should be discussed or escalated


You are structured and reliable and comfortable working iteratively, learning from feedback and adjusting along the way. You understand when consistency and structure are important and when a simpler, more flexible approach creates greater value.

#### **Extra points for**


Experience in one or more of the following is an advantage:

* Recruitment and onboarding
* Swedish work environment processes and employment practices
* HR systems, employee data or HR reporting
* HR analytics
* Agile HR or working in an agile organisation
* Technology, international or regulated organisations


We will continuously review and interview qualified applicants.

title: SAP Technical Architect
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Be part of something bigger. Decode the future.**


At Electrolux Group, as a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living.


Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute, and grow together.


Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home.

**All about the role:**


The SAP Technical Architect is a strategic role that will enable business capabilities with SAP technology. The role includes creation of technology roadmaps as well as governance and support of existing deliveries and will be instrumental in modernising Electrolux technical landscape.


Working with the landscape in Electrolux means working with a wide range of applications in a global environment. Electrolux landscape includes applications from on premise ERP, SCM, EWM, etc to public cloud solutions like IBP, CCv2, C4C, etc. There is currently a big modernisation of the landscape moving into private cloud/RISE, Integration Suite, BW/4HANA, BTP and eventually S/4HANA.


The successful candidate is passionate about driving business value from technical solutions, analysing and designing solutions and collaborating with different level of stakeholders in a global setting. You will be part of a team of global architects with expertise in different business processes and technologies.

**What you'll do:**

* Create and own the SAP landscape strategy and design technical landscapes, both on premise and cloud.
* Establish and maintain SAP technical architecture principles, standards and guardrails to ensure scalable, secure and supportable solutions across the SAP landscape, for example considering data volume and performance.
* Define and govern non-functional requirements including security, availability, performance, resilience, recoverability and operational supportability.
* Own architecture decisions and review proposed solutions from functional and technical teams to ensure alignment with architecture standards.
* Collaborate with SAP, implementation partners and internal teams to jointly resolve complex issues or design solutions.
* Provide architecture leadership and guidance in high-priority support issues.
* Create and own the roadmap for Application Lifecycle Management to ensure the applications used are efficiently supporting the IT processes.
* Participate in ERP modernisation program, including move to private cloud, conversion to S/4HANA and implementation of Business Data Cloud (BDC).
* Proactively monitor innovation and emerging technologies, including AI-driven capabilities, to identify business value opportunities.
* Mentor and provide guidance to technical and functional teams and promote architecture best practices across the organization.

**Who you are:**

* You possess excellent written and oral communication skills and ability to communicate complex concepts to senior IT management, technical, functional and business teams in English.
* Demonstrate strong business acumen, with a solid understanding of SAP business processes and the ability to influence stakeholders through effective relationship management and communication.
* Able to work independently and as part of distributed, multi-disciplinary, multi-national teams with good collaboration skills
* Able to deal with ambiguity and manage multiple priorities
* A proactive learner with a strong passion for continuously expanding your knowledge and skills across SAP technologies and the broader digital ecosystem.
* Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Fluent in English.

**Required qualifications****:**

* 8+ years of SAP technical platform and architecture experience, including significant experience designing and governing enterprise-scale hybrid SAP landscapes.
* Proven experience acting as SAP Technical Architect, Lead SAP Basis Architect, SAP Platform Architect or equivalent architecture leadership role.
* Application Lifecycle Management, including e.g. transports, monitoring, testing and documentation using Solution Manager, CloudALM and/or third party tools.
* S/4HANA conversion, preferably with experience in optimizing downtime.
* Experience with SAP BTP platform architecture, account models, service enablement, for example linked to AI.

**Nice to have**:


The following experience is a plus, but not mandatory:

* SAP Security, including roles and authorisation design.
* Integration technology (PI/PO, CPI, Integration Suite).
* Custom development on stack and side-by-side in BTP or non-SAP platforms.
* SAP licensing and commercial models (on-premise, RISE, BTP and cloud subscriptions).
* FinOps, linking cloud consumption with financial processes, both for public cloud and credit-based solutions such as BTP, BDC, AI and PCE/RISE.
* Experience working with Enterprise Architecture frameworks.

**Where you will be:**


This is a full-time position based in Electrolux Group's headquarters in Stockholm in the Stadshagen district of Kungsholmen.


We offer 20% workplace flexibility, while maintaining the collaboration, connectivity, and team spirit that come from working together at our Global Headquarters.


With more than 60 nationalities under one roof, you will be part of a dynamic international environment where English is the common language and diversity is part of everyday life.

**Benefits highlights:**

* Generous vacation allowance and a range of family-friendly benefits, including extended paternity leave.
* Comprehensive insurance coverage.
* Discounts on our award-winning Electrolux products and services.
* Extensive learning and development opportunities, with flexible career paths.
* Access to in-house sports facilities.


We look forward to receiving your application!


As part of Electrolux, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you.

description:

 Vi söker en senior fullstackutvecklare med stark DevOps-profil som kan ta ett helhetsansvar genom hela utvecklingskedjan. Rollen kombinerar mjukvaruutveckling med teknisk styrning, integrationsarbete, miljöhantering och driftsättning.

title: AI Engineer Stockholm
description:
**Jobbeskrivning**
 Vill du vara med och skapa verkligt värde med hjälp av generativ AI? Hos Sopra Steria får du arbeta nära både kunder och kollegor i uppdrag där modern AI-teknik används för att utveckla och implementera lösningar som gör skillnad på riktigt.
   

  

 Vi arbetar med allt från intelligenta assistenter och RAG-baserade lösningar till AI-agenter och automatiserade, integrerade lösningar baserade på Agentic Process Automation. Nu söker vi en erfaren AI Engineer som vill vara med och ta generativ AI från idé och prototyp till robusta lösningar i verkliga kundmiljöer.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Som AI Engineer blir du en del av vårt AI & Analytics-team och arbetar i kunduppdrag med hög innovationshöjd. I rollen kommer du bland annat att:
   

  

* Designa, utveckla och implementera lösningar baserade på generativ AI och LLM:er
* Arbeta med RAG, AI-agenter och andra moderna arkitekturer för generativ AI
* Utveckla lösningar på moderna molnplattformar, exempelvis Microsoft Azure AI Foundry
* Integrera AI-lösningar med befintliga system, data och verksamhetsprocesser
* Arbeta nära kundens verksamhet och tekniska organisation för att omsätta behov till skalbara lösningar
* Bidra med teknisk kompetens och perspektiv kring hur generativ AI kan skapa konkret affärsvärde


**Vem vi söker**
 Vi söker dig som redan har hunnit bygga upp gedigen praktisk erfarenhet inom generativ AI och som har arbetat med att utveckla AI-lösningar i professionella miljöer. Du är tekniskt stark, nyfiken på utvecklingen inom området och trivs i gränslandet mellan teknik och verksamhet.
   

  

**Vi ser att du har:**
* Minst 2–3 års praktisk erfarenhet av att utveckla lösningar inom generativ AI, exempelvis med LLM:er, RAG och AI-agenter
* Erfarenhet av att utveckla och implementera AI-lösningar på Microsoft Azure, Azure AI Foundry eller motsvarande plattform
* Minst 3 års erfarenhet av Python eller andra relevanta programmeringsspråk
* God förståelse för systemutveckling, API:er, integrationer och hur AI-lösningar passar in i större tekniska ekosystem
* Erfarenhet av att ta AI-lösningar från prototyp eller proof of concept till implementation
* Förmåga att arbeta nära kunder och verksamhet och omsätta behov till tekniska lösningar
* Flytande svenska och engelska i tal och skrift


*Det är meriterande om du även har erfarenhet av:*
* Agentic AI och utveckling av lösningar där flera AI-agenter, verktyg eller system samverkar
* Utvärdering, övervakning och kvalitetssäkring av generativa AI-lösningar
* Data Science, maskininlärning och statistisk modellering
* Dataplattformar, Data Warehousing och datamodellering
* Microsoft Fabric, Databricks eller motsvarande moderna dataplattformar
* Konsultrollen och att driva tekniska dialoger direkt med kund


**Vad vi erbjuder**
*Hos oss får du:*
* Spännande kunduppdrag där du utvecklar lösningar baserade på den senaste AI-tekniken
* Möjlighet att arbeta med hela kedjan, från idé och arkitektur till implementation och vidareutveckling
* Möjlighet att påverka hur vi utvecklar vårt erbjudande inom generativ AI
* Ett starkt nätverk av kollegor inom AI, Analytics och modern systemutveckling
* En miljö där du får fortsätta utvecklas tillsammans med kompetenta och erfarna kollegor
* Flexibilitet att arbeta både på plats och remote beroende på uppdrag


**Ansök nu – vi ser fram emot att träffa dig!**
 Vi behandlar ansökningar och kallar till intervju löpande.
   

  

 På Sopra Steria ställer vi höga krav på både kompetens och säkerhetsmedvetenhet hos våra medarbetare. Innan en eventuell anställning kommer du därför att genomgå en bakgrundskontroll, och vid intervju behöver du kunna uppvisa giltig legitimation.
   

  

 Rekryteringsprocessen består av tre intervjuer, personlighet- och logiktest, referenstagning och bakgrundskontroll. Kombinationen av urvalsmetoder ger oss en bredare och mer rättvis bild av dig som kandidat och ger dig möjlighet att visa din kompetens och potential från flera perspektiv.

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Databases - Analytics | Sweden | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
   

  

 We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
   

  

 You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
   

  

**This is a remote opportunity, and we would be interested in applicants located in Spain, Sweden, UK, Ireland or Germany.**
**The Opportunity**
 At Grafana Labs, we build observability tools that help users understand, respond to, and improve their systems – regardless of scale, complexity, or tech stack. We recently started a skunkworks initiative with a mission to bring observability to the rest of the business. Our goal is to make Grafana the single best place where humans and AI agents understand and act on real-time data from across the enterprise. As part of this initiative, we are building an AI-native data intelligence system that gives agents reliable, governed access to enterprise context. This system helps agents retrieve the right data, metadata, definitions, lineage, quality signals, and institutional knowledge without every agent builder having to maintain their own brittle context files. The principle is simple: the context system retrieves, agents decide, and data teams maintain the intelligence.
   

  

 The new team is a mix of seasoned Grafanistas and new hires. We operate with a high degree of autonomy and ownership, both as individuals and as a team. Engineers are empowered to make decisions, move quickly, and validate ideas early – while being supported by a deeply collaborative culture that values curiosity, feedback, and cross-functional partnership.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Senior Software (Database) Engineer to help build the underlying storage system for our general purpose data platform. The database layer has both OLAP and OTLP capabilities to support classic analytics queries while also serving up freshly stored data. It embraces the separation of compute and storage and is designed to run on multiple cloud providers. This is an early-stage role on a high-autonomy team, so you should be comfortable working through ambiguity, making pragmatic architectural decisions, and building systems that can evolve from internal dogfooding to production-grade SaaS. As the team matures, there’s a broad opportunity to expand or redefine this role based on impact and initiative.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Take ownership over and build one or multiple parts of the database: Design, implement, test, and operate ingestion, query planning, distributed query execution, data formats, storage formats.
* Create a scalable SaaS foundation: Help define and build the architecture for a multi-tenant database service, including tenant isolation, usage tracking, quotas, audit logs, background jobs, and reliable service boundaries.
* Power agent-facing retrieval workflows: Build APIs and database interfaces that allow AI agents, MCP tools, CLIs, and internal applications to retrieve data quickly.
* Work across product and infrastructure: Partner with the team to make practical tradeoffs between fast experimentation and long-term reliability, especially as the project moves from prototype to production.
* Operate what you build: Instrument database services with metrics, logs, traces, alerts, and dashboards. Use observability tools to understand system behavior and improve reliability.
* Contribute to technical direction: Help shape the architecture, service boundaries, storage choices, API contracts, deployment patterns, and engineering practices for a new product area.
* Effective communication: You’ll be working in a highly dynamic and collaborative environment, so we need someone who can communicate effectively and contribute across teams.
* Ownership and impact: Take full ownership of the database solutions you develop, ensuring they are not only innovative but also scalable, maintainable, and aligned with real user workflows.


**What Makes You a Great Fit**
* Strong engineering skills: Solid experience building production-grade, user-facing software systems. You’re a self-starter, capable of tackling complex engineering problems and making design decisions with minimal supervision.
* AI experience with a practical mindset: You’re familiar with AI technologies and frameworks, and you focus on delivering high-quality solutions that work in the real world, not just in theory.
* Quick iteration and experimentation: You’re comfortable releasing prototypes, collecting feedback, and iterating with a pragmatic mindset.
* Proven initiative: You take ownership and drive projects forward, pushing boundaries to find the most impactful solutions. You can deal with ambiguity and are able to define scope where things are loosely defined.
* Collaborative attitude: You communicate effectively with your peers. You’re open to feedback, and you bring a solutions-oriented mindset to the table.
* Experience with distributed systems, catalogs and table formats, query engines.
* Mastery of a programming language like golang, C++, or Rust
* Proven track record of delivering software that made it into production and is actively used by users.
* Exposure to working in cloud-native environments (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).
* Experience using observability tools to understand and troubleshoot system behavior.


**Bonus Points For**
* Experience building distributed query engines.
* Experience building data warehouses and/or data lakes.
* Experience building tools for data engineering.


**How We Work**
 We are a remote-first team that meets regularly over video and does most of our work asynchronously, in writing. We value creativity, diverse perspectives, and clear communication. Tempo is relied upon by prominent global organizations to monitor critical applications and infrastructure, and we expect everyone on the team, including our Staff engineers, to contribute ideas that make it a more reliable, more useful, and more loved product.
   

  

**Compensation & Rewards**
 In Sweden, the Base compensation range for this role is SEK 775,000 - SEK 969,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits listed here.
   

  

* Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process
* Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.


**Why You’ll Thrive At Grafana Labs**
* 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
* Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
* Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
* Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
* Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
* Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
* Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
* Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
* Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
* In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
* Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. \*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.


**Equal Opportunity Employer:** 
*Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.*
*Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.*
*For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.*

title: Enterprise Account Executive, AI Natives
description:
MongoDB is looking for a highly accomplished, results-oriented individual with exceptional energy, intellectual curiosity, and entrepreneurial initiative to significantly expand our presence within the startup ecosystem. This AI Natives EAE role is critical for proactively identifying and cultivating strategic, net-new relationships with high-potential startup founders and executive decision-makers, while concurrently forging deep, impactful partnerships across the AI landscape, and expertly guiding complex sales cycles within an assigned territory.
   

  

 This role is deeply connected to MongoDB’s vision to become the Data Platform for AI, and you’ll be at the forefront of that mission. You will be focused on winning the fastest-growing organizations in the world’s most concentrated AI hub.
   

  

 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Amsterdam, Stockholm or Copenhagen for our hybrid working model.
   

  

 What you will be doing
   

  

* Serve as a pivotal leader within MongoDB GTM, working cross-functionally with Marketing and Product Leadership directly influencing and driving MongoDB’s market penetration within the VC and startup ecosystem
* Architect and execute highly sophisticated, data-driven go-to-market strategies for the assigned AI Native territory, identifying key market segments and opportunities for exponential growth
* Drive executive-level engagement and influence within the startup community, with a particular focus on C-suite technical decision makers, visionary founders, and strategic investors
* Cultivate and maintain profound, long-term relationships with founders, VCs, key developers, and technical architects to (1) secure net-new logos within the startup ecosystem, (2) identify, establish, and mature strategic product and go-to-market partnerships, and (3) consistently exceed top-line revenue targets
* Develop and evangelize a comprehensive, expert-level understanding of MongoDB products, the competitive landscape, and partner technologies, positioning MongoDB as a thought leader


 Who You Are
   

  

* 8+ years of consistent quota-carrying field experience in highly competitive and rapidly evolving markets, with a proven track record of selling technically complex enterprise solutions at scale
* Exceptional intellectual curiosity and a demonstrated commitment to continuous learning and professional development
* A profound history of identifying, building, and nurturing executive-level champions within your customer-base, and successfully navigating highly complex, multi-stakeholder sales processes
* Mastery in translating intricate technical concepts and nuanced technical challenges into compelling, quantifiable business value and strategic outcomes for customers
* Possess an inherent drive, intense competitiveness, and an insatiable desire to achieve extraordinary success and exceed expectations
* Must reside within the assigned territory and be willing to maintain a significant in-office presence (3+ days per week) to foster collaboration and team cohesion


 Things we love
   

  

* A passionate commitment to continuous learning and a strong aspiration to lead and define your career trajectory
* A proven ability to contribute significantly to building something truly special and scaling a high-growth business unit
* Deep familiarity with advanced software development concepts, emerging technologies, and a nuanced understanding of diverse developer and technical personas
* Extensive experience and a strong preference for selling to highly technical buyers and engineering leadership


**About MongoDB**
 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
   

  

 With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
   

  

 Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
   

  

 To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
   

  

 MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
   

  

 MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.
