title: Product Deployment Engineer - Search/Performace to leading search engine
description:
*We are looking for a Product Deployment Engineer – Search to join the Google App team. The ideal candidate has experience as a Performance Marketing Specialist and will work closely with the team on search-related products and performance. This is a consultancy assignment starting as soon as possible, with an initial duration of up to 12 months.* 




  





 As a Product Deployment Engineer, you manage external clients and/or consult internal teams to exercise your comprehensive knowledge of translating commercial business models/needs into technical solutions. You own and manage relationships with technical and non-technical manager+ level internal and external users/clients/partners/stakeholders and deliver excellent customer care to achieve project goals. You manage project outcomes and are a key contributor, creating custom solutions, repeatable solution development, customer requirement gathering and mapping, and solution strategy, scoping, and development. You possess core technical skills and comprehensive knowledge of troubleshooting, systems design, integration, and our technologies and processes, using it to act as an industry specialist in your technical domain.
 



  





**Responsibilities include:** 



* Provide feedback on product requirement documents (PRDs) and design documents; may author or actively drive PRDs, particularly around the developer experience.
* Review product requirement documents (PRDs) to record product specifications, and validate PRDs to ensure customer/partner and internal needs are met.
* Scale existing or create repeatable solutions (e.g., best practices recommendations, tutorials, blog articles, sample code) and ensure effective documentation of repeatable solutions.
* Drive solution code development in collaboration with internal or external developers/users/partners/clients/stakeholders (as needed). Test products/solutions for customers/partners before release through different phases (e.g., internal testing, user acceptance testing). Contribute to resolving bugs and refining product/solutions through feedback collection and iteration.
* Build and maintain strategic relationships with senior stakeholders in customer and/or partner organizations to deliver or manage quality technical solutions and services.
* Define long-term technical solution strategies in collaboration with cross-functional teams and influence the direction and priority of technical product features and/or the solution.
* Define and identify problems at the system level or from a broader perspective and design a workable solution. Moderate understanding of how factors or components in a system interrelate. Contribute to defining the appropriate components at scale, application programming interfaces (APIs), and data for a given system to meet specific requirements of the user and the ability to validate the system correctness and functionality.
* Leverage, customize, or develop solutions based on defined customer/partner business objectives and technical requirements. Drive discussions with internal teams and users/clients/partners/stakeholders to define solution constraints and scope. Help identify the value of solutions through design sessions with the customer/partner.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders in their respective process lifecycle to provide technical guidance or identify possible existing or new technical solution offerings to help shape outcomes. Contribute to indirectly engaging customers and internal teams as part of the process lifecycle.
* Troubleshoot complex technical issues throughout solution delivery and deployment by generating and analyzing relevant data, proposing fixes, and validating solutions.



  





**Skills Required** 




 As a Product Deployment Engineer (Search), you will serve as a strategic technical authority driving customer adoption, performance, and speed to market for Google’s largest advertisers across diverse industry verticals. You will act as a trusted technical advisor, navigating complex ad tech architectures to design, deploy, and scale advanced Google Search and AI-driven advertising solutions.
 



 In this role, you will bridge the gap between commercial strategy and deep technical execution. Working closely with cross-functional sales and product teams, you will deploy cutting-edge Search features—including AI Max for Search, Smart Bidding, advanced data integrations, and feed solutions—ensuring our partners achieve sustainable business growth.
 



  





**Minimum role qualifications require proficiency in:** 



* Opportunity and pipeline management
* Industry knowledge
* Situational leadership
* Debugging and troubleshooting
* Stakeholder management strategy
* Systems Thinking (Knowledge)
* Technical acumen
* Core Tech role related knowledge
* System design or Coding
* Team Management
* Consultative skills

title: Senior Konsult inom Transformation med starkt affärsdriv
description:
Beskrivning av tjänsten
   

  

 Vill du kombinera strategisk rådgivning, transformation och affärsutveckling med ett tydligt fokus på att skapa nya affärer?
   

  

 Du är en konsult med ett starkt kommersiellt tankesätt. Du förstår kunders strategiska utmaningar och kan omsätta behov till konkreta lösningar, erbjudanden och affärer. Samtidigt har du erfarenheten och trovärdigheten att leda förändringsinitiativ och transformationer hos våra kunder.
   

  

 Dina framtida arbetsuppgifter
   

  

 I rollen kommer du att vara en nyckelperson i vår fortsatta tillväxt inom industri, transport och bygg.
   

  

 Du kommer bland annat att:
   

  

* Identifiera och skapa nya affärsmöjligheter hos både befintliga och potentiella kunder.
* Leda och stötta transformationer inom verksamhetsutveckling, digitalisering och förändringsledning.
* Utveckla kundunika erbjudanden tillsammans med CGI:s experter och specialister.
* Bidra till utvecklingen av vårt konsultteam, våra erbjudanden och vår marknadsposition.
* Vara en inspiratör och mentor för kollegor inom försäljning, affärsutveckling och konsultleverans.


 För dig är försäljning en naturlig del av konsultrollen.
   

  

 Du tycker om att skapa nya kontakter och är inte rädd för att ta den första dialogen med en potentiell kund. Du ser möjligheter där andra ser begränsningar och drivs av känslan av att vinna nya affärer och bygga långsiktiga kundrelationer.
   

  

 Samtidigt är du konsultmässig i ditt arbetssätt. Du bygger förtroende genom att förstå kundens verksamhet, ställa rätt frågor och leverera värde. Du är lika bekväm i styrelserummet som i workshoprummet.
   

  

 Kvalifikationer för att bli framgångsrik denna roll
   

  

 Vi tror att du har:
   

  

* Minst 5 års erfarenhet som affärskonsult, verksamhetskonsult eller affärsutvecklare.
* Erfarenhet av komplex försäljning och dialog med ledningsgrupper och seniora beslutsfattare.
* Erfarenhet av verksamhetsutveckling, digitalisering, transformation eller förändringsledning.
* Kunskap inom industri, transport, bygg eller närliggande branscher.
* Akademisk utbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet.
* Mycket god förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska.


**Låt oss som ägare omvandla verklig insikt till handling – tillsammans.**
 Livet på CGI bygger på ägande, lagarbete, respekt och tillhörighet. Tillsammans med oss kommer du att kunna nå din fulla potential.
   

  

 Du är inbjuden att ta ägandeskap redan från första dagen i vårt arbete med att förverkliga vår dröm om att skapa en arbetsmiljö där vi trivs med att arbeta tillsammans och bidrar till framgången för vårt företag. Det är därför vi kallar oss CGI Partners snarare än anställda. Vi drar nytta av vår kollektiva framgång och tillsammans får vi möjlighet att aktivt forma vår företagsstrategi och inriktning.
   

  

 Ditt arbete skapar värde. Du kommer att vara med att utveckla innovativa lösningar och bygga relationer med medarbetare och kunder samtidigt som du får tillgång till globala möjligheter att skala upp dina idéer, omfamna nya möjligheter och dra nytta av gedigen bransch- och teknikexpertis.
   

  

 Du kommer att forma din karriär tillsammans med ett företag som är byggt för att växa och bestå. Du får stöd av ledare som bryr sig om din hälsa och ditt välbefinnande och ger dig möjligheter att fördjupa dina kunskaper och vidga dina vyer.
   

  

 Bli en del en av världens största leverantörer av IT- och affärskonsulttjänster.

title: Postdoktor i mjukvaruteknologi
description:
**Arbetsuppgifter**




 Arbetet består av
 


* Designa och implementera programvaruprototyper
* Delta i samarbeten inom ramen för programvaruteknisk forskning
* Skriva artiklar och anslag



**Kvalifikationer**




**Krav** 



* Avlagd doktorsexamen eller utländsk examen som bedöms motsvara en doktorsexamen. Detta behörighetskrav ska vara uppfyllt senast vid tidpunkten då anställningsbeslutet fattas.
* Ansökanden bör inneha en doktorsexamen i ett ämne relevant för anställningens forskningsområde. Djup kunskap och erfarenhet inom formella metoder är ett krav, och likaså bra programmeringsfärdigheter.



**Meriterande** 



* Vid sista ansökningsdag högst tre år sedan doktorsexamen eller en utländsk examen som bedöms motsvara doktorsexamen avlades.
* Specialisering inom mjukvaruutveckling, N-1.
* Erfarenhet av forskning inom laboratorium är ett plus.
* Erfarenhet av systemprogrammering och datorsäkerhet är fördelaktigt.
* Vetenskaplig skicklighet.
* Pedagogisk förmåga.
* Medvetenhet om mångfalds- och likabehandlingsfrågor med särskilt fokus på jämställdhet.
* Samarbetsförmåga.
* Självständighet.



 Vi kommer att lägga stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper.
   

  





**Bli en del av KTH**




 KTH formar framtiden genom utbildning, forskning och innovation. Som ett ledande internationellt tekniskt universitet spelar vi en aktiv roll i att driva och medverka i omställningen till ett hållbart samhälle. Här erbjuds du möjligheten att växa och utvecklas på en kreativ och dynamisk arbetsplats med goda arbetsvillkor och förmåner. Jämställdhet, mångfald och lika villkor är en kvalitetsfråga och en självklar del av KTH:s värdegrund som universitet och statlig myndighet.
   

  





 Läs mer om våra förmåner och hur det är att arbeta och utvecklas på KTH.
   

  





**Fackliga representanter**




 Kontaktuppgifter till
 
 fackliga representanter.
   

  





**Ansökan**




 Du ansöker via KTH:s rekryteringssystem. Du som sökande har huvudansvaret för att din ansökan är komplett när den skickas in.
   

  





 Ansökan ska innehålla: 
 


* CV inklusive relevant yrkeserfarenhet och kunskap.
* Kopia av examensbevis och betyg från dina tidigare universitetsstudier. Översättningar till engelska eller svenska om de ursprungliga dokumenten inte utfärdas på något av dessa språk.
* Kortfattad redogörelse för varför du vill bedriva forskning, dina akademiska intressen och hur de relaterar till dina tidigare studier och framtida mål. max 2 sidor lång.



 Ansökan ska vara KTH tillhanda senast sista ansökningsdagen vid midnatt, CET/CEST (Central European Time/Central European Summer Time).
   

  





**Om anställningen**




 Anställningen gäller tillsvidare, dock längst två år
   

  





 En anställning som postdoktor är en tidsbegränsad meriteringsanställning med huvudinriktning mot forskning avsedd som ett första karriärsteg efter disputation.
   

  





**Övrigt**




 För information om behandling av personuppgifter i samband med rekrytering.
   

  





 Det kan förekomma att en anställning hos KTH är placerad i säkerhetsklass. Om så är fallet för just denna anställning görs en säkerhetsprövning av sökande i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) efter samtycke. I dessa fall är en förutsättning för anställning att sökande blir godkänd efter säkerhetsprövning.
   

  





 Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av platsannonser.

title: Account Executive
description:
Grow with us
   

  

 Upsales was founded in 2003, grew without a single outside investor, and has been profitable ever since. No VC pressure. No compromises. Just a product customers keep paying for.
   

  

 We build the leading CRM and AI platform for B2B sales, and we're now in our highest growth phase in years, one of the very few SaaS companies growing profitably while staying genuinely ahead on AI.
   

  

 If you want real autonomy, colleagues who push you, and work that moves the needle from day one, you'll fit right in.
   

  

 Account Executive
   

  

 We’re looking for a world-class Account Executive to join our high-performance sales team, the spearhead of our growth engine. This is a chance to be part of one of the most effective AI software sales teams in the Nordics, a team built around high ownership, high ambition, and a shared belief that we’re building something truly category-defining.
   

  

 This isn’t a customer success role. And it’s not just about closing deals. This is
 **strategic, consultative selling at the highest level,** 
 working closely with C-level stakeholders as a trusted advisor, a growth partner, and a commercial leader.
   

  

 You’ll be supported by a high-performing team of solution engineers and go-to-market colleagues, but you own the outcome. Success in this role requires more than hitting quota, it requires curiosity, strategic thinking, and the ability to connect the dots between a company’s problems and the potential of Upsales AI.
   

  

 This is a role for someone who wants to sell at the highest level, who thrives in fast-paced, high-performance teams, and who’s motivated by the chance to help reshape how companies grow.
   

  

**AI first mindset**
 We’re not looking for someone who simply uses AI. We want someone who weaponizes it. You treat tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI copilots as force multipliers, allowing you to deliver at a level and speed others can’t match. For you, AI isn’t an add-on, it’s the default operating system for how you think, work, and lead. You’re relentlessly curious about new capabilities, and you push the limits of what’s possible, turning AI into a competitive advantage for yourself, Upsales, and our customers. This is a role for someone with real ambition: someone who wants to set a new standard for efficiency, precision, and impact in the age of AI.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Drive end-to-end new business. From prospecting to negotiation and close.
* Create and execute strategic outbound campaigns toward key verticals and segments.
* Engage with CEOs, CROs, and other revenue leaders to identify growth opportunities.
* Position Upsales AI as a must-have platform for data-driven sales and marketing teams.
* Collaborate with product, marketing, and solution engineers to craft winning proposals.
* Build a strong, predictable pipeline, and consistently exceed your targets.


**Who We're Looking For**
 This isn’t an entry-level role, we’re looking for someone who has already
 **proven they can win at the highest level** 
 .
   

  

* At least 5 years of proven experience in complex SaaS B2B sales
* A degree from a respected academic institution, preferably in the technical or economic field
* A strong track record of meeting and exceeding targets
* Experience building long-term relationships with fast-growing mid-sized companies
* A proactive, ambitious mindset with full ownership of the sales process
* Excellent communication skills in both English and Swedish
* Driven by growth, responsibility, and the ambition to build something meaningful


 Personality-wise? You’re
 **obsessed with winning** 
 , but never at the expense of the team. You take pride in delivering results, but you’re also the kind of person who jumps in to help a teammate close a deal or solve a tough problem. You raise the bar, and bring others with you.
   

  

 Read our Culture Playbook to learn more about life at Upsales.
   

  

*As part of your application, we'd love to give you the chance to share a bit more about yourself. After applying, you'll receive an email from our partner Fika Jobs, which helps us get to know you beyond your CV. Creating a Fika profile is completely optional - but we do recommend it, as it gives us a fuller picture of who you are. Either way, we'll review your application carefully.*
 Upsales was founded in 2003, grew without a single outside investor, and has been profitable ever since. No VC pressure. No compromises. Just a product customers keep paying for.
   

  

 We're now in our highest growth phase in years, one of the very few SaaS companies growing profitably while staying genuinely ahead on AI.
   

  

 If you want real autonomy, colleagues who push you, and work that moves the needle from day one, you'll fit right in.

title: Head of Law Firms
description:
**About Us**
 Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
   

  

 Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.
   

  

 1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to
 **$100M+ in ARR** 
 , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.
   

  

 We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
   

  

 Joining Legora means three things.
   

  

* We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
* We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
* We grow together: as a team and with our customers.


 Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
   

  

 If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Legal Engineering sits at the intersection of legal practice, product, enterprise change and commercial execution.
   

  

 As Team Lead for Law Firms across Scandinavia and the Baltics, you will report to the Head of Legal Engineering, North EMEA and lead a team of Legal Engineers from Stockholm. This is a manager role, but it requires the craft credibility and scope of someone already operating at senior Legal Engineering level. You will stay close enough to the work to coach from first-hand evidence, set weekly priorities, raise delivery quality, manage capacity and escalations, and personally lead selected strategic engagements where senior judgment matters.
   

  

 The regional opportunity has two distinct parts. Scandinavian firms are sophisticated adopters. The next phase is deeper practice-group adoption, clearer proof of value, competitive renewals and expansion. The Baltic market is earlier and more concentrated, with a realistic opportunity to help the leading firms establish how AI becomes part of everyday legal work.
   

  

 This is a player-coach manager role for someone who can combine first-line leadership with Lead Legal Engineer or Director-level judgment. Your success will be measured by the quality and independence of the team, the outcomes customers achieve, and the methods that continue to work without you in every room.
   

  

 What you'll be doing
   

  

* Lead the day-to-day operating rhythm for the law-firm Legal Engineering team, including priorities, 1:1s, coaching, capacity, quality review and escalation.
* Translate regional commercial priorities into clear weekly execution across accounts. Keep every material pilot, rollout, renewal and expansion tied to a named owner, next step, risk signal, governance forum and measurable outcome.
* Lead selected high-value law-firm engagements from discovery to go-live, especially where the customer problem is ambiguous, senior-stakeholder heavy or commercially important. Turn legal problems into credible workflows, agree success measures and help firms move from isolated use cases to repeatable adoption across practice groups.
* Build trusted relationships with Managing Partners, practice leaders, innovation and knowledge teams, IT leaders and day-to-day champions. Create the conditions for bad news and blockers to surface early.
* Partner closely with Go-to-Market and Engagement on conversion, usage, renewal and expansion. Bring legal judgment into commercial decisions, shape the service model for strategic accounts and make the value of Legal Engineering visible.
* Coach Legal Engineers on demos, workshops, programme plans, stakeholder communications and difficult client moments. Step in when required, then return ownership rather than keeping it.
* Build a strong sponsor-and-champion model inside customer firms so that implementation has both day-to-day energy and senior decision-making support.
* Turn recurring client patterns into reusable templates, checklists, recordings, narratives and playbooks that improve delivery across the region and raise the standard for how the team serves sophisticated law firms.
* Represent the voice of Scandinavian and Baltic law firms inside Legora. Log product gaps with evidence, translate field patterns into actionable requirements, propose practical fixes and follow through with Product.
* Hire and ramp strong Legal Engineers. Apply a consistent bar in interviews, give new joiners clear expectations and shorten the path to independent client work.
* Protect quality and sustainable pace while the team grows. Challenge poorly scoped work, surface structural capacity issues early and prevent the team from becoming dependent on heroics.


 What good looks like
   

  

 This is a senior player-coach manager role requiring full autonomy across high-value, multi-stakeholder and often multi-product engagements. The impact should show up in faster adoption, better time to value, stronger customer outcomes across more than one account, and a team that produces more consistent work because of how it is led.
   

  

* Product knowledge and application. You own priority use cases from discovery to go-live with measurable success targets. You connect product choices to the firm's legal and commercial goals, define what great looks like for large programmes, produce assets others can reuse, and turn product gaps into evidence-based recommendations.
* Communication. You lead meetings, workshops and demos with senior law-firm stakeholders. You explain how Legora creates measurable value in business terms, handle complex objections cleanly and adapt your register across partners, associates, innovation leads and technical teams.
* Project and programme management. You lead detailed planning for complex enterprise work, using standard methods where they help and varying the playbook where the context demands it. You keep owners, dependencies, risks, governance and outcomes visible, then adjust quickly when reality changes.
* Stakeholder management. You build trusted senior relationships, identify concerns before they become blockers, influence priorities and navigate conflict between stakeholder groups. You can operate credibly with managing partners, practice leaders and executive sponsors while coaching less experienced Legal Engineers to own relationships themselves.
* Thought leadership. You lead substantive discussions on how AI will change law-firm work and economics. You synthesise field evidence into credible client narratives, contribute original ideas to the roadmap, represent Legora's point of view in senior forums and help the wider team develop a sharper point of view.


 How you lead as a first-line manager
   

  

**Strong First-line Leadership In This Role Looks Like This**
* Hiring judgment and partnership. You are active in sourcing, interviews, case calibration, closing and onboarding. You partner tightly with Talent and keep the quality bar stable when growth pressure rises.
* Talent development and accountability. Your team knows where they stand. You run regular 1:1s, give early written feedback and create clear development plans. You invest in coaching and act when the evidence shows that the slope is not changing.
* Ownership, delegation and operating rhythm. You own team outcomes without taking back every task. Priorities, decision rights, leading indicators and dependencies are clear. Team members hold real areas of ownership, and the team can run day to day without you present.
* Team-first leadership and culture. You give the team credit and take accountability for misses. You create stretch opportunities, show up when pressure rises and build enough trust that risks and bad news travel early.
* Performance bar and decisive judgment. You set a clear standard, identify underperformance early and distinguish coachable gaps from persistent misses. Decisions are evidence-based, timely, fair and humane.


 The practical test is simple: the team should produce better work, stronger people and more repeatable customer outcomes because of how you lead, rather than because you personally carried every important engagement.
   

  

 What success looks like after 12 months
   

  

* The team has a clear weekly rhythm, reliable account ownership and fewer late escalations.
* Every team member knows what strong performance looks like, where they stand and what they are developing toward.
* Strategic law-firm pilots and rollouts have explicit value measures, senior sponsorship and credible paths into renewal or expansion.
* Customer learning travels across markets through reusable playbooks rather than remaining with one person or account.
* The team has visible informal owners and successors, with less dependence on the Team Lead for routine decisions.
* Go-to-Market, Engagement and Product treat the team as a high-trust partner with sound legal, product and commercial judgment.


 What you bring
   

  

 You may come from a leading law firm, legal innovation or knowledge, legal operations, professional services, legal technology, or a combination of those worlds. The common thread is evidence that you have improved how sophisticated lawyers work and helped other people raise their standard.
   

  

**You Will Thrive In This Role If You**
* Bring substantial experience of sophisticated law-firm work and the judgment to influence senior legal stakeholders. A Scandinavian legal qualification is preferred but not required; equivalent credibility can come from legal innovation, knowledge, legal operations, professional services or legal technology.
* Bring substantial senior experience, often around 8+ years of relevant work. Scope, autonomy, repeated impact and evidence of operating at Lead Legal Engineer or Director-level scope matter more than tenure alone.
* Understand law-firm economics, partner incentives, practice-group dynamics and the tension between innovation, quality, risk and billable work.
* May have managed people directly, which is an advantage, but it is not a prerequisite. This can be a growth move into formal management if you can show repeated evidence of first-line leadership through coaching, feedback, delegation, hiring or performance judgment.
* Can personally lead a difficult client workshop, demo or programme while developing others to do the same.
* Are deeply curious about generative AI and product. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you must be able to test workflows, challenge assumptions and explain limits accurately.
* Connect Legal Engineering work to commercial outcomes, including conversion, adoption, usage, renewal and expansion, and know how to make that value visible to GTM, Engagement and senior customer stakeholders.
* Bring structure to ambiguity without creating process for its own sake. Your systems make decisions faster, quality more consistent and team execution less dependent on individual heroics.
* Communicate fluently in English. Any Scandinavian language is preferred but not required.
* Are based in Stockholm and able to work from the office five days per week. You are also comfortable travelling across Scandinavia and the Baltics for strategic customers, team leadership and market work.


 A few more things
   

  

 You will inherit real customer proof, a fast-growing Stockholm team and a region with material commercial momentum. You will also inherit the useful mess that comes with scale: uneven adoption, competitive renewals, local-market differences, new joiners who need to ramp quickly and a management layer still being built.
   

  

 The right person will enjoy that combination. They will be credible with a senior partner, practical with the team doing the work and disciplined enough to turn strong individual execution into a system.
   

  

**Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer**
 At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: IT Compliance Officer, Solna
description:
Are you passionate about turning complex regulations into smart, business-friendly solutions?
   

  

 Do you thrive in environments where structure meets innovation and where your work directly strengthens digital trust across an entire organization?
   

  

 At PostNord, we are on a mission to build a resilient and transparent cybersecurity landscape that supports our digital transformation. As our new IT Compliance Officer, you will be at the heart of this journey and leading our compliance efforts across NIS2, IT General Controls (ITGC), and ISO/IEC 27001:2022. This is a unique opportunity to shape how we govern, report, and continuously improve our IT security posture across the Nordics.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As IT Compliance Officer, you will play a pivotal role in PostNord’s CyberSecurity team. You will take ownership of our compliance framework across NIS2, IT General Controls (ITGC), and ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ensuring that our policies, controls, and processes are not only compliant - but effective, scalable and aligned with our business goals.
   

  

**You Will Also**
* Design and operate an integrated compliance program that enables risk-based reporting to leadership and external stakeholders.
* Ensure our controls are well-designed, implemented, and operating effectively — with clear evidence and audit readiness.
* Coordinate internal and external audits and act as a trusted point of contact for auditors and regulators.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Procurement, Finance, HR, and product/solution owners to translate standards into practical, business-friendly controls.
* Ensure ITGC governance is followed across key stakeholders, and coordinate control execution, evidence collection, and remediation tracking.
* Support OT Security in aligning NIS2 and ISO requirements with operational technology policies and roles.
* Deliver quarterly dashboards and insights to the IT Leadership Team and Group Leadership Team, supporting strategic decision-making.


**Who are we looking for?**
 To succeed in this role, you need to be based in the greater Stockholm area, as close collaboration with teams and stakeholders on-site is an important part of the role. We are looking for someone who thrives in a structured environment but knows how to navigate complexity. You bring a pragmatic approach to problem-solving, with a sharp eye for detail and a strong sense of structure. Your deep technical knowledge is matched by your ability to communicate clearly and concisely, whether you are presenting to leadership, collaborating with external auditors, or aligning with internal stakeholders. You build trust across departments, foster collaboration, and know how to turn regulatory frameworks into practical, business-friendly solutions that support both compliance and innovation.
   

  

* A university degree or equivalent experience.
* 7+ years of experience in information security, IT audit/assurance, or risk with at least 3 years leading compliance or assurance programs.
* Expertise in ISMS design and operation, ITGC domains, and control mapping.
* Bonus points for certifications such as ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, CISA, CISM, or CRISC.


**We Offer You**
 We are a modern, customer-oriented company that cares as much about our employees as we do about our customers. With us, you are offered a varied job in an international environment with constant new challenges and quick decisions. In addition to fair employment conditions according to collective agreements, we offer you:
   

  

* Flexible hybrid workplace. Watch the film about our office.
* Great development opportunities
* Great insurance and occupational pension terms
* Wellness allowance & opportunity to train at Arken's gym and indoor swimming pool
* Employee benefits through PostNord Plus - PostNord´s own personnel foundation


**About Us**
 PostNord is the leading supplier of communication and logistics solutions to, from, and within the Nordic region. We ensure the provision of a postal service to households and businesses in Sweden and Denmark. We aim to make everyday life easier and more sustainable for everyone who lives and works in the Nordic region. We are in a constant transformation and work consistently to develop both our offer and our employees, all to achieve our vision of being The favourite carrier of the Nordics. We are PostNord - a fantastic company to work and grow with. Read more at group.postnord.com
   

  

**Apply**
 Welcome to submit your application! The selection is ongoing, so please apply as soon as possible. If you have any questions or concerns, please email erkan.kahraman@postnord.com.
   

  

 We look forward to hearing from you!
   

  

 For union representatives, visit: www.postnord.com/fackliga

title: Sales & Partnerships Manager - Uber Health & Transit (Nordics)
description:
**About The Role**
 Uber Health & Transit is a rapidly growing division dedicated to bridging public and private
   

  

 transport to create more efficient, accessible, and sustainable systems. Reporting to the Head of EMEA Health & Transit Partnerships, you will lead our expansion across the Nordic
   

  

 region, with a primary hub in Stockholm.
   

  

 This is a strategic, consultative enterprise sales role operating within structured procurement environments. You will be responsible for acquiring and launching new public sector and enterprise customers, working with healthcare organisations, local authorities, transport providers, and regional governments to reduce private car dependency and improve patient mobility.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Pipeline & Territory Management: Own the end-to-end sales process across the Nordics, from prospecting and qualifying opportunities to negotiating agreements and managing a robust pipeline of ARR and booking targets.
* Strategic Growth: Identify and develop sub-vertical strategies across healthcare, social care, public transport agencies, and insurers to expand Uber's non-emergency patient transport and paratransit solutions.
* Tender & Procurement Leadership: Lead discovery conversations and collaborate with the Bids & Proposals team to develop compelling commercial responses for formal public procurement processes and tenders.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Build and navigate complex relationships with senior decision-makers and influencers within Nordic public bodies and transport operators.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Policy, Legal, Operations, and Product teams to structure high-impact solutions and ensure successful long-term customer launches.
* Implementation & Success: Take ownership of light post-sale implementation and early issue resolution to champion long-term partnership success.


**What You'll Need**
* Experience: 5+ years of B2B enterprise sales or business development experience, with a proven track record of exceeding KPIs and revenue goals.
* Public Sector Expertise: Experience selling into regulated environments, public transport agencies, or healthcare bodies, including experience with structured public procurement frameworks.
* Mindset: A self-starter with the resilience to operate independently in a fast-paced environment and the patience to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder buying cycles
* Technical Fluency: Proficiency in Salesforce (SFDC) and modern sales engagement tools (e.g., ZoomInfo, Lusha, Apollo).
* Regional Proficiency: Exceptional communication skills in English and at least one Nordic language (Swedish preferred, or Norwegian, Danish, or Finnish).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Direct experience working with Nordic local authorities, regional health boards, or national transport operators
* Familiarity with mobility-as-a-service (MaaS), healthcare transport, transport technology, or health technologies or adjacent industries.
* A genuine passion for sustainable mobility and its power to improve lives and strengthen communities.


 ~~ ~~
   

  

**Ready to Ride?**
 This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

 You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.
   

  

 Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.
   

  

 Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

title: Principal Product Manager - Personalization
description:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.
   

  

 Spotify Search handles billions of queries across every market, language, and content type — music, podcasts, audiobooks, videos, playlists, and more. We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead the Search Personalization within our Conversation Product Area, setting the product strategy for how hundreds of millions of users find and discover content on Spotify. This is a leadership role at the intersection of search systems, AI, and user experience. You’ll own the end-to-end strategy for search results — from ranking and relevance to AI-powered features like semantic search, LLM reranking, and AI Overviews — while leading two key Search squads (results ranking and query suggestions). Search is the front door to Spotify; this role shapes what people find when they walk through it.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Set the product strategy and multi-cycle roadmap for Search Personalization at Spotify — spanning ranking, relevance, retrieval, AI-native features, quality, and trust.
* Drive the evolution of Search toward AI-native experiences — AI Overviews, semantic search, LLM reranking — balancing innovation velocity with quality and cost discipline.
* Own the Search quality bar: define how relevance, trust, compliance, and user experience connect into a holistic quality framework with measurable outcomes.
* Manage Search’s role as a shared surface across many company strategies — build prioritization frameworks, communicate trade-offs, and represent Search at executive forums.
* Influence and coach junior PMs working in Search.
* Partner with engineering leadership to make architectural decisions that balance short-term delivery with long-term Search infrastructure health.
* Drive cross-functional alignment where Search intersects.


 Who You Are
   

  

* You have 8+ years of product management experience, with 3+ years leading search, discovery, or information retrieval products at scale (100M+ users).
* You have a deep technical understanding of search systems — ranking architectures, retrieval strategies, evaluation methodology, and the trade-offs between relevance, latency, cost, and freshness.
* You have experience with AI/ML-powered search features — semantic search, LLM-based reranking, recommendations, or similar — and can lead a team through the transition from traditional to AI-native search.
* You have a track record of managing complex stakeholder landscapes with competing priorities and limited resources, and can build frameworks for principled prioritization.
* You think strategically at the portfolio level — you can synthesize across many concurrent initiatives, set a coherent vision, and communicate it clearly to executives.
* You communicate with clarity and conviction, with the ability to translate technical complexity into compelling narratives for leadership, bet owners, and cross-functional partners.
* You have experience mentoring and developing early-career PMs, and can influence without authority or direct reporting lines.
* You bring familiarity with music, audio, or media technology and understand the unique dynamics of content-rich platforms.
* You have experience operating Search as a platform that serves multiple internal teams or content verticals.
* You have worked in content integrity, trust & safety, or regulatory compliance in the context of search or discovery systems.


 Where You'll Be
   

  

* This role is based in London or Stockholm.
* We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.


 Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
   

  

 At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Find our AI notice here: https://lifeatspotify.com/ai-notice
   

  

 Today, we are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service.

title: Senior Application Consultant Dynamics 365 CE/CRM
description:
Accigos team inom Customer Engagement & Power Platform söker nu en person med djup kompetens inom Microsoft 365 CE/CRM som vill vara med och driva digital transformation hos våra kunder. Är du en prestigelös person med ett stort intresse för tekniska lösningar? Då kan den här möjligheten vara helt rätt för dig.
   

  

 Vad gör en senior applikationskonsult i vårt team?
   

  

 Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer i första hand vara att stötta teamet i tekniska problemlösningar i form av design och utveckling av lösningsarkitektur för Dynamics Customer Engagement (CRM). Du kommer att genomföra workshops för att analysera kundens affärsbehov och översätta dessa till tekniska krav och se till att utvecklingsteamet kan realisera dem. Du kommer även att arbeta med utveckling av nya system, vidareutveckla befintliga system, arbeta med systemdesign och applikationsutveckling, där ditt ansvar blir att driva tekniskt arbete och forma den framtida arkitekturen.
   

  

 Du kommer att tillhöra ett härligt team med sociala och drivna medarbetare som gillar att ha kul tillsammans både under och efter arbetstid.
   

  

 Kvalifikationer
   

  

* Minst 5 års erfarenhet av Dynamics 365 (Customer Engagement).
* Stark förståelse för CRM-processer, inklusive försäljning, kundservice och marknadsföring.
* Erfarenhet av att leda workshops och skapa tekniska dokumentationer.
* Förmåga att arbeta tvärfunktionellt med utvecklare, projektledare och andra intressenter.
* Certifieringar inom Dynamics 365 eller Azure är meriterande.
* Flytande i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.


 Du kommer att trivas hos oss
   

  

 Det här jobbet passar dig som är lösningsfokuserad, kundfokuserad och kvalitetsmedveten i din yrkesroll. För att passa i rollen behöver du också vara genuin i ditt bemötande med andra människor och har alltid inställningen att ge kunden bästa möjliga upplevelse. Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av agilt arbete och Dynamics 365 CE/CRM och ser det som meriterande om du har arbetat med Microsofts olika molntjänster tidigare.
   

  

**Vårt team**
 Accigos CRM-team består av en härlig mix av människor i olika åldrar, med olika erfarenheter och roller. Det vi alla har gemensamt är ett stort tekniskt intresse i allmänhet och för CRM i synnerhet. Vi brinner för det vi gör och för våra kunder.
   

  

 Vi är ett prestigelöst gäng som värdesätter humor och glädje och har en stöttande kultur där vi alltid hjälper varandra och där alla kan vara sig själva. Vi tycker om att umgås både på och utanför jobbet och olika teamaktiviteter är ett stående inslag.
   

  

 Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta med ny teknik från Microsoft och oftast i team-leveranser, främst med andra från CRM-teamet men även med konsulter från andra affärsområden på Accigo. För oss stärker det vi-känslan och säkrar både en bra leverans gentemot kunden samt glädje och balans i vardagen för oss konsulter.
   

  

 Kompensation och förmåner
   

  

 Vår förmånspolicy är utvecklad för att möta både dina professionella och personliga behov. I vårt omfattande förmånspaket ingår friskvårdsbidrag, tjänstepension och frivillig sjukvårdsförsäkring. Vår ersättningsmodell består av en konkurrenskraftig fast del och en rörlig del som ger dig möjlighet att påverka din lön baserat på din prestation och ambition. Vi erbjuder både professionell och personlig utveckling.
   

  

**Nyfiken?** 
 Vi svarar gärna på frågor, eller berättar mer om oss över en kaffe - du kan enkelt komma i kontakt med oss genom att maila: amir.hosseini@accigo.se
   

  

 Läs gärna mer om oss och träffa våra medarbetare på vår karriärsida: https://karriar.accigo.se/
   

  

 Accigo är ett konsultbolag som hjälper företag och organisationer med digital affärs- och verksamhetsutveckling med tekniken som möjliggörare. För oss handlar digitalisering till 90% om människor och 10% om teknik. Det är när samspelet mellan människa och teknik fungerar som digitaliseringens fulla styrka visar sig.
   

  

 För många handlar digitalisering mest om teknik. För oss är det så otroligt mycket större. Digitalisering kan få både människor och organisationer att våga sikta högre, följa sina drömmar och öppna dörrar som de inte ens visste fanns. Och när man ser igenom tekniken och börjar skönja vilka möjligheter som gömmer sig där bakom. Då ser man att framtiden kan vara en fantastisk plats – fylld av mänsklig energi och värme – och digitalisering är inget annat än vår superkraft för att komma dit.

title: Javautvecklare
description:
**Företagsbeskrivning**
 AFRY erbjuder tjänster inom teknik, design, digitalisering och rådgivning. Vi är dedikerade experter inom industri, energi och infrastruktur och skapar värde för kommande generationer. AFRY har nordiska rötter med global räckvidd. Våra gemensamma principer – Result driven, Client centric, Empowering och Accountable – vägleder oss i hur vi arbetar, utvecklas och lyckas tillsammans. Var med och accelerera övergången till ett hållbart samhälle.
   

  

**Jobbeskrivning**
 Vi söker en erfaren Javautvecklare till ett långsiktigt uppdrag hos en aktör med ansvar för samhällsviktig infrastruktur. Du kommer att arbeta i en komplex och tekniskt avancerad miljö där systemen ställer höga krav på säkerhet, tillgänglighet och prestanda.
   

  

 Som konsult blir du en del av ett agilt utvecklingsteam där du bidrar till utveckling och förvaltning av verksamhetskritiska system.
   

  

 I rollen så kommer du designa och utveckla robusta och skalbara applikationer i Java samt bygga och vidareutveckla mikrotjänstarkitekturer och distribuerade system. Utöver detta innefattar rollen även att:
   

  

* Utveckla API:er och arbeta med systemintegrationer mellan olika plattformar
* Delta i moderniseringsresor, exempelvis migrering från legacy-system
* Arbeta med testbarhet, kvalitet och prestanda i system med höga krav
* Bidra till och utveckla CI/CD-flöden och DevOps-arbetssätt
* Delta aktivt i kodgranskningar och kontinuerliga förbättringar
* Samarbeta nära team, arkitekter och verksamhet för att säkerställa rätt lösningar


**Kvalifikationer**
**Skallkrav**
* Flytande svenska i tal och skrift
* Minst fem års erfarenhet av Javautveckling inom offentlig sektor och/eller energisektorn.
* kandidatexamen inom datavetenskap eller liknande område


**Meriterande kvalifikationer**
* Erfarenhet av CI/CD och moderna utvecklingsflöden
* Erfarenhet av containerplattformar som Docker, Kubernetes eller OpenShift är meriterande
* Erfarenhet av molnteknologier (Azure, AWS eller liknande) är meriterande


 Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper och din vilja att skapa värde för kunder och kollegor.
   

  

**Viktig information om ansökan**
 För att vara aktuell för fortsatt urval behöver du i din ansökan tydligt redogöra för hur du uppfyller skallkraven. Vi baserar den initiala urvalsbedömningen på informationen i ansökan.
   

  

**Ytterligare information**
 Vår enhet Digital Services verkar över hela utvecklingskedjan med experter inom projektledning, kravanalys, QA och test, systemutveckling, arkitektur, dataanalys och AI, cybersäkerhet med mera.
   

  

 Vad erbjuder AFRY dig som anställd?
   

  

 Vi har regelbundna träffar där temat varierar mellan kompetens och socialt utbyte, eller både och. En bra balans helt enkelt! Hos oss får du också:
   

  

* En AFRY Buddy som bollplank under din första tid som anställd
* Balans i arbetslivet med möjlighet till hybridarbete.
* Tillgång till Club AFRY där en bredd av spännande och underhållande aktiviteter för våra medarbetare anordnas - det finns något för alla! Läs gärna mer här.
* Konkurrenskraftiga förmåner gällande pension, friskvård och föräldraledighet reglerade i vårt kollektivavtal
* Företagsrabatter med externa partners genom vår förmånsportal Advantage You.
* Friskvårdsbidrag 4500 SEK/år.
* Restauranger och kaféer på plats
* Ett enormt nätverk av tekniska experter med +19 000 kollegor runtom i världen.


**Välkommen med din ansökan, sista ansökningsdag är 2026-09-30**
**Kontaktperson för frågor:**
 Aamir Faried, Gruppchef
   

  

 aamir.faried@afry.com
   

  

 Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt säljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.
   

  

*På AFRY driver vi förändring i allt vi gör. Vi anser att förändring sker när modiga idéer möts, när vi samarbetar, skapar innovation och omfamnar kreativa lösningar, det är så vi skapar framtiden. Vi söker konstant kvalificerade kandidater som vill ansluta sig till våra inkluderande team runt om i världen. Bli en del av oss och påskynda den gröna omställningen*

title: Systemförvaltare
description:
Vill du förvalta och utveckla de samarbetsplattformar som används i hela Teracoms organisation? Då kan det vara dig vi söker i rollen som Systemförvaltare.
   

  

 Teracom ser till att radio, tv och beredskapskommunikation når fram när det verkligen gäller, oavsett om det råder solsken, storm eller kris. Som statligt bolag med över 100 års erfarenhet av samhällsviktig infrastruktur bygger och moderniserar vi den infrastruktur som Sverige är beroende av för att fungera i alla lägen. I den här rollen är du med och driver utvecklingen av våra samarbetsplattformar.
   

  

 Om rollen
   

  

 Som Systemförvaltare förvaltar och utvecklar du Teracoms samarbetsplattformar, främst Jira och Confluence, samt en applikation för säker fildelning. Du blir en del av en pågående förändringsresa där Teracom utreder framtiden för sin plattformsmiljö, med både molnmigrering och en eventuell övergång till exempelvis ServiceNow som möjliga vägar framåt.
   

  

 I vardagen handlar rollen om löpande förvaltning, felsökning och support, att hålla utbildningar och omsätta verksamhetens behov till konkreta lösningar i systemen. Det kan handla om att förbättra en befintlig process, eller att ta ett helt nytt behov från idé till färdigt systemstöd. Du styr själv prioriteringen och har en bred kontaktyta i organisationen, från servicedesk och IT till HR, kommunikation och säkerhet, samt externa leverantörer.
   

  

 Mer om dig
   

  

 För att trivas i rollen är du tekniskt nyfiken och kommunikativ, med förmåga att självständigt fatta beslut utifrån både verksamhetens och systemens behov. Du trivs med förändring och ser en osäker målbild som en möjlighet snarare än ett hinder.
   

  

 Vi tror att du har:
   

  

* Minst tre års erfarenhet av systemförvaltning, en tekniskt avancerad supportroll eller som projektledare inom IT.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta i minst ett av systemen Jira, Confluence eller ServiceNow.
* God förståelse för IT-arkitektur, databaser och integrationer – det tekniska djupet är det viktigaste i rollen.
* Erfarenhet av incidenthantering, automationer och behörighetsadministration.
* Förmåga att förklara komplexa tekniska frågor på ett enkelt sätt för många olika delar av organisationen.
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift.


 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av flera av systemen, särskilt Jira och Confluence. Kunskap om Linux-servermiljö är också meriterande, då det i dagsläget hanteras inom rollen.
   

  

 Teracom erbjuder
   

  

 Du får marknadsmässiga villkor och goda möjligheter att utvecklas i din roll. Förmåner inkluderar:
   

  

* Friskvårdsbidrag
* Rikskort eller subventionerat SL-kort
* Arbetstidsförkortning
* 2 friskvårdstimmar/vecka


 Mer information finns på Teracoms hemsida.
   

  

 Bra att känna till
   

  

 För anställning krävs godkänd drog- och alkoholtest samt att godkänd bakgrundskontroll liksom godkänd säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll genomförs. Detta eftersom anställningen innefattar säkerhetsklassning. Med anledning av detta krävs svenskt alternativt nordiskt medborgarskap.
   

  

 Ansökan
   

  

 Låter det här som en roll för dig? Då vill vi gärna höra ifrån dig. Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande så tveka inte på att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. För frågor, kontakta Sara Åkerlund, sara.akerlund@ants.se.
   

  

 Om du inte redan känner Teracom
   

  

 Teracom samhällsnät bidrar till ett tryggare samhälle genom att våra tjänster ser till att information och kommunikation kan fungera för de allra viktigaste samhällsfunktionerna även i kris och krig. Våra uppdrag inkluderar utsändningen av public servicekanalerna för radio och tv, kommunikationslösningar och beredskapsuppdraget. Vi utvecklar och levererar också allt fler beredskapstjänster samt olika typer av kommunikationslösningar till totalförsvarsviktiga aktörer. Vi är ett statligt bolag med cirka 500 medarbetare på ett 50-tal orter i Sverige. Vår vision är att, tillsammans med våra uppdragsgivare, göra Sverige tryggare där det behövs, när det behövs.

title: Senior ML Engineer
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**

  

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. title: Automotive Design & Development Engineer
description:
The Automotive Design & Development Engineer is responsible for the design, development, testing, and validation of automotive components and systems in accordance with international automotive standards and Swedish industry practices. The role involves technical responsibility from concept phase through series production.
  
The position requires advanced engineering competence and independent technical decision-making.
  
Main Duties and Responsibilities
  
  

**The employee will perform the following tasks:**  

Design & Development
  
* Develop and design automotive components and subsystems using CAD software (e.g., CATIA, Siemens NX, Creo, SolidWorks).
* Prepare 2D drawings and 3D models including GD&T specifications.
* Conduct tolerance analysis and material selection.
* Lead concept design reviews and technical feasibility studies.


Engineering Analysis & Validation
  
* Perform engineering simulations such as FEA and CFD.
* Support prototype builds and validation testing.
* Prepare Design Verification Plan & Report (DVP&R).
* Conduct DFMEA and risk assessments.


Product Lifecycle Management
  
* Manage engineering change requests (ECR/ECN).
* Prepare technical documentation in compliance with automotive quality standards (IATF 16949, ISO standards).
* Coordinate with manufacturing for production readiness.


Supplier & Cross-Functional Coordination
  
* Interface with suppliers for component development and cost optimization.
* Support procurement and quality teams during APQP and PPAP processes.
* Provide technical support during vehicle launch and production ramp-up.


Qualification Requirements
  
  

**The position requires:**  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or equivalent.
* Minimum 3–5 years of relevant experience in automotive product design and development.
* Proficiency in advanced CAD tools (CATIA/NX/Creo/SolidWorks).
* Knowledge of automotive development processes (APQP, PPAP, DFMEA).
* Experience in engineering simulations (FEA/CFD preferred).
* Strong knowledge of automotive safety and regulatory standards.
* Fluent English (spoken and written).


The position requires independent problem-solving skills and the ability to work in cross-functional international teams.
  
  

Employment Terms
  
* Employment type: Full-time, Project based
* Working hours: 40 hours per week
* Salary: Salary in line with Swedish collective agreement and meeting the minimum salary requirement for work permit eligibility
* Benefits: Occupational pension, insurance, and employment conditions according to Swedish labor law and applicable collective agreement


5. Level of Responsibility
  
This role is classified as a qualified engineering position requiring higher education and specialized technical competence. The employee will independently manage assigned development projects and contribute to technical decision-making.

* Ensuring timely and high-quality deliveries for complex development projects.

* Strong fundamental in Finite element methods and solid mechanics.
* Experience in product design of turbomachinery i.e., Gas turbine, steam turbine will be preferred.
* Experience in performing strength assessment as per ASME BPV Sec VIII Code.
* Experience in Rotor dynamics is an added advantage.
* Performing low cycle fatigue, high cycle fatigue and detailed fracture mechanics assessments of Gas turbine static & rotating components.

title: Master Thesis: AI-Based Automated Test Data Analysis and Report Generation Tool
description:
**Join our Team**
**About this opportunity:**
 In product verification and validation, large amounts of test data are generated from laboratory measurements, automated test systems, and network equipment. This data often consists of raw numerical values, text logs, and image-based results that require significant manual effort to analyse, visualize, and document in test reports.
   

  

 The goal of this thesis is to investigate and develop a software tool that automatically transforms raw test outputs into meaningful insights, including statistical analyses, graphical visualizations, and automated report population.
   

  

 The tool should be able to store and retrieve data from a database and classify the data based on the DUT vendor and run comparison between different DUT from different vendors in terms of performance parameters.
   

  

 The solution should reduce manual effort, improve reporting accuracy, and accelerate the overall test verification workflow.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Analyse existing test data formats including numerical measurements, textual logs, and image-based outputs.
* Design and develop a software application for automated test data processing.
* Convert raw measurement data into meaningful visualizations such as graphs, trend analyses, and statistical summaries.
* Investigate methods for extracting relevant information from text files and test result images.
* Implement automatic population of predefined test report templates and result tables.
* Evaluate the accuracy, efficiency, and usability of the developed solution.
* Demonstrate the tool using real-world test data from Ericsson verification environments.
* Present findings and recommendations for future deployment and enhancements.

title: Engineering Manager | Shared Tech
description:
**Craft:**
 Technology & Development
   

  

**Job Description:**
**Engineering Manager – Game Platform Foundations**
 Are you a natural connector who thrives on developing great people and high-performing teams? Do you enjoy solving complex technical challenges while enabling hundreds of millions of players to have amazing gaming experiences?
   

  

 Game Platform Foundations builds the platforms that make it fast, easy and safe to build and operate games, tools and services at King. We create the shared foundations that empower engineering teams to innovate faster, operate with confidence and continuously improve the player experience.
   

  

 As our platforms and technology continue to evolve, we’re investing in both our engineering capabilities and our people. That’s where you come in.
   

  

 Your role within our Kingdom
   

  

 Game Platform Foundations is responsible for building and evolving the shared platforms that support King’s games and engineering teams. From backend platforms and cloud infrastructure to developer experience, agentic engineering and internal tools platforms, we provide the foundations that enable teams across King to build, ship and operate games at global scale.
   

  

 Our mission is to make software engineering fast, easy and safe through intuitive self-service platforms, shared capabilities and scalable infrastructure. By improving developer experience and engineering effectiveness, we enable product teams to focus on creating amazing player experiences while we provide the platform products that help them succeed.
   

  

 As an Engineering Manager, you will inspire and empower the engineers in your team, enabling them to build high-quality software while supporting their individual growth through coaching, goal setting and continuous feedback.
   

  

 You will be responsible for recruitment, mentoring, coaching, performance management and fostering a collaborative, inclusive and psychologically safe team culture. You’ll work closely with other Engineering Managers, Tech Directors and Software Engineers, and own stakeholder relationships at team level, building trusted partnerships with engineering teams across King, aligning on delivery priorities and trade-offs, and ensuring your team’s work creates clear, measurable value for developers and players.
   

  

 We believe great platforms are products. You will own the product direction for your team: defining the roadmap, translating the needs of King’s engineering community into clear priorities and making informed trade-offs. You are accountable for delivery, tracking progress, reporting with transparency and steering the team to hit commitments with precision and predictability. You will continuously evolve those products using productivity metrics and developer feedback to identify friction, experiment with improvements and measure success through the value your team creates for developers and ultimately for players.
   

  

 You’ll work across the platform domains where Foundations has most impact: backend systems and developer tooling, cloud infrastructure, observability, internal tools and agentic engineering. In a dynamic platform organisation, the specific focus may evolve as technology and priorities shift, but the goal is always the same: help your team build software that King’s engineers love to use and trust to run their games.
   

  

 AI-assisted and agentic engineering is increasingly central to how we work. You will guide your team’s adoption of AI tooling in ways that raise the quality and speed of good engineering decisions, and ensure that judgment, correctness and maintainability remain the bar, regardless of how code is produced.
   

  

 You have a humble and direct leadership style, are comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, believe in pragmatic Agile ways of working and are passionate about developing both people and technology.
   

  

 Skills to create thrills
   

  

 We believe your journey started with a passion for technology and problem solving, giving you a solid understanding of software engineering and the challenges engineering teams face every day. Over time, you’ve discovered that helping people grow can be just as rewarding as building great software.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has experience leading software engineering teams together with a technical background in software engineering, distributed systems, cloud platforms or platform engineering. You enjoy solving complex technical challenges while building shared platforms that enable other engineering teams to move faster, deliver with confidence and focus on creating value.
   

  

 You understand that great platforms are built with their users in mind. You care about creating products and services that engineers love to use and have a passion for improving developer experience, engineering effectiveness and operational excellence. You are comfortable leading through change, building strong relationships across teams and creating an environment where engineers can do their best work.
   

  

  

* Experience building or operating large-scale cloud platforms and distributed systems.
* Experience with platform engineering, internal tools platforms, developer experience or engineering productivity.
* Experience leading technical modernization and large-scale platform transformations.
* Experience from the gaming industry is a bonus, but we also welcome candidates from other industries operating complex, large-scale software platforms.


 Most importantly, we’re looking for an inquisitive Engineering Manager who enjoys bringing people together to solve challenging problems, build exceptional teams and create platforms that help engineering teams across King do their best work.
   

  

**About King**
 With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

title: Kravställande Specialist - Signalsystem
description:
*Vill du bidra till att utveckla och säkra framtidens signalsystem i en verksamhet där kvalitet, säkerhet och långsiktighet står i fokus?*
*Trafikförvaltningen, Region Stockholm söker nu dig som har byggt upp en gedigen teknisk kompetens inom signalsystem och som kan vara den specialist som hjälper verksamheten att fatta rätt tekniska beslut, både idag och för framtiden.*
**Om rollen**
 Som kravställande specialist blir du ett viktigt stöd till projekt och förvaltning i frågor som rör signalsystem, teknisk kravställning och verksamhetskritiska processer. Med din erfarenhet bidrar du till att säkerställa robusta, hållbara och långsiktigt effektiva lösningar i en verksamhet där säkerhet, kvalitet och samhällsnytta står i centrum.
   

  

 Rollen passar dig som trivs med att analysera komplexa sammanhang, omsätta specialistkunskap till tydliga vägval och skapa struktur i tekniskt avancerade miljöer. Du verkar genom din expertis och har en viktig rådgivande funktion där du stöttar verksamheten med kvalificerade bedömningar, kravställning och strategisk vägledning för att stärka både projektgenomförande och långsiktig förvaltning.
   

  

**Några exempel på arbetsuppgifter:**
* Vara specialiststöd till projektledare och förvaltare.
* Driva frågor inom dokumentation, konfigurationsstyrning och mjukvarurelaterade processer.
* Identifiera risker och bidra till långsiktigt hållbara lösningar.
* Ställa tekniska krav och bidra i strategiska vägval.
* Samverka med specialister, projekt och verksamhet för att skapa gemensam förståelse och framdrift.


**För att trivas och lyckas i rollen behöver du:**
 Vi tror att du är en analytisk och lösningsorienterad person som trivs med att arbeta självständigt och driva frågor framåt. Du har lätt för att skapa förtroendefulla relationer, samarbeta med olika intressenter och kommunicera komplexa frågor på ett tydligt och begripligt sätt. Samtidigt motiveras du av att arbeta i en verksamhet där kvalitet, säkerhet och långsiktigt hållbara lösningar står i fokus. Eftersom rollen kräver att du kan dokumentera, analysera och kommunicera komplexa tekniska frågor på ett tydligt och strukturerat sätt till olika målgrupper, ser vi att du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt, samt har goda kunskaper i Microsoft Office.
   

  

**Krav:**
* Akademisk examen från högskola eller universitet inom teknik, systemteknik eller annan inriktning som trafikförvaltningen bedömer som likvärdig.
* Gedigen erfarenhet av signalsystem inom järnväg eller annan säkerhetskritisk teknisk verksamhet.
* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att driva tekniska frågor genom kravställning, specialiststöd och rådgivning i komplexa verksamhetsmiljöer.
* God förståelse för dokumentationsstyrning, konfigurationshantering samt system- och mjukvarurelaterade processer.


**Det är meriterande om du har:**
* Erfarenhet av livscykelhantering och förvaltning av tekniska system, exempelvis enligt ISO 55000.
* Kunskap inom cybersäkerhet och/eller säkerhetsskydd.
* Erfarenhet av manöversystem, trafikstyrningssystem och informationssystem inom IT/OT-miljöer.
* Erfarenhet av att leda, styra eller medverka i utvecklingsprojekt enligt EN 50126 och närliggande standarder.
* Erfarenhet av signalsystem och trafikstyrning inom spårväg.
* Civilingenjörsutbildning med relevant inriktning, exempelvis järnväg, signalsystem, elektroteknik eller IT/OT.
* Utbildning eller kurser inom signalteknik, signaltekniska system eller säkerhetsstyrning.


 Vi ser det som positivt om du har erfarenhet inom något eller flera av områdena ovan, men vi söker inte nödvändigtvis någon som kan allt. Vi uppmuntrar därför sökanden som bara uppfyller vissa av de meriterande kraven, särskilt om du besitter stort djup inom något/några av dessa områden.
   

  

**Om oss**
 Hos oss på trafikförvaltningen får du jobba med starka varumärken som SL, Waxholmsbolaget, Färdtjänst i Region Stockholm och Spårvägsmuseet.
   

  

 Tillsammans ansvarar vi för halva Sveriges kollektivtrafik och vi har höga ambitioner. Vi utvecklar en av världens mest hållbara och attraktiva kollektivtrafik. Och vi jobbar dagligen med att minska vår miljöpåverkan, öka social hållbarhet och ansvarfullt förvalta våra gemensamma medel. Utan oss stannar Stockholm.
   

  

**Det här erbjuder vi dig**
 På trafikförvaltningen har du möjlighet att växa och utvecklas för ett helt yrkesliv. Här kan du vara expert och fokusera på ditt sakområde. Samtidigt som du jobbar i ett lag och i en organisation med stor bredd. Det finns stora möjligheter att röra sig mellan olika roller och uppgifter. Du har utrymme att forma din egen karriärväg och stärka både din personliga och professionella utveckling i en spännande och varierad miljö!
   

  

 Vi är en välkomnande och öppen arbetsplats där vi stöttar och hjälper varandra. Vi vet att nyckeln för att vi ska klara vårt uppdrag – är medarbetare som trivs, mår bra och kan utvecklas på jobbet. Därför lägger vi stor vikt vid att säkerställa hållbarhet i vårt arbetssätt, bland annat genom att erbjuda flexibilitet i vardagen och hybridarbete när möjlighet finns.
   

  

 Årligen erbjuds hälsoundersökning och friskvårdsbidrag på 5 000 kr. Hälsospåret, vår friskvårdssatsning, innehåller en rad olika hälsofrämjande aktiviteter. SL-kort är en annan uppskattad förmån hos oss. Läs mer om våra förmåner här.
   

  

**Välkommen med din ansökan!**
 Du ansöker med CV via vår hemsida, vi har inte möjlighet att ta emot ansökan via e-post. För att säkra objektiva bedömningar använder vi tester i samband med urval. Om du har några frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef  Martin Almgren, tfn +46707861611. För frågor om rekryteringsprocessen, kontakta rekryterare Caroline Ljungberg, tfn +46707864070.
   

  

 Ansök redan i dag eftersom intervjuer kan ske löpande. Sista ansökningsdag är 2026-10-06.
   

  

 Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!
   

  

 Vi ställer höga krav på våra medarbetares säkerhets- och sekretessmedvetenhet. Grundutredning enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) kan komma att genomföras innan beslut om anställning fattas. Vissa tjänster ställer krav på svenskt medborgarskap samt omfattas av en säkerhetsprövningsintervju med registerkontroll enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585).
   

  

 Mer information om vad säkerhetsprövningen innebär och hur den går till finner ni här.
   

  

 Provanställning kan komma att tillämpas och eventuella arbetsprov kan bli aktuella för tjänsten.
   

  

**Webb och sociala medier**
 För mer information om hur det är att jobba hos oss, besök vår karriärsida. Du hittar oss också på LinkedIn.

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
**TL;DR** 
 - We are looking for data engineers to design, build, and maintain the end-to-end declarative data platform that powers ingestion, transformation, and consumption across Lovable. You are obsessed about empowering teams to ensure data systems are scalable, reliable, safe and easy to use.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**What we are looking for:**
* Strong experience with cloud-based data platforms (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks or similar).
* Deep understanding of data ingestion frameworks, orchestration(Airflow, Dagster, Prefect or similar) and infrastructure as code (Terraform, Pulumi or similar).
* Familiarity with event-driven architectures (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Kinesis or similar).
* Proficiency in SQL, and distributed systems. Knowledge in Go is a plus.
* Strong communication and documentation skills. Be able to align technical details with strategic goals.


**What you will do:**
* Develop and maintain core data infrastructure (data lake, warehouse, orchestration, observability, governance).
* Partner with other platform and domain teams to design data pipelines and implement declarative configuration for ingestion and transformation.
* Ensure data quality, lineage, and security standards are embedded across all workflows.
* Collaborate with Analytics Engineers to define modeling conventions and enforce schema governance.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines for data systems and assist with cost optimization and performance tuning.
* Define data platform best practices and support self-service enablement.


**Our tech stack**
 We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:
   

  

* Frontend: React
* Backend: Golang and Rust
* Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, Many LLM providers
* DevOps & Tooling: Github Actions, Grafana, OTEL, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform)


 And always on the lookout for what's next!
   

  

**How We Hire**
* Fill in a short form then jump on an intro call with recruiter.
* Complete the general programming exercise.
* Show us how you approach problems during several technical interviews.
* Tell us about your most impressive project.


**About Your Application**
* Please submit your application in English - it’s our company language so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join
* We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested please apply through our careers portal
